💻 We Are Hiring- Backend Developer | 100% Remote

We are seeking a skilled Backend Developer with professional experience to maintain, support, and enhance an existing Payment Terminal Management Platform.

The role involves supporting backend services, managing transaction-related data, maintaining APIs, and implementing improvements to ensure the platform operates reliably and efficiently.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and improve existing backend applications, services, and APIs.
  • Develop and implement backend features based on business and product requirements.
  • Work with SQL databases to manage and retrieve transaction-related information.
  • Maintain integrations between backend services, the management dashboard, and related systems.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve backend issues.
  • Improve backend performance, reliability, and data handling.
  • Collaborate with the Product Owner and frontend developer to deliver system improvements.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, and documentation of backend changes.

Must-Have Skills:

  • At least 5 years of professional experience in Backend Development for a payment terminal management platform or similar transaction-processing systems.
  • Good English communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate technical decisions.
  • Strong hands-on experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js for backend application and API development.
  • Good knowledge and practical experience in SQL and Relational Database Management Systems (RDBMS), including database queries, data retrieval, and management.
  • Experience in RESTful API Development, Git Version Control, and Backend Troubleshooting, including debugging, testing, and maintaining existing backend applications.
  • Knowledge or hands-on experience in Python for backend development, scripting, or automation.

Nice-To-Have Skills:

  • Familiarity with payment processing workflows, transaction data management, and payment terminal integrations.
  • Experience integrating backend services with management dashboards, frontend applications, and third-party systems.
  • Experience improving backend system performance, scalability, reliability, and data-handling efficiency.

🕒 Work Schedule: 4 PM - 12 MN Philippine Time

🚀 Engagement: Full-time engagement

💎 What You’ll Get

  • Above-market compensation.
  • Long-term opportunity.
  • Opportunity to shape user-facing experiences that reach thousands of users.
  • Collaborative, growth-oriented work culture.
  • Enjoy a Signing Bonus of PHP 50,000 upon joining!

🚨 Don’t Meet Every Requirement?

No worries. If you're a strong developer and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply! We’re always looking for exceptional people—even if they don’t check every box.

💬 Referral Program – Earn While You Help!

Know someone who’s a great fit for this role?

Refer a candidate and earn up to ₱20,000 per successful hire. There’s no limit—refer as many qualified developers as you like!

raw.description:
What is Shotgun?

Shotgun is a leading platform dedicated to empowering live music event organizers and touring artists, driving the future of the live music industry. Our mission is to build the infrastructure that enables live music to thrive.

We provide powerful tools to sell tickets, build strong brands, and connect with fans in meaningful ways. From 2020 to 2025, Shotgun achieved rapid growth with GMV increasing 25× and revenue growing 40×, leading the company to profitability. Today, we support more than 10,000 clients and engage over 8,000,000 users across Europe, the US, and LATAM.

In the past seven years, Shotgun has raised €10M from Newfund, Venrex, One RagTime, Creator Collective, and BPI Culture Fund. We are a lean and dynamic team, with offices in Paris, Miami, São Paulo, Lisbon, and Marseille. Our culture is built on passion, commitment, ownership, and humility.

The Role

As Shotgun grows, so does the complexity behind every ticket sold. We're expanding into new countries and live music experiences, and our engineering teams need a platform that helps them move fast with confidence.

As our Engineering Manager Platform, your mission is to lead the team building the technical foundation for Shotgun’s next stage of growth. You own the Platform roadmap and technical choices across four pillars: observability, security, scalability, and developer experience.

You will manage a team of two Staff Software Engineers and one SRE, reporting to Vivien, our Head of Engineering. This is a hands-on role: expect to spend around 50% of your time on technical work and 50% on people management, team processes, and collaboration.

What you will do

  • Own the Platform roadmap and technical priorities, turning the needs of engineering teams and the business into clear objectives, supported by relevant metrics

  • Lead and support two Staff Engineers and one SRE, creating the environment, feedback, and team rituals they need to do their best work

  • Stay hands-on with backend and platform engineering, contributing to implementation, reviewing designs, and helping the team solve complex technical problems

  • Improve observability across the platform, bringing together metrics, logs, and traces with OpenTelemetry and meaningful SLIs and SLOs

  • Strengthen platform security and scalability, making sure our foundations support international growth and sharp traffic peaks

  • Improve developer experience across databases, CI/CD, service hosting, and repository management so teams can build and ship more effectively

  • Tackle technical debt and distributed architecture challenges, balancing immediate needs with the long-term health of the platform

  • Partner with engineering teams on the revamp of our end-user API, and help shape shared backend architecture principles and guidelines

  • Work closely with Engineering, Data, and Ops to build a platform that serves the whole company

The job is for you if

Must-have

  • You have 5**+ years of engineering experience**, including experience leading a backend or platform team as an Engineering Manager or Tech Lead in a startup that scaled

  • You have strong backend expertise, preferably in TypeScript / JavaScript, and want to remain hands-on for around 60% of your time

  • You have a deep understanding of PostgreSQL and solid knowledge of backend architecture patterns such as DDD

  • You have solid experience with AWS infrastructure, including services such as IAM, S3, EC2, EKS, and RDS

  • You know how to lead experienced engineers, providing clear direction, useful feedback, and autonomy

  • You can own a technical roadmap, define measurable objectives, and balance reliability, delivery speed, and business priorities with a pragmatic approach

  • You communicate clearly in French and English, and collaborate with humility, ownership, and proactivity

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with OpenTelemetry, SLIs, and SLOs

  • Experience improving developer tooling, CI/CD, and shared engineering workflows

  • Experience leading API refactoring or distributed architecture improvements

  • A passion for live music, entertainment, and the engineering challenges behind large ticket sales

👪 Note to women and underrepresented groups: We value diversity because it’s essential for creativity and healthy growth. If you don’t meet 100% of the requirements but are excited by this role, please apply 🙏

Comps & Perks

  • 💰 Compensation: Competitive salary

  • 📍 Location: Paris preferred, remote possible

  • ✈️ Team Offsites & Events: We invest in team moments because they matter

  • 🕺 Shotgun Event Credits: Enjoy live events with quarterly credits

  • 🏋️‍♀️ EGYM Wellpass: Preferential rates for gyms and sports activities

  • 🌱 Sustainable Mobility Bonus: For eco-friendly commuting like biking

  • 🍔 Swile Lunch Card: Meals and more

  • 💊 Alan Health Insurance

  • 👶 Childcare Support

raw.description:
Job Summary

The Business Continuity & Crisis Management Officer will be responsible for developing, establishing, and implementing a comprehensive Business Continuity and Crisis Management Framework across the organization.

The role focuses on building business continuity processes, policies, and procedures from the ground up to strengthen organizational resilience, minimize operational disruptions, and ensure preparedness for potential crises.

The position will work closely with management and various business units to identify risks, assess business-critical functions, develop response and recovery strategies, and establish an effective enterprise-wide business continuity program.

Key Responsibilities

Business Continuity Planning & Development

  • Develop and implement an enterprise-wide Business Continuity Management (BCM) Framework from the ground up.
  • Establish business continuity policies, procedures, standards, and governance structures.
  • Conduct Business Impact Analysis (BIA) to identify critical functions, dependencies, and recovery priorities.
  • Develop Business Continuity Plans (BCPs) and recovery strategies for different departments and business units.
  • Identify potential threats and vulnerabilities that may affect organizational operations.

Crisis Management & Response

  • Establish a Crisis Management Framework, including escalation procedures, communication protocols, and incident response guidelines.
  • Develop crisis response strategies for operational disruptions, emergencies, natural disasters, and other business-critical incidents.
  • Define roles, responsibilities, and decision-making protocols during crisis situations.
  • Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure preparedness and effective crisis response.

Risk Assessment & Organizational Resilience

  • Conduct enterprise-wide risk and continuity assessments.
  • Collaborate with department heads to identify operational risks and business dependencies.
  • Recommend mitigation measures and recovery strategies to minimize business interruptions.
  • Align continuity and crisis management initiatives with organizational objectives and recognized industry standards.

Implementation, Testing & Continuous Improvement

  • Facilitate the implementation of business continuity and crisis management procedures across business units.
  • Organize crisis simulations, tabletop exercises, and business continuity testing activities.
  • Evaluate organizational preparedness and identify areas for improvement.
  • Provide training and awareness sessions to employees and key stakeholders.
  • Maintain and periodically review continuity plans and crisis response procedures.

Governance & Stakeholder Coordination

  • Work closely with senior management and cross-functional teams to establish business continuity governance and accountability.
  • Prepare documentation, reports, recommendations, and progress updates.
  • Ensure business continuity practices are aligned with relevant regulations, organizational policies, and industry standards.
  • Support the long-term sustainability and continuous improvement of the organization's business continuity program.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Risk Management, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in Business Continuity Management, Crisis Management, Operational Resilience, Enterprise Risk Management, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience developing or implementing business continuity frameworks, policies, and procedures.
  • Experience conducting Business Impact Analysis, risk assessments, crisis preparedness planning, and continuity testing.
  • Familiarity with ISO 22301, business continuity management principles, and crisis management best practices.
  • Strong analytical, project management, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to coordinate with multiple business units and communicate effectively with senior leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in diversified corporations, infrastructure, financial services, utilities, logistics, or other organizations with complex operations.
  • Hands-on experience establishing business continuity or crisis management programs from scratch.
  • Certifications such as Certified Business Continuity Professional (CBCP), Member of the Business Continuity Institute (MBCI), or ISO 22301 Lead Implementer are advantageous.

Key Competencies

  • Business Continuity Management (BCM)
  • Crisis Management & Incident Response
  • Business Impact Analysis (BIA)
  • Enterprise Risk Assessment
  • Business Continuity Planning (BCP)
  • Disaster Recovery & Recovery Planning
  • Operational Resilience
  • Crisis Communication & Escalation
  • Policy & Framework Development
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Business Continuity Testing & Simulation

raw.description:
Foresite is looking for a high-energy, results-oriented Enterprise Account Executive - West to drive the growth of our Google Security practice. In this role, you will act as the primary catalyst for expanding Foresite’s footprint, selling our Managed Detection and Response (MDR), SecOps, and advisory offerings built on the power of Google Security Operations, Chronicle, and Mandiant.

This role is designed for a strategic seller who excels at the intersection of cybersecurity expertise and cloud technology, helping mid-market and enterprise customers modernize their security operations and reduce risk.

What You'll Do:

In this role, you will operate at the intersection of Foresite’s cybersecurity expertise and Google’s security technology. You will partner closely with Google Cloud field sellers, Google Security specialists, and Foresite’s solution architects and delivery teams to identify opportunities, shape solutions, and close business. You will be measured on new logo acquisition, annual recurring revenue (ARR), and the expansion of existing customer relationships.

Revenue Generation & Territory Management

  • Own the Quota: Execute a strategic territory plan to achieve and exceed quarterly and annual bookings quotas for Foresite’s Google Security-aligned services.

  • Pipeline Excellence: Build and maintain a qualified pipeline through direct prospecting, account-based outreach, and co-selling with Google Cloud field teams and channel partners.

  • Lead to Close: Lead negotiations and drive deals to completion, ensuring accurate forecasting and disciplined use of CRM (HubSpot/Salesforce) and deal-desk processes.

Strategic Partnerships & Co-Selling

  • Google Ecosystem Integration: Collaborate with Google Cloud account teams on joint account planning, opportunity registration, and leveraging partner funding programs (MDF, POC funding) to accelerate cycles.

  • Solution Crafting: Partner with Foresite solution architects and Google specialists to design compelling, outcome-focused proposals and Statements of Work (SOWs).

  • Market Presence: Represent Foresite at industry events, Google Cloud partner forums, and customer briefings as a credible voice for our Google Security practice.

Executive Relationship Building

  • C-Level Engagement: Develop deep relationships with CISOs, CIOs, and security leaders to understand their business drivers, compliance requirements, and SOC maturity.

  • Feedback Loop: Provide structured insights into Foresite’s product and marketing leadership regarding customer needs and competitive dynamics to enhance our service portfolio.

Who You Are:

  • Experienced Pro: You have 7+ years of experience in a quota-carrying technology sales role, specifically selling cybersecurity, cloud, or enterprise software.

  • Security Savvy: You have a deep understanding of the threat landscape and experience selling into IT security buyers (CISOs, SOC Directors, Architects).

  • Strategic Navigator: You are skilled at influencing multiple stakeholders across technical and executive audiences and can translate technical capabilities into ROI.

  • Collaborative Hunter: You have a proven track record of building pipelines through both direct prospecting and partner co-selling motions.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have:

  • Google Cloud Expertise: Direct experience selling or partnering within the Google Cloud Security ecosystem (Chronicle, Mandiant, SCC).

  • Service Knowledge: Experience selling managed security services (MDR, MSSP) or GRC/Compliance services (CMMC, HIPAA, SOC 2).

  • Growth Mindset: Deep knowledge of SecOps modernization trends and the competitive landscape across SIEM, XDR, and MDR providers.

Why Join the Foresite Team?

At Foresite, we aren’t just another security provider—we are a mission-driven partner helping organizations navigate an increasingly complex threat landscape. We’ve built a global leader in SecOps and MDR by leaning into three core pillars that set us apart from the crowd:

  • The "Google Bet" Has Paid Off: Four years ago, we took a contrarian path by going all-in on Google Cloud. Today, that strategy is validated. As a Google Cloud Security Partner of the Year, we operate at the absolute cutting edge of the industry, offering our team a front-row seat to the future of security operations.

  • Practitioner Credibility: We were founded by security practitioners, and more importantly, we are still governed by them. We speak the language of the SOC because we’ve lived it. This ensures our strategy is driven by technical reality, not just marketing trends.

  • Room to Run: We are at that "sweet spot" of growth—large enough to win global contracts, but early enough that every individual’s contribution directly shapes our trajectory.

When you join Foresite, you are part of a "humans-first" culture where radical transparency isn’t just a buzzword—it’s how we lead. We know that while our technology is world-class, our greatest asset is the practitioner behind the keyboard.

How You'll Win Here:

  • Partner-sourced pipeline (Google Cloud co-sell, not pure cold outbound)

  • Dedicated Customer Engineer (SE) pairing from day one

  • ABM, field marketing, and BDR coverage on named accounts

  • Practitioner-led delivery team you can stand behind in CISO meetings

What We Offer:

  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Robust medical insurance options to keep you and your family healthy.

  • Employer-Covered Insurance: We fully provide employer-paid Dental coverage, as well as Short-Term (STD) and Long-Term Disability (LTD).

  • Recharge & Refuel: We believe in a true work-life balance. You’ll start with 3 weeks of paid vacation, plus additional sick leave and paid company holidays.

  • Uncapped Upside:A competitive, results-oriented commission structure with no ceiling on what you can earn.

The Global Medical Director, Rare Cardiology is an integral member of the Rare Cardiology Global Medical team, providing dedicated scientific and external engagement leadership grounded in deep rare disease expertise, with a focus on transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy (ATTR-CM) and rare cardiology.


WHAT YOU WILL ACHIEVE

This global medical affairs role on the TTR Amyloidosis team will be responsible for supporting critical external thought leader relationships as well as partnering with key internal colleagues on the delivery of scientifically accurate content for educational and commercial uses outside of the company.


HOW YOU WILL ACHIEVE IT

  • Primary medical contact to the commercial team with responsibility for medical input on materials created in support of the ATTR-CM indication/Vyndaqel.
  • Primary medical support/SME for the content development team to ensure the scientific validity of all deliverables for external use.
  • Shared responsibility for the scientific symposia content for all internal congresses.

  • Advance AI-enabled and data-driven medical initiatives, including early diagnosis, patient identification, medical insight generation, and responsible use of AI tools in accordance with applicable governance, privacy, quality, and compliance requirements.
  • Partner with relevant stakeholders to ensure an aligned scientific strategy, consistent external narrative, and effective preparation for submissions, scientific advice, key market events, congresses, competitive readouts, and customer-facing colleague needs.
  • Lead or contribute to scientific content, medical education, training, advisory board strategy, external engagement plans, publications, and medical communications related to ATTR-CM and rare cardiology.

QUALIFICATIONS

Must-Have

  • Advanced scientific or clinical degree required.
  • Minimum 10+ years of pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or relevant healthcare industry experience, with substantial experience in Medical Affairs.

  • Managerial experience
  • Experience leading medical strategy, evidence generation, lifecycle management, publications, scientific communications, launch readiness, and external expert engagement.
  • Strong scientific acumen, strategic thinking, executive communication skills, and ability to influence senior stakeholders in a complex matrix environment.

raw.title: SVP Transformation Execution and Delivery
raw.excerpt: Overview We are seeking a senior leader with a proven record of bringing complex technical transformations to completion.
raw.description:
Overview

We are seeking a senior leader with a proven record of bringing complex technical transformations to completion. This leader will own end-to-end execution, translating strategic objectives into an integrated delivery plan and establishing the discipline, transparency, and accountability required to achieve measurable business outcomes. The mandate is not simply to coordinate work or report progress; it is to drive decisions, resolve barriers, and deliver a successful transformation through implementation, adoption, stabilization, and operational handoff.

The successful candidate will combine technical fluency, operational rigor, and executive influence to align technology, product, operations, finance, and other business stakeholders around a single execution framework. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can bring structure to ambiguity, challenge unsupported assumptions, and maintain delivery momentum without compromising quality or business continuity.

Responsibilities

  • Own delivery through completion. Establish accountability for transformation scope, schedule, investment, quality, adoption, and business outcomes. Define what completion means and secure agreement on measurable acceptance criteria.
  • Build one integrated execution plan. Translate the transformation into sequenced workstreams, deliverables, milestones, critical-path dependencies, resource requirements, and named accountable owners. Reconcile technical delivery plans with operational readiness and business commitments
  • Install rigorous governance. Establish a consistent operating cadence for workstream reviews and executive decisions. Maintain a single source of truth for commitments, decisions, dependencies, and performance, and give the executive team and sponsors clear recommendations and timely decision requests.
  • Enforce stage-gate discipline. Apply the gate framework below. Surface unmet criteria explicitly and require documented decisions on remediation, exceptions, or changes before proceeding.
  • Drive technical execution. Partner with engineering, architecture, product, data, security, and infrastructure leaders to challenge estimates, validate sequencing, and resolve integration, migration, testing, scalability, and release-readiness issues.
  • Manage risks and recovery. Identify delivery threats early, quantify their implications, assign mitigation owners, and execute recovery plans. Escalate unresolved issues with clear options, trade-offs, recommendations, and decision deadlines.
  • Control scope and investment. Establish disciplined change control and assess requests against business value, capacity, cost, delivery timing, and risk. Make the consequences of reprioritization visible before commitments change.
  • Measure outcomes, not activity. Establish baselines, targets, metric definitions, data sources, and accountable owners. Use leading and lagging indicators to distinguish completed tasks from accepted deliverables and realized business value.
  • Lead cross-functional execution. Align teams and external partners around shared commitments and resolve competing priorities, promoting fact-based problem solving and timely escalation.
  • Cultivate high-performing teams. Build, mentor, and retain top-tier technical and program management talent, and create a team culture that applies best-in-class practices and sustains high customer satisfaction.
  • Lead with accountability and principle. Set clear goals and roles, hold leaders and teams to their commitments through candid feedback and prompt corrective action, and model integrity, transparency, and sound judgment.
  • Secure adoption and sustained results. Integrate process redesign, communications, training, support readiness, and operational controls into the delivery plan. Own stabilization and handoff to permanent operational owners, including benefits tracking and formal closure.

Milestones and Decision Gates

  • Establish a fit-for-purpose gate framework that connects technical progress to business readiness. Each gate needs an accountable owner, a committed date, objective acceptance criteria, supporting evidence, and a designated decision-maker. The framework should address:
  • Mobilization and baseline: Approved scope, business case, delivery plan, resourcing, dependencies, success measures, and governance.
  • Design and execution readiness: Validated requirements, solution approach, integration and data plans, operational impacts, and test strategy.
  • Release and deployment readiness: Evidence of testing, defect disposition, migration readiness, security and operational approvals, training, support coverage, and contingency plans.
  • Stabilization and operational acceptance: Demonstrated performance against agreed service and quality thresholds, resolved or formally accepted issues, and operational-owner sign-off.
  • Benefits validation and closure: Accepted deliverables, verified outcomes against the business case, assigned ownership for ongoing benefits, and completed transition documentation.

raw.description:
Overview

Join our dynamic healthcare team at Health Services of North Texas as a Remote Referral / Authorization Coordinator, where your expertise helps streamline patient care and reduce delays in treatment. In this vital role, you will manage referral and authorization workflows from start to finish, ensuring providers, insurance companies, and patients stay informed and aligned. You will use your knowledge of managed care, medical coding, and medical records to secure timely approvals so patients can access the services they need. If you are detail‑oriented, passionate about healthcare access, and ready to make a direct impact from the comfort of your home, this role is an excellent opportunity to grow your career.

﻿Key Responsibilities


Review, enter, and process incoming referral requests and prior authorization submissions quickly and accurately according to payer requirements.
Verify insurance coverage and benefits using online portals and phone verification to confirm eligibility, in‑network providers, and authorization requirements.
Collaborate with providers and clinic staff to obtain necessary clinical notes, orders, and supporting documentation needed for approvals.
Utilize medical terminology, CPT codes, and ICD‑9/ICD‑10 coding to support accurate and complete referral and authorization requests.
Maintain strict compliance with HIPAA and organizational privacy policies when handling patient information throughout the referral process.
Track, monitor, and document all referral and authorization activities in the electronic health record (EHR) and other tracking tools to ensure audit readiness.
Follow up with insurance carriers to check status, appeal denials when appropriate, and clarify any missing or incorrect information.
Communicate clearly with providers, clinic staff, and patients about referral status, required steps, and any issues affecting scheduling or approval.
Work closely with billing and front‑office teams to reduce denied claims by ensuring accurate authorization information is documented prior to services.

﻿Skills and Qualifications


Strong knowledge of managed care policies, insurance verification processes, and general medical office procedures.
Experience in a medical office, clinic, hospital, or dental office handling referrals, authorizations, medical records, or billing is highly preferred.
Proficiency with CPT and ICD‑9/ICD‑10 coding concepts and the ability to interpret clinical information for authorization requirements.
Familiarity with HIPAA regulations and commitment to maintaining confidentiality and privacy of patient information at all times.
Ability to navigate electronic health record (EHR) systems efficiently, with accurate and thorough documentation of all activities.
Solid understanding of medical terminology across primary care and specialty services; dental office experience is a plus.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills to liaise effectively with providers, insurance companies, and patients.
High level of attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple referrals and insurance requests simultaneously.
Comfortable working independently in a remote environment, meeting productivity and turnaround time expectations.

﻿Why This Role Stands Out


Fully remote position supporting a mission‑driven nonprofit that improves access to care across North Texas.
Direct impact on patient experience by helping reduce delays and ensuring services are approved before appointments.
Opportunity to deepen your knowledge of insurance, authorizations, and medical coding while working with a supportive team.

﻿This role is perfect for motivated professionals eager to make a difference in healthcare delivery while working remotely in a fast‑paced, patient‑focused environment. If you love problem‑solving, coordination, and ensuring patients get the care they need, we encourage you to apply.

The Summer 2027 Product Management & Development Undergraduate Internship provides students with an opportunity to gain meaningful, hands-on experience supporting the development, implementation, and ongoing management of dental and vision products within a large healthcare organization. This internship is designed to develop the next generation of business and product professionals through direct exposure to product strategy, artificial intelligence (AI), automation, market research, data analysis, process improvement, and cross-functional product delivery.

As a member of the Product Management & Development team, the intern will work alongside product professionals and business partners to support initiatives that enhance products, modernize processes, and improve the way product information is managed and delivered. Participants will gain insight into the full product lifecycle, from research and initial concept through development, testing, implementation, measurement, and continuous improvement.

A significant focus of the internship will involve exploring practical applications of AI and automation to solve real business challenges and improve everyday processes. The intern will help identify potential AI use cases, research available solutions, support development and testing, document results, and evaluate opportunities to increase efficiency and effectiveness across the Product organization.

The intern will also contribute to dental and vision product initiatives through competitive research, data analysis, product implementation support, process improvement, and modernization of internal tools and resources. Projects may include enhancing SharePoint resources, improving product documentation, supporting the transition of information from legacy databases to modern solutions, and developing recommendations that inform product strategy.

This internship is designed to provide real project ownership rather than observation-only experience. Participants will have opportunities to contribute to initiatives addressing current business needs and may see projects progress from research and initial concept through testing, implementation, and measurement of results.


SUMMARY OF JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

This job has the goal of providing the opportunity to acquire practical experience through direct exposure to the related business line(s) and to develop the next generation of diverse business professionals. To that end, the program will provide hands-on training and experience in the business line, expose the various career opportunities in the business line and related areas, and prepare participants for positions in the business.

Typical responsibilities include, providing services to the day-to-day operating objectives of the assigned area, participating in projects and programs appropriate to the needs of the assigned area, participating in the planning and implementation of projects and initiatives, conducting research and reporting including recommendations or proposals for action.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Business Administration, Management, Marketing, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Healthcare Administration, or a related field.

1. Communicate effectively while interacting directly with colleagues, clientele, and/or other internal or external constituencies in the planning of assignments and the resolution of day-to-day operational problems.

3. Undertake and/or participates in projects and programs designed to develop professional skills and expertise appropriate to the needs of the organization.


4. Participate in the planning and implementation of unit projects and initiatives within area of expertise and ability.


5. As specifically requested by management, conduct research and reporting inclusive of recommendations or alternative proposals for action.


6. Undertake related studies or enrichment programs as appropriate to the specific objectives of the operating unit.


7. Perform miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.

This position supports Medicare Advantage (MA) and Affordable Care Act (ACA) Risk Adjustment programs by taking ownership of assigned activities, identifying issues early, and driving timely completion. Working closely with the Manager of Risk Adjustment Operations, the analyst uses data, reporting, and coordination across internal teams and vendors to keep work moving, resolve operational issues, and recommend improvements. This role also supports continuous process improvement and development of standardized operational processes and documentation.

Responsibilities and Qualifications

  • Take ownership of assigned Medicare Advantage and ACA Risk Adjustment activities, managing milestones, regulatory deadlines, dependencies, and deliverables through completion.
  • Proactively identify gaps, delays, and emerging issues within assigned work; recommend next steps, coordinate resolution, and escalate barriers that require leadership involvement.

  • Analyze operational dashboards, KPIs, production metrics, and other reporting to identify trends, variances, potential risks, and opportunities for improvement. Prepare reports and summaries that explain findings and recommended actions
  • Coordinate activities across Analytics, Coding, Provider Engagement, Chart Retrieval, Actuarial, Compliance, and external vendor partners. Confirm responsibilities and timelines, follow up on commitments, and track outstanding items through completion.
  • Coordinate day-to-day EMR connectivity operations, including user access, access documentation, connectivity issues and issue resolution. Work with internal teams, provider practices, and external partners to support timely medical record retrieval.
  • Investigate operational issues by gathering supporting data, identifying root causes, and recommending practical solutions or process improvements.
  • Monitor vendor deliverables, production metrics, service-level expectations, and outstanding issues. Follow up on performance gaps and escalate unresolved concerns.

  • Facilitate assigned working meetings, prepare agendas and materials, document decisions and action items, and follow through with responsible stakeholders.
  • Perform additional operational analysis and other duties as assigned.

Skills:

  • Demonstrated initiative and ownership, including the ability to anticipate next steps, seek out needed information, and move assigned work forward without waiting for step-by-step direction.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret operational data, dashboards, and performance measures; investigate discrepancies; and recommend practical next steps.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to summarize findings, explain issues clearly, and facilitate productive working meetings.
  • Ability to build effective relationships and coordinate work across internal teams, external vendors and provider groups.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple assignments, shifting priorities, and deadlines in a faced paced environment.
  • Ability to work independently with the ability to manage multiple assignments, priorities, deadlines, and follow-up activities.
  • Strong organization skills and attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate project documentation, trackers, status reports, and operational records.

  • Experience with project management, workflow, or tracking applications preferred.

Knowledge:

  • General knowledge of healthcare operations and healthcare data.
  • Basic to working knowledge of Medicare Advantage and/or ACA Risk Adjustment required.
  • Understanding project management principles, operational workflows, documentation, and performance tracking.
  • Familiarity with Risk Adjustment processes such as medical record retrieval, coding, provider engagement, analytics, data submission, and vendor operations required.
  • Basic understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements within a healthcare environment.
  • Knowledge of data quality, operational controls, and continuous process improvement concepts preferred.
  • Basic working knowledge of Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems, connections, and functionality, including an understanding of user access, system navigation, medical record retrieval workflows, and common EMR access or connectivity issues.
  • Basic working knowledge of medical coding platforms and their functionality within Risk Adjustment operations.
  • Basic working knowledge of HCC diagnoses, Risk Adjustment coding concepts, and the role of clinical documentation in supporting accurate diagnosis capture.
  • Basic working knowledge of provider education and engagement related to Risk Adjustment, including documentation and coding education.

Experience:

  • Experience supporting projects involving multiple stakeholders, deliverables, and deadlines.

  • Experience coordinating meetings, documenting action items, and following up with internal or external stakeholders.

We recognize that work is a part of life, not separate from it, and foster a flexible environment where your health and wellbeing are prioritized. At Capital you will work alongside a caring team of supportive colleagues and be encouraged to volunteer in your community. We value your professional and personal growth by investing heavily in training and continuing education, so you have the tools to do your best as you develop your career. raw.title: HealthCare Medicare Advantage & ACA Risk Adjustment Program Specialist
raw.excerpt: Position Description Base pay is influenced by several factors including a candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, and anticipated contributions to meet the needs of the business, along with internal pay equity and external market-driven rates.
raw.description:
Position Description

Base pay is influenced by several factors including a candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, and anticipated contributions to meet the needs of the business, along with internal pay equity and external market-driven rates. The salary range displayed has not been adjusted for geographical location. This range has been created in good faith based on information known to Capital Blue Cross at the time of posting and may be modified in the future. Capital Blue Cross offers a comprehensive benefits packaging including Medical, Dental & Vision coverage, a Retirement Plan, generous time off including Paid Time Off, Holidays, and Volunteer time off, an Incentive Plan, Tuition Reimbursement, and more.

At Capital Blue Cross, we promise to go the extra mile for our team and our community. This promise is at the heart of our culture, and it’s why our employees consistently vote us one of the “Best Places to Work in PA.”

This position supports Medicare Advantage (MA) and Affordable Care Act (ACA) Risk Adjustment programs by taking ownership of assigned activities, identifying issues early, and driving timely completion. Working closely with the Manager of Risk Adjustment Operations, the analyst uses data, reporting, and coordination across internal teams and vendors to keep work moving, resolve operational issues, and recommend improvements. This role also supports continuous process improvement and development of standardized operational processes and documentation.

Responsibilities and Qualifications

  • Take ownership of assigned Medicare Advantage and ACA Risk Adjustment activities, managing milestones, regulatory deadlines, dependencies, and deliverables through completion.
  • Proactively identify gaps, delays, and emerging issues within assigned work; recommend next steps, coordinate resolution, and escalate barriers that require leadership involvement.
  • Maintain project plans, operational calendars, timelines, trackers, risk and issue logs, meeting documentation, and status reports to support the Manager in managing program priorities.
  • Analyze operational dashboards, KPIs, production metrics, and other reporting to identify trends, variances, potential risks, and opportunities for improvement. Prepare reports and summaries that explain findings and recommended actions
  • Coordinate activities across Analytics, Coding, Provider Engagement, Chart Retrieval, Actuarial, Compliance, and external vendor partners. Confirm responsibilities and timelines, follow up on commitments, and track outstanding items through completion.
  • Coordinate day-to-day EMR connectivity operations, including user access, access documentation, connectivity issues and issue resolution. Work with internal teams, provider practices, and external partners to support timely medical record retrieval.
  • Investigate operational issues by gathering supporting data, identifying root causes, and recommending practical solutions or process improvements.
  • Monitor vendor deliverables, production metrics, service-level expectations, and outstanding issues. Follow up on performance gaps and escalate unresolved concerns.
  • Coordinate assigned vendor implementations, onboarding and offboarding activities, including requirements tracking, documentation, testing, and readiness checks.
  • Contribute to vendor evaluations, Requests for Proposal (RFPs), Proofs of Concept (POCs), Statements of Work (SOWs), and procurement activities by gathering and organizing requirements, documentation, operational feedback, and supporting data.
  • Review project and vendor data for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and adherence to established operational requirements.
  • Maintain and improve program documentation, standard operating procedures, process maps, workflows, controls, project requirements, and other operational reference materials.
  • Facilitate assigned working meetings, prepare agendas and materials, document decisions and action items, and follow through with responsible stakeholders.
  • Perform additional operational analysis and other duties as assigned.

Skills:

  • Demonstrated initiative and ownership, including the ability to anticipate next steps, seek out needed information, and move assigned work forward without waiting for step-by-step direction.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret operational data, dashboards, and performance measures; investigate discrepancies; and recommend practical next steps.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to summarize findings, explain issues clearly, and facilitate productive working meetings.
  • Ability to build effective relationships and coordinate work across internal teams, external vendors and provider groups.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple assignments, shifting priorities, and deadlines in a faced paced environment.
  • Ability to work independently with the ability to manage multiple assignments, priorities, deadlines, and follow-up activities.
  • Strong organization skills and attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate project documentation, trackers, status reports, and operational records.
  • Adaptability and willingness to learn unfamiliar processes, escalate issues, ask thoughtful questions, and apply feedback.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.
  • Experience working with Power BI or other business intelligence/reporting tools preferred.
  • Experience with project management, workflow, or tracking applications preferred.

Knowledge:

  • General knowledge of healthcare operations and healthcare data.
  • Basic to working knowledge of Medicare Advantage and/or ACA Risk Adjustment required.
  • Understanding project management principles, operational workflows, documentation, and performance tracking.
  • Familiarity with Risk Adjustment processes such as medical record retrieval, coding, provider engagement, analytics, data submission, and vendor operations required.
  • Basic understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements within a healthcare environment.
  • Knowledge of data quality, operational controls, and continuous process improvement concepts preferred.
  • Basic working knowledge of Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems, connections, and functionality, including an understanding of user access, system navigation, medical record retrieval workflows, and common EMR access or connectivity issues.
  • Basic working knowledge of medical coding platforms and their functionality within Risk Adjustment operations.
  • Basic working knowledge of HCC diagnoses, Risk Adjustment coding concepts, and the role of clinical documentation in supporting accurate diagnosis capture.
  • Basic working knowledge of provider education and engagement related to Risk Adjustment, including documentation and coding education.

Experience:

  • Two to three years of experience in healthcare operations, project coordination, program support, business analysis, data analysis, Risk Adjustment, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting projects involving multiple stakeholders, deliverables, and deadlines.
  • Experience preparing or maintaining operational reports, production plans, project trackers, dashboards, or performance metrics.
  • Experience analyzing data or operational information to identify discrepancies, risks, or trends.
  • Experience coordinating meetings, documenting action items, and following up with internal or external stakeholders.
  • Experience working with healthcare vendors or supporting vendor-related activities preferred.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Health Information Management, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field preferred.
  • Relevant healthcare, Risk Adjustment operations, project management, or analytical experience may be considered in lieu of a degree, depending on organizational requirements.
  • Lean Six Sigma, CAPM, or other project management/process improvement training or certification preferred but not required.

About Us

We recognize that work is a part of life, not separate from it, and foster a flexible environment where your health and wellbeing are prioritized. At Capital you will work alongside a caring team of supportive colleagues and be encouraged to volunteer in your community. We value your professional and personal growth by investing heavily in training and continuing education, so you have the tools to do your best as you develop your career. And by doing your best, you’ll help us live our mission of improving the health and well-being of our members and the communities in which they live.

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Job Description

We are seeking an innovative and passionate Engagement Delivery Senior Manager (Senior Project Manager) for our Professional Services team who shares our vision of bringing the power of cloud computing to enterprises. Engagement Delivery Managers are responsible for overseeing our teams to drive successful customer outcomes with our implementations. They manage and run more complex, enterprise and strategic projects. Our Engagement Delivery Managers actively participate on the project, scoping, contracts review, knowledge transfer, and budget management.


Your Impact:

  • Serve as the overall Leader of the project team and exhibit excellent leadership skills in forming a team, ensuring strong communication channels, giving clarity, motivation and direction to the team throughout the engagement.
  • Be the primary customer interface and perform project management activities that ensures adherence to Salesforce methodology and project gates and governance.
  • Build and lead project plans; supervise and review project progress and timelines; adjust schedules and plans as needed; ensure on time and on budget delivery of projects and identify and resolve issues to ensure project success.
  • Drive teams through the Software engineering experience using Agile and demonstrated analytical and technical skills.
  • Supervise utilization of project resources in alignment with resource allocation and budget. This includes on time entry and approvals for project timesheets.
  • Able to lead one or two large projects or programs, or a couple of small to medium sized interrelated projects requiring complex cross-functional teamwork and management at the program level.
  • Anticipate and remove obstacles that slow down or prevent teams from delivering on project goals.
  • Facilitate requirements gathering and assist with crafting project deliverables, and Salesforce documentation as needed.
  • Being an extension to the account team to extend the Salesforce footprint.
  • Participate in end to end implementation planning including project management, risk & issue management, communication and business organizational change.
  • Facilitate User Acceptance Testing with business end users including coordination and user acceptance sign-off.

Basic qualifications:

  • Proven experience in Project Management, including experience handling external client projects.
  • Ability to balance the business and technical requirements to produce a project plan and collaborate to acquire the information, such as estimates, as input to the project plan.
  • Ability to lead enterprise-wide engagements, facilitate meetings with client executives, mentor teams of senior team members, and proactively run project risk ability to weigh business and technical requirements to identify dependencies, produce project plans and estimates.
  • Demonstrated project management skills, with direct responsibility for leading project teams of 20+ members, as well as managing budgets and schedules.
  • Demonstrated ability to have difficult conversations.

Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec la coordination de la migration, les architectes, les développeurs front-end, les Data Engineers, les responsables de la gouvernance des données et le manager.   • Formaliser les standards, les méthodes et les bonnes pratiques du projet.

  • Contribuer à la montée en compétences des profils Front-End, Back-End, des architectes et des responsables de la gouvernance des données.

raw.description:
EHS Support is a specialty environmental consulting firm that provides solutions to complex environmental, health, and safety challenges across a range of market sectors and industries. With experts located throughout the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, and South Africa, we form long-lasting partnerships with our clients through a culture of excellence, innovation, work ethic, and integrity. We focus on hiring and retaining talented, motivated people who enjoy collaborating with and delivering value to our clients. Our team does more than identify problems— we provide solutions.

Location: Remote, must reside in one of the following states: MA, CT, NY, NJ, PA, RI, DE, MD, NH, VT

This Wetland Scientist opportunity is for a flexible and self-motivated individual that is willing to learn and grow as part of a team while providing wetlands and permitting expertise to projects within the Sediment and Risk Assessment (SRA) and Remediation (REM) service lines at EHS Support. As a Wetland Scientist, you will be joining a high-performance team of risk assessors, toxicologists, ecologists, scientists, and engineers that is focused on providing high-quality technical and strategic solutions to a variety of clients. Your primary responsibilities in the Wetland Scientist position will include assisting EHS Support’s wetland and waterways capabilities, including wetlands assessment, delineation, permitting, and restoration services. You will also be responsible for engaging in technical writing for development and delivery of technical reports or other regulatory submittals at the federal, state, and local levels to report findings for routine and complex sites.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Support development of federal, state, and local regulatory permitting processes to obtain authorization for construction and environmental remediation activities that may impact wetlands, waterways, or other regulated natural resources.
  • Ability to travel to project locations throughout the U.S.
  • Perform surveys in outdoor environments that require carrying equipment through forested areas.
  • Lead assessment, delineation, and classification of wetlands, waterways, or other regulated natural resources.
  • Support efficient and compliant permitting paths, develop required permit applications, and assist in coordination with regulatory agencies through permit application approval.
  • Provide occasional technical support to projects focused on ecological risk assessment, sediment assessment and remediation, biodiversity and ecological services, Natural Resource Damage Assessment (NRDA), and water quality compliance.
  • Obtaining, organizing, reviewing, and synthesizing environmental data in an organized and concise manner.
  • Engaging in technical writing to report findings to support investigation objectives.
  • Supporting the preparation of high-quality technical deliverables, reports, and presentations.
  • Planning and conducting field investigations as a lead to collect hydrologic, hydric soil, hydrophytic vegetation, and stream assessment data in support of wetland and surface water delineation surveys.
  • Prepare technical reports and supporting documentation for jurisdictional determination requests and assist with the development of permit application packages for federal, state, and local regulatory agencies.
  • Documenting field observations and recording necessary data to support multi-media field programs.
  • Ensuring field work is conducted in accordance with relevant investigation work plans and in accordance with prescribed standard operating procedures (SOPs) and wetland delineation methodologies and reporting.
  • Communicating (both written and verbal) the findings of data analyses and interpretation to both lay and technical audiences.

Specific Experience and Skills

  • 1-3 years of experience in environmental consulting, with a focus in freshwater and coastal wetlands assessment and permitting (NJ, NY, and PA experience preferred).
  • Experienced in independently performing wetland and surface water delineations consistent with wetland delineation manual standards for Northcentral and Northeast Region, including field data collection, survey documentation, preparation of Wetland Determination Data Forms and Ordinary High Water Mark Field Identification Data Sheets, aquatic resource mapping, and wetland functional assessments.
  • Ability to support and implement field investigations in wetland and surface water delineations, wetland function and value assessment, habitat assessment, and technical writing experience with Section 404, Section 10, Section 401 WQC, and state wetland permitting programs.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail and data quality.
  • Proficiency or understanding of Geographic Information Systems (GIS), global positioning system (GPS) units (e.g., Trimble) and other field monitoring equipment (e.g., multi-parameter water quality monitors, data logging instrumentation).
  • Ability to develop and maintain positive relationships with clients and co-workers.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • An understanding of environmental regulations and guidance under state wetland programs, and Northcentral and Northeast Region federal programs (e.g., RCRA, CERCLA, and CWA).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills.

Education and Licenses

  • Bachelors with 1-3 years of experience or a Masters degree in biology, ecology, environmental science, natural resources or a related field.

Benefits

  • Generous Vacation Policy
  • Health Benefits (medical, dental, vision)
  • 401k w/matching options
  • Short- & Long-Term Disability
  • Life Insurance
  • Sick Time
  • Bonus Opportunities

Our Principles

  • Strive for excellence, always
  • Be open, honest, and direct
  • Assume good intentions
  • Trust coworkers, leadership, and clients
  • Listen to learn
  • Be accountable for our work
  • Foster teamwork
  • Demonstrate integrity
  • Take pride in one’s work
  • Live your personal values
  • Provide a safe and health work environment that promotes wellness
  • Have fun!

Our renewables sector focuses on solar, wind and battery storage. Sustainability and safety are foundational to our culture and influence everything we do.

MasTec, a minority-owned Fortune 500 company, has shaped the construction industry for more than 90 years. With over 35,000 employees and 400 offices nationwide, we provide flexibility and career growth in dynamic work environments.

raw.title: Product Support Engineer
raw.excerpt: About Snowplow Snowplow is the real-time customer context layer that collects, validates, enriches, and delivers behavioral data for advanced analytics, ML, and AI agent decisioning.
raw.description:
About Snowplow

Snowplow is the real-time customer context layer that collects, validates, enriches, and delivers behavioral data for advanced analytics, ML, and AI agent decisioning. Snowplow’s event tracking is leveraged across 2M+ websites and applications globally, processing over one trillion events per month.


More than 250 companies, including Experian, AutoTrader, Strava, Condé Nast, and HelloFresh, rely on Snowplow to build a well-governed, first-party data foundation that powers their customer-facing AI agents, in-session personalization and recommendations, and real-time analytics.


How we work

  • High agency. When you see a problem or an opportunity we’re missing, you act on it. Managers build alongside their teams.

  • Make it count. Every piece of work points at a goal that matters, with a number that shows whether it’s working.

  • Move fast. We work at the pace AI makes possible and improve as we go, except where customers trust us with their data, service, security and contracts. Those we get right the first time.

  • Challenge, and be open to challenge. Say what you think, with evidence, to the person who can act on it, and expect the same back.


This Opportunity

Support is the first place a product problem shows up. When a pipeline fails, a loader misbehaves, or a customer’s cloud setup hits a limit, we see it first. Snowplow runs and monitors event pipelines inside customer-owned AWS, GCP, and Azure accounts, many processing billions of events a month, and products like Snowplow Signals raise the bar again. Product and Engineering need that front-line signal in a form they can act on, and customers need someone who can go deep on the infrastructure underneath.


That’s the Product Support Engineer. It’s one of two specialist tracks we’re building inside Support. Everyone on the team keeps our 24x7 service running, so roughly 75-80% of your time is core support: first response against our SLAs, technical cases, and incident management. The other 20-25% is your focus, which is product and infrastructure. You’ll be Support’s link to Product and Engineering, and the team’s go-to for the infrastructure side of hard cases. In APAC, you’ll be the infrastructure specialist on a small team.


We’re also changing how Support works. We build our own agents and automations, use AI to investigate and resolve cases faster, and look for repetitive work a well-designed tool can take off our plates. It’s how we plan to scale a highly technical, 24x7 team without lowering the quality of help our customers get.


What you will own

Core support (roughly 75-80% of your time)

  • Technical cases from start to finish. Investigate and resolve pipeline failures, failed events, enrichment and schema issues, and loader and warehouse problems, and escalate the hardest ones with a diagnosis, not just a symptom.

  • The customer relationship during an incident. Keep customers informed with clear, honest updates when their data is at stake, and work with Engineering to restore service.

  • AI in your everyday toolkit. Use AI assistants and agents to investigate issues, analyze logs and data, and draft responses, while keeping your own judgment on accuracy and customer impact.

Product and infrastructure focus (roughly 20-25% of your time)

  • Product liaison. Be Support’s voice to Product and Engineering for your area. Spot patterns across cases and bring them in as evidence-backed bug reports and enhancement requests, then follow them through.

  • Roadmap input. Show where a product gap is costing a customer or holding back an expansion, so Product can weigh commercial impact alongside engineering effort.

  • Infrastructure depth. Go deep on the cloud infrastructure our pipelines run on in customer accounts: networking, permissions, infrastructure as code, scaling, and failure modes. Become the person the team asks.

  • Ops resilience. Build the feedback loop that keeps our managed service lights on 24x7. Turn what incidents teach us into better monitoring, alerting, and runbooks, so the same problem doesn’t catch us twice.

  • Diagnosis, not just escalation. Reproduce issues, read the code, and hand Engineering a diagnosis. Then see the fix through to the customer.

  • Building the tools you wish you had. Spot repetitive work and ship the fix, whether that’s a script, an automation, a prompt workflow, or an improvement to our internal AI agents. Document it and demo it so others can adopt it.

  • Knowledge that scales. Write runbooks and knowledge base articles for infrastructure and product issues that serve both people and the AI tools that draw on them.


We would love to hear from you if you have

  • Grounding in technical support. Experience in technical support, support engineering, or a customer-facing engineering role, ideally for a B2B SaaS or data infrastructure product.

  • Infrastructure fluency. Hands-on experience with AWS or GCP (Azure is a plus). You can find your way around logs, permissions, networking, and managed services without needing a guide.

  • Strong troubleshooting instincts. You can take an ambiguous, unfamiliar problem, break it down methodically, and narrow it to a root cause.

  • Comfort with code and SQL. You can read and debug JavaScript and at least one other language, and query large datasets to investigate data quality questions.

  • Real fluency with AI tools. You use LLMs and AI coding or agent tools every day, and you know where they work well and where they get things wrong.

  • A builder’s instinct. You’ve automated part of your own workflow or your team’s, and you can show us what you built and explain why.

  • Bug reports engineers act on. You write clearly and precisely, and explain complex technical issues to engineers and non-technical stakeholders alike.

  • Calm under pressure. You can prioritize when several things are urgent, stay steady during incidents, and know when to escalate.

  • A share-by-default attitude. You document, demo, and teach.

  • Availability for our coverage window. Monday to Friday, approximately 8am–5pm local time in AU, exact hours TBD


Bonus points for

  • Infrastructure as code experience

  • Experience with event data, analytics pipelines, or customer data infrastructure

  • Familiarity with Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or dbt

  • Experience building with LLM APIs, agent frameworks, or MCP-style tool integrations


Where this role can take you

The Product Support Engineer track grows toward Engineering and Product roles. Moving between our two tracks later stays open as an internal move.


We know some of you will read this and think you need to tick every box before applying. You don’t. We value diversity and hire for potential as much as for experience. If you think you can help solve our challenges, we’d love to hear from you.


What you get in return for being awesome

  • Meaningful equity stake

  • Competitive Base Salary

  • Flexible working

  • Generous PTO

  • MacBook and home office equipment allowance

Role Overview


We’re looking for a Staff DevOps Engineer to own the infrastructure, delivery pipelines, and reliability tooling behind our exchange and trading platform. You’ll build and run the cloud foundation that keeps a low-latency, regulated, always-on market available, and make it faster and safer for engineers to ship. You’ll work closely with backend, security, and compliance partners, and you’ll have real ownership from day one.

What You’ll Own

  • Design, build, and operate our AWS infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent) across production, staging, and development environments.
  • Run and scale our Kubernetes platform, including cluster upgrades, autoscaling, networking, and cost management.
  • Own CI/CD end to end: fast, reliable build, test, and deploy pipelines with safe rollout strategies (canary, blue/green) and quick rollback.
  • Build observability for the exchange: metrics, logging, tracing, dashboards, and actionable alerting tied to SLOs for latency and availability.
  • Operate and tune supporting infrastructure for our event-driven systems, including Kafka, databases, caches, and WebSocket edge services.
  • Participate in on-call, lead incident response, and run blameless postmortems that lead to durable fixes.
  • Partner with security and compliance on access controls, secrets management, audit logging, vulnerability management, and disaster recovery that meet CFTC-regulated expectations.
  • Plan capacity and performance testing ahead of high-volume sports events, and automate away toil.
  • Document runbooks and share knowledge so the whole engineering team can operate with confidence.

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering experience running production systems at scale
  • Deep hands-on expertise with AWS (or equivalent), including networking, IAM, compute, and managed data services
  • Strong Kubernetes and Docker experience in production, including cluster operations and troubleshooting
  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform strongly preferred) and configuration management, with GitOps-style workflows
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines at scale (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, or similar)
  • Strong observability skills: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, or comparable tooling, plus SLO-driven alerting
  • Solid scripting or programming ability in Go or Python (Go preferred) and comfort with Linux and networking fundamentals
  • Experience operating Kafka, SQL and NoSQL databases, and low-latency, real-time services in production
  • Experience with incident management, on-call, and blameless postmortems
  • Working knowledge of security best practices: secrets management, least-privilege access, vulnerability scanning, and audit logging
  • Experience in trading, exchange, fintech, or other high-throughput regulated systems is strongly preferred
  • Strong communicator who can explain complex tradeoffs to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Proactive, growth-focused, and highly adaptable with a strong sense of ownership
Nice to Have
  • Experience in prediction markets, sports betting, or regulated exchanges (CFTC or similar)
  • Familiarity with risk, fraud, KYC/AML, or settlement systems
  • Experience scaling a team through hiring and growth in a startup environment

Why Join Us!

Compensation & Ownership
  • Competitive compensation aligned to role and market
  • Equity opportunities so you share in what we’re building
  • A clear connection between impact and reward
Health & Wellbeing
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Flexible time off built on trust and accountability
  • A culture that respects your time and avoids unnecessary meetings
Remote & Flexible Work
  • Fully remote within the U.S.
  • Flexibility to work in the way that helps you do your best work
The Role
  • Own the cloud infrastructure, delivery pipelines, and reliability tooling behind the real-time, high-throughput systems at the core of America’s first sports-native, CFTC-regulated prediction market
  • Take on a hands-on technical leadership role with real influence over architecture, platform standards, and how engineering ships and operates software safely at speed
  • Help scale a live, regulated exchange as prediction markets grow into America’s next great asset class

Description

We seek a system-level thinker and Senior Software Developer (5+ years) to design scalable, secure, and maintainable software that stands the test of time.

Are you passionate about crafting robust systems, improving engineering standards, and mentoring others? Do you know how to turn business needs into architecture and high-quality code—without over-engineering? We’re looking for someone who can partner across teams, make sound architectural decisions, and guide the team toward reliable, high-performance solutions.

This isn’t just about writing code. It’s about engineering systems, leading by example, and elevating quality across the stack. You’ll shape solutions end‑to‑end—designing APIs and data models, optimizing performance, and ensuring we build for long-term sustainability.

What you bring

·5+ years of hands‑on software development, operating at system level

·Deep understanding of SOLID, Clean Architecture, domain separation, dependency inversion, and GoF patterns

·Strong data design and performance tuning experience

·Proven experience with microservices and cloud design patterns

·Clear communicator who can translate business needs into technical designs and explain trade‑offs

What you’ll do

Scope & Impact

·Own end-to-end technical outcomes for services/systems

·Drive architectural decisions, system decomposition, and integration patterns

·Improve performance, reliability, security, and developer experience

·Anticipate risks, manage trade-offs, and reduce technical debt strategically

Core Technical Competencies

Advanced Application Development

·Architect and build complex systems in .NET (C#)

·Design scalable and secure REST APIs

·Implement advanced frontend architecture in Angular or React

·Optimize performance (async programming, concurrency handling, caching)

·Identify, prioritize, and eliminate technical debt
Mindset: Think in terms of maintainability and long-term evolution.

Architecture & Design Mastery

·Apply SOLID (advanced), Clean Architecture, domain separation, and dependency inversion

·Expert application of GoF patterns

·Design for microservices and apply cloud‑native patterns (resilience, messaging, scalability)

Data Strategy

·Design relational database schemas (MS SQL, PostgreSQL)

·Optimise indexing, performance, transactions, and concurrency

·Implement polyglot persistence (including Cosmos DB for NoSQL) where appropriate

·Use Entity Framework efficiently and design file storage lifecycles (Azure Blob / AWS S3)
Accountability: Performance and scalability at the data layer.

Cloud Architecture & DevOps

·Hands-on with Azure (App Services, Functions, Service Bus, Blob, Cosmos DB) and/or AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda)

·Design deployment strategies; define CI/CD pipelines (nice to have/lead when needed)

·Implement monitoring/observability and logging strategies

·Design scalable, cost-aware cloud infrastructure

Security & Performance Leadership

·Design authentication & authorization flows (OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT)

·Apply secure coding standards and anticipate vulnerabilities

·Optimize high‑load systems; implement effective caching strategies

Engineering Standards & Technical Leadership

·Lead code reviews and establish Git workflows

·Set logging, error handling, and operational standards

·Provide reliable estimations and delivery plans

·Mentor and coach junior/mid developers; lead technical discussions

·Protect architecture integrity and align solutions with strategic goals

Non-Technical Competencies

System Ownership

·Takes end-to-end responsibility for services/systems

·Anticipates risks and makes sound decisions under pressure

Mentoring & Leadership

·Coaches, pairs, and grows the team’s technical capabilities

·Facilitates design sessions and drives engineering improvements

Strategic Thinking

·Identifies technical debt and proposes pragmatic remediation

·Balances business priorities with long-term technical health

Communication

·Translates business requirements into clear technical designs

·Challenges ambiguity and communicates trade-offs and rationale clearly

Success Indicators (Examples)

·Systems meet SLOs for performance, reliability, and cost

·Clear architectural artefacts and standards adopted across the team

·Reduced incident frequency and faster MTTR through good observability

·Junior/mid engineers consistently level up through your mentorship

·Technical debt is visible, prioritized, and reduced with measurable impact

Signs You’re Ready for Next Level (Staff/Principal Track)

·You lead multi-system initiatives and cross-team architecture

·You drive platform strategy and organisation-wide standards

·You influence product strategy through technical vision and data

If you want to build systems that scale—and help others level up while you’re at it—we’d love to talk.

Who we are

Init is a group of software and automation companies offering sustainable, innovative, and long-term solutions to various Nordic and worldwide industries. Init was established in January 2022 by 17 companies joining forces. Today, it has over 900 highly qualified employees in Denmark, Sweden, Norway, North Macedonia, UK and Spain.

At Init, we focus on people, and as a people-first company, we see it as our most important task to help and support talented people by offering some of the most exciting challenges in the industry. We emphasise providing you with a fun, safe and inclusive working environment so you may feel a burning desire to come to work every day. In short, we do everything possible to make Init a positive part of your life. Our motto is "We are Init together." This applies when we collaborate with colleagues to make Init an attractive workplace and with customers to shape the future within automation and IT.
