raw.title: Lead DevOps Engineer
raw.excerpt: We Also Walk Dogs needs you to help our clients win fights to make the world a better place.
raw.description:
We Also Walk Dogs needs you to help our clients win fights to make the world a better place.

Our product, ActionKit (actionk.it), is used by dozens of major progressive groups and not-for-profits to stay in touch with tens of millions of online supporters. Our clients use ActionKit to fight climate change, push back against corporate power and more.

We've already begun moving our stack from on-premises servers to AWS, and need a DevOps engineer to help us take that effort to the next level. If you'd like to work at the intersection of cool cloud tech and making a better world, this is the job for you.

ActionKit is built by We Also Walk Dogs. Named after a Robert Heinlein story about a company that specialized in solving impossible problems, We Also Walk Dogs has spent over a decade serving online progressive organizations and charities. We're a small, friendly, and clever company. And we all work remotely.

Is this the job for you?

  • Do you keep production systems running? According to our external monitoring, we've kept 99.98% uptime this past year, and gone three months without downtime, while very actively working on the product. We need someone with the expertise and discipline to help us keep that going.
  • Do you think in the cloud? After starting with a fully on-premises deployment, today we're serving millions of end-users from AWS. But we know that intelligently deploying new tools and cloud capabilities can help us do things we could never do with just a rack of servers, and we need a DevOps engineer who can take us there.
  • Can you can wear a lot of hats? We're a small company and not much for bureaucratic divisions. The boss codes; the project manager gives sales demos; most everyone, including you, does a shift of at least a few hours each week answering our clients' support tickets.

If this sounds like you, please apply!

Must haves:

  • You need to care about maintaining a high-quality deployment. We've kept our uptime record with solid automation and monitoring, jumping on oddities before they become problems, and digging into root causes when things go wrong. We need you to be able to continue that tradition.
  • You need vision as well as execution. We need you to not only keep things running smoothly, but also help lead us where we need to go next. You need expertise in modern tools and AWS capabilities, and a strategic sense of how we can use them for efficiency, manageability, performance, and reliability.
  • You need to be in touch with others' needs. We're a small, tight-knit crew where everyone pitches in. Empathy with clients and end-users is also core to our business. Everyone on the team works directly with clients.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience working with all-remote teams.
  • Experience with Django, MySQL, and Ansible.
  • Experience with AWS features and patterns like VPCs, ELBs, SQS, auto-scaling groups, multi-zone deployments, and so on.
  • That said, experience with our stack is maybe the least important factor here; Even if you've used Rails instead of Django, Postgres instead of MySQL, or Azure instead of AWS, we want to hear from you.

Why work for us?

  • Competitive salary. We are a self-funded, for-profit company.
  • Remote work. Hours and location are flexible as long as you get the work done. In this day and age you shouldn't have to relocate to San Francisco for awesome work.
  • Four weeks paid time off. We encourage you to take vacation; we are not the sort of workplace that pressures anyone into 60-hour weeks.
  • A free, great health insurance policy and 401(k)
  • Work with an awesome team for awesome causes.

raw.description:
About WebEngage:

WebEngage is an enterprise-grade customer engagement and retention platform that helps global brands across industries such as e-commerce, fintech, travel, edtech, gaming, media, and consumer apps. and turn data into measurable revenue impact. Trusted by 800+ brands globally, we have strong presence in India, UAE, KSA, SEA, Europe and beyond. WebEngage powers intelligent, real-time engagement across the entire customer lifecycle.
  • We are built for scale.
  • We are built for complexity.
  • We are built for outcomes.
At our core, WebEngage is a full-stack retention operating system that combines:
  • A powerful Customer Data Platform (CDP)
  • Real-time behavioral segmentation and intelligence
  • Omnichannel journey orchestration
  • AI-driven personalization and recommendations
  • Deep analytics, experimentation, and revenue attribution
  • WebEngage BLACK: our AI-native layer that brings Agentic capabilities to engagement.
Learn more about us at www.webengage.com

About The Role:

WebEngage’s Data Engineering team is the backbone of our analytics, personalisation, and machine-learning capabilities. As a Data Engineer, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of data — from ingesting raw event streams and third-party feeds to building well-modelled, highly reliable datasets that power dashboards, predictive models, and customer journey orchestration. This is a high-impact, hands-on role where you will work at the intersection of product, analytics, and backend engineering. You will be expected to think beyond just moving data — designing for data quality, pipeline observability, cost efficiency, and long-term maintainability from day one.

Responsibilities:

Pipeline Development & Reliability

  • Design, build, and maintain production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from APIs, databases, event streams (Kafka/Pub-Sub), and flat files into the central data warehouse.
  • Implement idempotent, incremental load patterns with built-in retry logic, dead-letter queues, and SLA-based alerting to ensure zero-data-loss pipelines.
  • Own pipeline observability — set up data freshness checks, row-count validations, schema drift detection, and anomaly alerts using tools like Great Expectations or dbt tests.

Data Modelling & Warehouse Design

  • Translate business requirements into clean dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas) and maintain a well-documented data catalogue.
  • Design slowly changing dimensions (SCD Type 1/2), bridge tables, and fact tables optimised for analytical query patterns.
  • Enforce partitioning, clustering, and materialised view strategies to keep warehouse costs under control while maintaining sub-second query performance.

Code Quality & Engineering Best Practices

  • Write clean, modular, well-tested Python and SQL code. Follow DRY principles, use version control (Git), and participate in peer code reviews.
  • Build reusable transformation frameworks using dbt or equivalent tooling, with proper documentation and testing at every layer (staging → intermediate → mart).
  • Containerise data services with Docker and automate deployments via CI/CD pipelines (GitHub
Actions / GitLab CI).

BI, Visualization & Analytics

  • Build interactive dashboards and analytical tools using Streamlit, enabling stakeholders to explore metrics, run ad-hoc analyses, and make data-driven decisions without engineering dependency.
  • Design and maintain BI layers — semantic models, KPI definitions, and pre-aggregated mart tables that serve as the single source of truth for reporting across teams.
  • Translate raw data into compelling visual narratives using libraries like Plotly, Matplotlib, or Altair; present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner with product managers, analysts, and data scientists to understand data needs and proactively identify gaps in current data coverage.
  • Document data lineage, transformation logic, SLAs, and known limitations in a shared knowledge base to enable self-service analytics.
  • Contribute to internal engineering guilds, knowledge-sharing sessions, and post-incident reviews for pipeline failures.

Requirements:

  • Strong SQL skills with expertise in complex queries, performance optimization, and cost-efficient design on cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Redshift).
  • Strong Python scripting for data ingestion, transformation, and validation, with hands-on experience in Pandas, SQLAlchemy, APIs, and automation.
  • ETL/ELT- End-to-end ownership of data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, and loading, with understanding of incremental loads, and backfills.
  • Data Modelling- Ability to design dimensional and transactional data models (star/snowflake, SCDs) and translate business needs into optimized table structures.

Good to Have:

  • Airflow, dbt, Docker, CI/CD
  • GCP/AWS, data warehousing concepts
  • BI tools / Streamlit / visualization

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 1–3 years of professional experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a backend role with significant data pipeline work.
  • Strong understanding of data warehouse architecture — know when to use wide denormalised tables vs. normalised models, and the trade-offs of each.
  • Familiarity with version control workflows (Git branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews) and agile development practices.
  • A data quality mindset — you instinctively validate assumptions, add assertions to pipelines, and treat silent data failures as critical incidents.

Life at WebEngage:

  • We take transparency very seriously. Along with a full view of team goals, get a top-level view across the board with our monthly & quarterly town hall meetings.
  • A highly inclusive work culture that promotes a relaxed, creative and productive environment.
  • Practice autonomy, open communication, growth opportunities,while maintaining a perfect work-life balance

Perks & Benefits:

  • Learning is a way of life. Unlock your full potential backed with cutting-edge tools and mentorship (Macbook for Engagers!)
  • Get the best in class medical insurance (with Covid Care facilities), programs for taking care of your mental health, and a Contemporary Leave Policy (beyond sick leaves)

Offers a single dashboard solution to consumer companies to unify and analyse their customer data, engage with customers across multiple channels and personalise every message including in-line content on the web / mobile apps. We work with thousands of brands worldwide, across industries like E-Commerce, Edtech, Fintech, Foodtech, Media & Publications, Gaming, BFSI, Healthcare, and Online Retail.

One of the hottest global SaaS companies, we've been recognized by G2 as a Marketing Automation Leader in Asia 2021. A battle hardened team, accessible founders and a resilient culture of sustainable growth with no shortcuts. A somewhat uncommon, in-the-ring view of building a company to last.

Learn more about us at www.webengage.com

raw.description:
Convex US is seeking a dynamic, production-focused Vice President – Underwriter to lead day-to-day account underwriting, risk selection, and business production within our Accident & Health (A&H) line of business, focusing specifically on the Transportation/Trucking and Gig Worker verticals. This role is focused on driving profitable premium growth, expanding our market footprint, and delivering tailored A&H insurance solutions to meet industry-specific needs. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical underwriting capabilities, advanced risk analysis, and established wholesale and retail broker networks to write profitable business efficiently. This role will be measured on achieving production targets, submission flow, renewal retention, and overall portfolio profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Business Production & Sales Execution
  • Drive individual deal production by proactively identifying, quoting, and closing new business opportunities in the transportation and gig worker sectors.
  • Execute an actionable distribution strategy alongside the Head of A&H to expand retail and wholesale producer channels, hit target written premium goals, and grow market share.
  • Build, maintain, and leverage direct relationships with key brokers, agents, and market partners.
  • Deliver responsive turnaround times on submissions, RFPs, and broker inquiries to win accounts in a competitive environment.
Technical Underwriting & Risk Management
  • Analyze, structure, and underwrite complex Accident & Health risks across the transportation and gig worker verticals within established authority guidelines.
  • Utilize advanced risk evaluation techniques, actuarial insights, and pricing models to determine appropriate terms, conditions, and rate structures.
  • Conduct day-to-day portfolio oversight, monitoring account performance, loss ratios, and exposure trends to ensure long-term profitability.
  • Enforce underwriting standards, regulatory compliance, and risk controls across all bound accounts.
Product Execution & Portfolio Development
  • Partner with actuarial, legal, and product teams to translate market demand into actionable policy forms, coverage extensions, and specialized A&H solutions.
  • Continually refine underwriting guidelines, policy wordings, and rating tools based on competitive feedback and real-world deal outcomes.
  • Track submission pipelines, hit ratios, and renewal rates to maximize deal conversion.
Broker & Market Engagement
  • Represent Convex US at industry conferences, broker meetings, and market events to generate leads and elevate brand visibility.
  • Maintain active market awareness regarding competitor pricing, product changes, and regulatory updates to optimize risk selection.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • 10+ years of hands-on A&H business production or relevant underwriting experience, with specialized expertise in transportation and/or gig economy verticals.
  • Demonstrated history of generating new written premium and executing sales plans through wholesale and retail distribution channels.
  • Comprehensive understanding of A&H risk evaluation, policy drafting, rating mechanics, and industry regulations.
  • Strong emotional intelligence, exceptional customer service standards, and proven ability to negotiate and collaborate with wholesale brokers and internal partners.
  • Tech-savvy and highly organized, comfortable working with data, web-based underwriting portals, digital filing platforms, and MS Office.
  • Practical problem solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment and reliably delivers quality work under tight submission deadlines.
  • Asks probing questions, evaluates data critically, and solves complex underwriting challenges with sound judgment.

Atos is the Atos Group brand dedicated to AI-powered, secure, end-to-end digital services. Atos designs, develops, and operates critical digital environments that drive performance, resilience and sovereignty, helping public and private organizations worldwide retain control over their data and infrastructures, while meeting regulatory requirements.

With more than 52,000 employees serving over 4,500 clients across 54 countries, Atos helps modernize core IT systems, accelerate cloud and data transformation, strengthen cybersecurity, and deliver secure digital workplace environments to support its clients, its employees and society. Atos also provides consulting and advisory services through its Atos Amplify brand.
A trusted partner in operating complex and mission-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts.

About Atos Group

Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 54,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion, operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is listed on Euronext Paris.

About Our Team

Our egineering team brings together experienced engineers, diverse perspectives, and a flat team structure that enables visibility and impact from day one. With 40–50 professionals across the practice, we deliver some of the most exciting projects in the market — from next‑generation fintech payment platforms to global insurance systems deployed across multiple countries.

The role requires Security Clearance or ability to get SC in short timescales.

About the Role

The Lead Platform Engineer is responsible for the design, delivery and operation of enterprise platforms supporting major client transformation programmes.

Acting as both a technical leader and trusted client advisor, the role combines hands-on engineering, people leadership and customer engagement. The successful candidate will work directly with client stakeholders, architects and programme teams to ensure platform solutions are secure, scalable and aligned to business outcomes.

Where Purpose Meets Career

Platform Engineering & Cloud Technology
This role offers the opportunity to work across a modern technology landscape, including cloud platforms, infrastructure as code, DevOps toolchains, observability, security, and automation technologies. You will help shape platform capabilities that accelerate software delivery, improve reliability, and enhance the developer experience. Working alongside highly skilled engineers and architects, you will continuously expand your expertise while selecting and implementing the most appropriate technologies and platform patterns to solve complex business and technical challenges.

Contribute to diverse and meaningful projects
From automating government client systems and delivering large‑scale platform migrations, to applying AI to enhance our products — including next‑generation fintech payment platforms and global insurance systems deployed across multiple countries.

Culture
Our culture is built by people who genuinely love technology. We value curiosity, collaboration, and continuous learning, and we actively support innovation and knowledge sharing.

Key Responsibilities
• Lead the design and delivery of cloud and platform solutions for major client programmes.
• Build trusted relationships with client technical and delivery stakeholders.
• Act as the senior platform engineering representative in client meetings, workshops and governance forums.
• Provide technical leadership during discovery, architecture, mobilisation and delivery phases.
• Lead and mentor a team of platform engineers.
• Define platform standards, engineering patterns and operational best practices.
• Drive automation through Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD pipelines.
• Ensure platforms are secure, resilient and compliant with client and regulatory requirements.
• Support solution development, estimates, bid responses and technical assurance activities.
• Collaborate with architects, engineering teams and programme leaders to resolve complex technical challenges.
• Act as the escalation point for critical platform and infrastructure issues.
• Drive continuous improvement, cost optimisation and operational excellence.

Essential Skills & Experience
• Significant experience delivering cloud and platform solutions within complex enterprise environments (Azure / AWS).
• Demonstrable experience working directly with external clients and senior stakeholders.
• Strong consulting and stakeholder management skills.
• Experience leading technical workshops and architecture discussions.
• Strong Azure expertise and cloud-native engineering experience.
• Kubernetes, containerisation and modern platform engineering experience.
• Strong knowledge of CI/CD, automation and Infrastructure as Code.
• Experience operating within regulated, secure or mission-critical environments.
• Strong communication and presentation skills.
• Experience leading and developing engineering teams.

Desirable Skills & Experience
• Experience delivering platform and cloud solutions within Government, Defence, Critical National Infrastructure
or other highly regulated environments.
• Strong understanding of DevSecOps, security-by-design and platform governance principles.
• Experience with AWS and multi-cloud architectures.
• Experience operating and governing Kubernetes platforms at enterprise scale.
• Knowledge of modern observability and monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry and Azure Monitor.
• Experience designing and supporting hybrid cloud environments.
• Familiarity with Internal Developer Platforms and self-service engineering models.
• Experience leading large-scale cloud migration and application modernisation programmes.
• Knowledge of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles and operational excellence practices.
• Experience with enterprise networking, identity management and Zero Trust architectures.

• Exposure to data and AI platforms.

• Relevant industry certifications, such as Azure, AWS, Kubernetes or Terraform.

Your Benefits, Your Way

raw.description:
Localization quality controllers (LQCs) support FunkyCorp project managers on localization projects. They ensure localized content reads naturally in their native language and meets our high standards. FunkyCorp is looking for dedicated individuals who are passionate about translation, detail-oriented, and motivated by a challenge.

What you’ll do:

  • Assist in the creation of a terminology list and style guide that aligns with content strategy and clearly defines target-language-specific rules
  • Manage the terminology list and style guide
  • Review content that has been translated and proofread ensuring it is:
    • Consistent with the terminology list and style guide
    • Contextually accurate—some words/sentences may need to be translated differently depending on the context. For example, “subject” can be translated differently in French depending on the context: “sujet”, “objet”, “matière”.
    • Free from mistranslations, grammatical errors, spelling mistakes and unnatural sentence structure/phrasing.
  • Evaluate and report to the project manager on translation quality, raising issues and providing feedback where necessary
  • Answer target-language-specific questions from translators and proofreaders
  • Participate irregular meetings with the project manager and other LQCs
  • Screen proofread the demo version of the localized site before the official launch checking for incorrectly displayed text, corrupted characters, image issues and high-level contextual inaccuracies

You have:

  • 3+ years of professional experience as a translator from English into your native language
  • Professional experience as a Localization quality controller or equivalent.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in translation, English literature, linguistics, your native language, or similar.
  • Must be a native speaker of the target language, with impeccable grammar and spelling
  • Is fluent in English (speaking, listening, reading and writing)
  • Has significant translation, proofreading and/or quality control experience in the digital field
  • Has uninterrupted access to the internet and is able to check and respond to emails regularly
  • Strong computer literacy including being comfortable using various task management systems, communication apps and presentation/spreadsheet apps for productivity

The ideal person:

  • Has visited or lived in Japan and is knowledgeable about the country and its culture
  • Has experience working on a large-scale localization project with multiple counterparts
  • Has experience working on travel-related contents
  • Has extraordinary attention to detail and problem-solving skills
  • Has a flexible schedule.
  • Thrives working on fast-paced and challenging projects as part of a dynamic team

We are seeking a highly motivated Manager - Data Engineering to join our growing team. This role will report to the Director of Data Engineering and will lead a team of data engineers. The ideal candidate is a strong technical leader with a passion for mentoring others and delivering scalable, high-quality data solutions. You will collaborate closely with data analysts, data scientists, technology teams, and business leaders to design and implement robust data pipelines and platforms that support internal and external clients. With over a million managed lives across the country and terabytes of healthcare data generated, your leadership will be critical to empowering our organization with the tools and insights needed to drive innovation and improve patient outcomes.

Our Values:
  • Put Patients First
  • Empower Entrepreneurial Provider and Care Teams
  • Operate with Integrity & Excellence
  • Be Innovative
  • Work As One Team

What You'll Do

  • Lead and mentor a team of data engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning, innovation, and operational excellence.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to design and implement scalable data pipelines and models aligned with business needs and industry best practices.
  • Oversee the development, deployment, and maintenance of enterprise-grade ELT processes, data marts, and business intelligence assets.
  • Own and evolve data quality frameworks, ensuring proactive monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolution of data issues.
  • Champion the adoption of automation and modern data engineering practices, driving efficiencies in pipeline management and data delivery.
  • Guide your team in building domain knowledge around healthcare operations, ensuring data solutions comply with regulatory and security requirements.
  • Contribute to strategic planning for the data engineering function, including resource allocation, technology selection, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Support and enforce software development best practices, including code reviews, source control, CI/CD, and testing.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required in computer science, engineering, healthcare, analytics, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
  • At least 5 years of experience in data engineering or software development roles, with at least 2+ years in a leadership or management capacity.
  • At least 2 years of experience with medical claims in healthcare and/or managed care.
  • Strong expertise in building scalable ELT/ETL pipelines using modern data platforms and cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure).
  • Advanced proficiency with SQL and scripting/programming languages such as Python or Spark.
  • Solid understanding of database structures, data modeling (normalized, star schema, snowflake), and data warehousing concepts.
  • Experience working with Databricks or similar distributed computing platforms preferred.
  • Familiarity with BI tools such Power BI.
  • Deep understanding of professional software engineering practices including SDLC, version control, CI/CD, and automated testing.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.
You're a great fit for this role if you:
  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy leading teams to solve complex data challenges.
  • Are passionate about mentoring and growing the next generation of data engineering talent.
  • Have a bias for action and a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions with measurable impact.
  • Bring a collaborative, team-first mindset to everything you do.

Environmental Job Requirements and Working Conditions

  • This position is remotely based in the U.S.
  • The total compensation target pay range for this role is: $140,000 - $160,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on geographic location (current or future), experience, and other job-related factors.

raw.excerpt: The Jed Foundation (“JED”) is a nonprofit organization that protects emotional health and prevents suicide for teens and young adults.
raw.description:
The Jed Foundation (“JED”) is a nonprofit organization that protects emotional health and prevents suicide for teens and young adults. By equipping individuals, families, schools, and communities with the skills, knowledge, and support to promote mental well-being, JED is committed to ensuring that all young people have the resources they need to thrive. Position Overview The Jed Foundation (JED) is seeking a AI Safety & Wellbeing to advance JED’s growing work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, emerging technology, mental health, and suicide prevention. AI is rapidly changing how people learn, connect, create, seek information and support, form relationships, and navigate the world around them. JED’s work in this area spans advising technology companies; AI safety, evaluation, and benchmarking collaborations; partnerships with research and public-interest organizations; public thought leadership and guidance; and efforts to understand and shape both the risks and potential benefits of emerging technologies. Reporting to the SVP, Youth Strategies & Chief Engagement Officer, the Director will advance key areas of work focused on emerging AI technologies and their implications for mental health and suicide prevention, AI safety and evaluation, technology advising, and the development of JED positions, frameworks, and guidance. The successful candidate will bring meaningful existing expertise in AI technology and safety or evaluation, along with experience applying technology, safety, research, or evaluation approaches in mental health, healthcare, public health, child and adolescent wellbeing or safety, or another high-stakes human context. The role requires understanding of mental health and suicide prevention to work effectively with JED’s experts and partners, alongside the technical fluency to engage credibly with AI researchers, safety and evaluation teams, engineers, and product leaders.

Candidates in Bay area, Boston, and NYC encouraged to apply!

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain a sophisticated understanding of developments in AI technology and assess their implications for mental health and suicide prevention, including emerging forms of human-AI interaction such as conversational and relational AI, multimodal systems, agents, memory and personalization, ambient and wearable technologies, and embodied AI.
  • Advance JED’s work in AI safety, evaluation, benchmarking, standards, and related field-building efforts, working with technology, research, mental-health, suicide-prevention, and public-interest partners to bring relevant priorities into evaluation frameworks, scenarios, constructs, measures, and other approaches.
  • Apply knowledge of model and system behavior, safety evaluations, red-teaming, safeguards and mitigations, failure modes, and evaluation methodology to identify where current approaches are strong and where important gaps remain.
  • Advance approaches that consider not only acute safety failures but broader questions involving relationships and dependency, connection and belonging, agency, coping, help-seeking, protective factors, developmental differences, and beneficial uses of AI.
  • Manage substantive technology-company advising work, assessing AI products, features, and safety approaches and developing actionable recommendations related to model and product behavior, safety, evaluation, developmental appropriateness, help-seeking and crisis pathways, relational dynamics, and responsible deployment.
  • Develop JED POVs, frameworks, principles, recommendations, and guidance on AI and emerging technology, drawing on technical and research developments, expert consultation, JED expertise, and learning across external engagements.
  • Identify emerging issues, evidence gaps, and opportunities that warrant JED engagement through advising, guidance, partnerships, evaluation, field-building, or other strategic action.
  • Build and manage substantive relationships across technology companies, AI safety and evaluation organizations, academic and independent research institutions, public-interest organizations, philanthropy, and mental-health and suicide-prevention organizations.
  • Collaborate with JED’s Knowledge & Advising, Policy, Programs, MarComms, and other teams to bring relevant expertise into the work and connect insights from AI partnerships and advising to JED’s broader efforts.
  • Represent JED in appropriate collaborations, working groups, expert processes, convenings, and external forums, and contribute to the development of new initiatives, partnerships, proposals, and funding opportunities.

Skills Knowledge and Expertise

Required
  • Approximately 7+ years of relevant professional experience, including substantial work in AI, AI safety, responsible AI, AI evaluation, human-AI interaction, or a closely related field. Exceptional candidates with a different career trajectory but equivalent depth of experience will be considered.
  • Strong working knowledge of contemporary AI technologies, including generative AI, large language models, multimodal systems, conversational AI, agents, memory/personalization, and emerging human-AI interfaces.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of AI safety and evaluation, including model and system behavior, evaluation and benchmarking, red-teaming, failure modes, safeguards and mitigations, and the strengths and limitations of current approaches.
  • Experience applying technology, safety, evaluation, research, or related expertise in a high-stakes human domain such as mental health, suicide prevention, healthcare, public health, child and adolescent wellbeing or safety, child protection, online safety, violence prevention, or another closely related area.
  • Working knowledge of mental health, suicide prevention, behavioral health, public health, or an adjacent field sufficient to engage meaningfully with domain experts and understand the implications of AI systems for people experiencing distress or vulnerability.
  • Technical fluency sufficient to engage credibly and independently with AI researchers, engineers, evaluation and safety teams, and product teams. This role does not require the candidate to be an ML engineer.

We are seeking a highly skilled and execution-focused Manager of Advanced Analytics to help shape and deliver our analytics strategy and roadmap. This role is hands-on and influential, focused on designing and implementing scalable data solutions, building advanced BI capabilities, and enabling actionable insights across risk adjustment, clinical operations, quality, compliance, and cost management.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with the ability to guide and mentor team members while collaborating closely with cross-functional stakeholders. You will partner with data analysts, data scientists, technology teams, and business leaders to design, implement, and optimize advanced analytics solutions that support internal and external clients. With over a million managed lives and terabytes of healthcare data generated, your contributions will be critical to driving data-driven decision making and improving patient outcomes.

What You'll Do

  • Contribute to the design and execution of Astrana Health’s enterprise analytics roadmap aligned with growth and value-based care objectives.
  • Lead the development of scalable analytics solutions and BI dashboards using tools such as Databricks and Power BI.

  • Partner with business stakeholders (Clinical Operations, Quality Improvement, Finance) to translate requirements into scalable analytic solutions and drive actionable insights.
  • Establish QA protocols and ensure data integrity for all reporting deliverables.

  • Conduct performance reviews and set development goals, to build team strength.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, data science, analytics, statistics, or related field.

  • Knowledge of SDLC best practices, including version control, testing, and CI/CD.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment and lead cross-functional initiatives.

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Database Administrator is responsible for the health, performance, security, and architecture of the organization's relational and NoSQL/document database platforms across on-premises and cloud environments. During a period of significant modernization, this role keeps on-premises SQL Server stable while leading the design and migration of transactional workloads to Azure and supporting the move to Microsoft Fabric. The position partners with Software Development, QA, Infrastructure, Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, Business Intelligence, and vendors, taking a prevention-first approach to protecting PHI and the organization's data.

Roles:

  • Primary technical owner and escalation point for all production and non-production databases and data stores, on-premises and in the cloud.
  • Lead database architecture, design standards, and Azure migration strategy in alignment with enterprise architecture.
  • Primary database partner to application development, QA, and Business Intelligence teams.
  • Proactively identify and resolve performance, capacity, security, and stability risks before they become incidents.

Major Responsibilities or Assigned Duties:

On-prem SQL Server Operations & Decommissioning

  • Administer, patch, secure, and support on-premises SQL Server (SQL Agent, SSIS, linked servers), keeping it stable through the transition.
  • Inventory databases, dependencies, and data flows to sequence migration; decommission servers once workloads move.

Azure Cloud Database Architecture & Migration

Multi-Platform Data Environment

NoSQL and Document Platforms

  • Administer and support NoSQL and document databases (e.g., Azure Cosmos DB, MongoDB), including partition/shard key design, indexing policies, consistency levels, throughput and cost management, and backup/restore.

Proactive Monitoring, Security & Continuity

  • Configure auditing to Information Security's SIEM; design and test backup, HA, and DR to RPO/RTO targets; support audits (e.g., HIPAA, SOC 2, HITRUST, URAC).

Application Development, BI & QA Partnership

  • Partner with developers and BI on data modeling, schema design, and query patterns; review database code and changes before release.
  • Guide QA on database testing standards (integrity, regression, load, performance), with QA retaining ownership of test strategy.

Certifications (Preferred):

  • Snowflake/Databricks equivalent), Security+, or ITIL Foundation.

Education:

raw.excerpt: About the Organization:Healthy oceans need healthy data systems, and healthy information ecosystems need stewardship.
raw.description:
About the Organization:Healthy oceans need healthy data systems, and healthy information ecosystems need stewardship. Intertidal Agency empowers ocean data stewards and helps build data infrastructure to drive ocean conservation, management, and innovation. We support the people layer of data sharing with a combination of policy, process, and technical tools. Our multi-disciplinary partners include governments, communities, scientists, nonprofits, and businesses who want to connect ocean data to action by making data more useful, usable, and used.
Position Summary:Intertidal Agency is seeking a data scientist or data engineer for a one-year fellowship to improve data pipelines into the World Ocean Database (WOD), the primary global source for ocean temperature, salinity, oxygen, and nutrient data. The overall project goal is to make WOD data more FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable) by standardizing workflows for data ingestion across a global community of data contributors. A specific focus for the fellow will be developing algorithmic solutions for de-duplicating data submissions from uncrewed systems, such as gliders, and expanding those solutions to address other ocean and earth science problems. Addressing this problem will require contending with three intersecting issues:
  • Identification. How do you determine that two records describe the same observation? The obvious matching key for glider data is unreliable, and finding better ones is part of the work.
  • Survivorship. Once duplicates are identified, which copy survives, and on what basis? Later submissions are often better, but not always. The rule must be defensible and documented.
  • Granularity. A glider may report every second. WOD cannot absorb that resolution across a growing fleet, and binning decisions determine what future researchers can ask of the record. Setting a community standard for granularity takes both analysis and community agreement.
Developing and publishing rigorous, community-supported solutions to these issues will be a significant contribution to WOD and the broader earth science field.
This is a one-year, fixed-term position that is supported by a Climate Reserve fellowship, and the hire will also participate in Climate Reserve network activities.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Establish and help manage a project advisory committee ocean data professionals.
  • Work directly with the major glider data providers (e.g. IOOS, EGO, and IMOS) on upstream improvements to data submissions.
  • Develop, test, and document an algorithmic method for identifying duplicate observations from gliders and other autonomous platforms, and for selecting which record to retain. Benchmark against the publicly served California Underwater Glider Network Line 80 record, roughly 67,000 quality-controlled profiles spanning 2005 to the present, then work against NOAA NCEI’s glider holdings.
  • Convene and run working sessions, including hackathons, to collaboratively develop solutions. Participants would include people experienced with the data sources, research software engineers, data scientists, and WOD experts. Support workshop participants in implementing and iterating on workshop products within their own workflows.
  • Release all code, computational notebooks, and documentation publicly under open licenses, written so that other data centers can adopt the methods. Prepare a manuscript for a peer-reviewed journal with the fellow as lead author.
  • Work with project directors and the advisory committee to draft recommendations for the Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission (IOC) to support the new standards and workflows. These would be drafted during the fellowship and presented at the fall 2028 IOC meeting.

The Ideal Candidate

You are drawn to challenges that span disciplines. You can take a messy, real-world data problem and find structure in it. You write code other people can run and read. You work well with people with a wide range of technical fluency, from research software engineers to program managers and scientists. You have experience modernizing legacy data systems. You develop clear roadmaps and roles with your teammates that let you work independently while staying coordinated. You see AI as a tool to support human expertise and judgement, not a replacement.
You do not need to be an oceanographer. If you bring strong quantitative and data science skills, the project leads and advisors will provide the ocean science grounding.

Specific Experience Requested:We recognize that each applicant for this role will bring unique skills, knowledge, experiences, and background to this position. We welcome diverse experiences and perspectives in our applicant pool, and will be looking for candidates who possess many, but not necessarily all, of the following qualifications and experience:
  • Quantitative and algorithmic capability. Multivariate statistics and dimensionality reduction, similarity and distance metrics, clustering or classification. Experience with record linkage, entity resolution, fuzzy matching, or deduplication in any domain, including outside Earth science (e.g. bibliographic records, customer data, other sensor networks).
  • Working knowledge of why pairwise comparison across millions of records is not viable, and familiarity with blocking, indexing, approximate nearest neighbor search, or locality-sensitive hashing as ways around it.
  • Python fluency, preferably with numpy, pandas, and scipy. Version control with git.
  • Comfortable in a Unix or Linux shell on a remote machine, with pipes, regular expressions, and standard text processing tools. You will need to open an unfamiliar file, inspect it, and write something to interrogate it, with nobody available to walk you through it.
  • Reading and writing netCDF, including CF conventions, standard names, fill values, and time units. The majority of the data under consideration will be in this format. Familiarity with CF discrete sampling geometries, particularly Profile and TrajectoryProfile, is a strong plus, since that is how glider deployments are represented.
  • Retrieving data programmatically from ERDDAP, THREDDS, or OPeNDAP endpoints, and from federal repositories, university archives, and cloud object storage.
  • Independence. The ability to take an ambiguous problem, break it apart, and make progress without close supervision.
  • Experience handling data you did not collect, from providers you do not control, in formats you did not choose
  • Experience with government data infrastructure and modernizing legacy data systems
  • International research or data collaboration
  • Familiarity with oceanographic or earth science data

Workplace & Compensation

Workplace: Intertidal Agency has a fully remote workforce with a 32 hour work week. The fellow will be expected to be available during a core set of working hours (generally 0900-1300 Pacific Time) with some availability during UTC/Europe time.
Travel: Estimated three weeks of travel for two project workshops plus the annual Climate Reserve convening.
Compensation: Intertidal Agency and Multiplier provide a comprehensive compensation package, including competitive salary ($78k-$88k annual salary), excellent medical and dental benefits, retirement savings, and generous vacation and sick leave policy.

How to Apply: To apply, please visit our Applicant Portal. Applications will be accepted until the position is filled. Priority will be given to applications received on or before Sunday, November 29, 2026. Please include your resume and a cover letter explaining your interest in the role. We respectfully request no follow-up calls or emails.

Intertidal Agency is an independent operating project ofMultiplier, a nationally recognized nonprofit that accelerates impact for sustainability-focused initiatives.
Multiplier is committed to creating an inclusive, equitable, and accessible application process for all candidates. We recognize that the traditional hiring process can create barriers. If we can support your participation in the job application or interview process by providing specific assistance or accommodation, please reach out to . Requests for accommodations are confidential and will not impact your candidacy.

raw.title: Data Engineer - Business Intelligence
raw.excerpt: WHO WE ARE & WHAT WE DO Hallmark’s Data & Business Intelligence organization turns enterprise data into trusted insights that help teams across Hallmark make better, faster decisions.
raw.description:
WHO WE ARE & WHAT WE DO

Hallmark’s Data & Business Intelligence organization turns enterprise data into trusted insights that help teams across Hallmark make better, faster decisions. We build and manage the data platforms, pipelines, semantic models, and analytics solutions that support critical business areas including retail, product, consumer, merchandising, planning, finance, and executive reporting.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING & THE IMPACT YOU’LL MAKE

We are looking for an experienced BI Engineer to design and build scalable, governed analytics solutions that enable trusted and intuitive access to enterprise data. This role will focus on developing Power BI semantic models, reusable business/context layers, and self-service analytics capabilities, leveraging Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and AI-assisted development practices. The ideal candidate will have 6–8 years of experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or related areas, with strong hands-on expertise in Power BI, dimensional modeling, semantic model development, SQL, and modern cloud data platforms. This role also requires an AI-first engineering mindset. The engineer will be expected to use approved AI capabilities to accelerate development, testing, documentation, optimization, and modernization while maintaining accountability for the quality, security, and maintainability of production solutions.

This is a progressive role that will be filled at the level based on the skills and experience of the selected candidate.

ADDITIONAL DETAILS

  • The salary range for this role is $85,000 - $110,000. Final compensation varies based on several factors.
  • This is a U.S.-based remote role.* We’re committed to creating a connected, collaborative culture, no matter where you are. You’ll have access to virtual tools, team support, and opportunities to engage and grow with us. *Due to state-specific benefits regulations, Hallmark cannot consider candidates for remote positions who reside in Alaska, Hawaii, or Puerto Rico, or any country outside of the United States.
  • This is a progressive role designed to grow with you. We’ll match the job level to your skills and experience so you can hit the ground running and keep building your career.
  • Hallmark is committed to recognizing and rewarding performance. Employees are eligible for annual merit-based increases, aligned with individual and company performance.
  • In alignment with our culture of care, Hallmark offers a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental and vision plans, paid time off, 401K with company match, and profit-sharing.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS (the following is required to be considered for this role):

  • At lease 6 years of experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related technology discipline.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI, including semantic model development, DAX, Power Query/M, dimensional modeling, Power BI Service, data security, and performance optimization.
  • Experience designing and developing dimensional data models using star schemas, facts, dimensions, aggregations, relationships, hierarchies, measures, and KPIs.
  • Demonstrated experience building shared and reusable semantic/business layers, rather than primarily developing individual reports.
  • Experience developing and implementing self-service analytics capabilities for business users.
  • Experience developing and optimizing SQL queries for performance and efficiency.
  • Hands-on experience working with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform.
  • Experience developing analytical solutions using Microsoft Fabric.
  • Understanding of modern analytical architectures spanning data platforms, analytical data products, semantic models, and visualization layers.
  • Experience designing or developing modern analytical architectures that include data platforms, analytical data products, semantic models, and visualization layers
  • Experience translating complex business requirements into scalable technical and analytical solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience incorporating Generative AI or AI coding assistants into real-world development workflows.
  • Ability to use AI effectively to generate, review, refine, and troubleshoot SQL, DAX, M, semantic-model metadata, documentation, and other engineering artifacts.
  • Experience using AI across multiple stages of the development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, troubleshooting, optimization, and documentation.
  • Ability to evaluate AI-generated solutions for correctness rather than accepting generated code without appropriate engineering review.
  • Experience applying responsible AI development practices, including data protection, security, validation, governance, and human accountability

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (your application will stand out if you have the following):

  • Advanced experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, Direct Lake, Dataflows Gen2, and data pipelines.
  • Experience integrating and optimizing Power BI with Snowflake.
  • Experience with medallion or layered data architectures and curated analytical data products.
  • Experience with CI/CD, Git integration, deployment pipelines, source control, and DevOps practices for BI and analytics solutions.
  • Experience establishing BI governance, semantic-model standards, common metric definitions, and self-service analytics frameworks.
  • Experience modernizing legacy BI/reporting platforms to Power BI, Fabric, Snowflake, or other modern cloud analytics platforms.
  • Experience with metadata management, data catalogs, lineage, business glossaries, or Microsoft Purview.
  • Experience developing AI-enabled accelerators, agents, reusable prompts, or automated development workflows for BI and analytics engineering.
  • Experience applying AI to accelerate BI modernization, report migration, semantic modeling, metadata management, testing, and self-service analytics.

COME JOIN US! Now’s your chance to embrace a future with Hallmark—just follow the instructions below to apply

You must show how you meet the basic qualifications in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields. Accepted file types are DOCX and PDF.

In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, Hallmark Cards, Inc. and its subsidiary companies will hire only individuals lawfully authorized to work in the United States. Hallmark does not generally provide sponsorship for employment.

Employment by Hallmark is contingent upon the signing of the Employment Agreement, signing of an agreement to arbitrate in connection with the Hallmark Dispute Resolution Program, completing Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification, passing the urinalysis drug screen, education verification and satisfactory reference and background checks.

Hallmark is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, pregnancy, national origin, physical or mental disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or any other legally-protected status. Principals only please.

HALLMARK – Because Connecting With Each Other Has Never Been More Important

For more than a century, Hallmark has been bringing people together and improving the relationships that matter most. That’s why millions of people all over the world connect with the Hallmark brand. It has always been a mission so much bigger than any one of us who work here. Today, we need empathetic learners, strategic thinkers, and enthusiastic visionaries with diverse experiences and skills to help us create the rest of Hallmark’s second century as we shift to a more digitally savvy, unified approach that combines the best of brick-and-mortar retail with the efficiency of dot-com spaces. Help us imagine what our next hundred years could look like!

When you join Hallmark, we will go out of our way to make you feel like part of the team, even in a remote/hybrid work environment. In the day-to-day, we’ll make the best use of the skills and talents you already have. We’ll also give you leadership opportunities and show you multiple potential pathways to future success.

Our culture of care for our consumers and for one another shows in the way we embrace different backgrounds, identities, and working styles, deliberately seeking out ways to be more inclusive both internally among our work groups and externally through the things we make and sell to our retail partners and consumers. We believe that a broadly inclusive, equitable approach is also our best path to future success. We’re seeking out those who can bring a fresh perspective to our business and would love your input as someone new to our team! We can only change and grow when we intentionally include new perspectives–like yours.

raw.title: Claims Performance Analyst
raw.excerpt: About Reserv Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims.
raw.description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About the role

Reserv’s book is growing fast — and fast growth stress-tests everything: file quality, reserving discipline, assignment logic, and the processes underneath them. We’re standing up a small rapid-response function inside Claims Performance to get ahead of it, and we’re staffing it with four of our own.

  • Deployments will range across the full complexity spectrum of the book — from high-complexity GL and liability files to high-frequency APD inventory. The common thread isn’t the line of business; it’s a book under pressure that needs senior claims hands in it now.
  • You’re a licensed, tenured adjuster who will embed inside a claims team under pressure, dig into the inventory, and take direct corrective action in files — because you hold the licenses to do it. You diagnose like an auditor and operate like an adjuster.
  • You will also act as a requirements pipeline for embedding quality and compliance controls directly into our platform: every problem you find, fix, or coach to gets written up as a spec for an embedded check in Glance. Put plainly: your job is to work yourself out of a job. When the book stabilizes and the platform checks ship, you haven’t made yourself obsolete — you’ve made the fix permanent.

**This is a 6-12 month rotational tour, not a permanent position — and the same is true of the function itself. This program exists to close the gap while quality and compliance controls are built into Glance; as those embedded checks ship, the need for manual intervention shrinks, and the program sunsets with it. That’s not a risk to the role — it’s the definition of success. At the end of your tour you return to a guaranteed equivalent-or-better seat, carrying skills and visibility very few adjusters get.

You’ll sit on the Claims Performance team. The VP of Claims Performance and claims leadership point you at the book, set the priorities, and re-aim you as conditions change — you bring the file-level judgment on how to get there. Before your first deployment, the QA team will train you on Reserv’s AI-assisted review tooling — MAG (multi-agent review), Batch, and Copilot — so you’re diagnosing with machine leverage, not just a legal pad.

What you'll do

  • Embed in an assigned book of business. Review the claim inventory end to end and surface what’s actually wrong: aged and stalled files, miss-assigned claims, under-reserved exposures, and authority breaches.
  • Fix what you find. Where licensed and authorized, take corrective action in the file: documentation, reserve recommendations, reassignment flags, and escalation. You don’t write a finding and walk away; you leave the file better than you found it.
  • Shape the action plan, then work the clean-up through Claim Health. Provide direct input into claim action plans, then use Claim Health to drive the clean-up: prioritize the inventory, work it down, and verify the improvement is real. A known failure mode is files being “moved” without actually advancing — you’ll distinguish genuine file progression from superficial touches, and call out the difference.
  • Route what you can’t fix to the leader who can. Some findings belong to a desk, not a file — training gaps, assignment logic, authority practices. Those get documented and handed to the accountable claims leader through Claims Performance, and you track whether they’re actioned. You illuminate; line leadership enforces.
  • Provide direct coaching and feedback to adjusting staff. Every corrected file is a coaching opportunity. Deliver specific, file-grounded feedback to the adjusters behind the inventory — directly, constructively, and in the moment. The goal isn’t just a cleaner file; it’s a desk that doesn’t produce the problem again.
  • Turn every fix into a platform check. Each problem you correct by hand gets written up as a structured requirement/spec for an automated control in Glance, so the platform catches it next time and no human has to. Rinse, repeat, scale.
  • Be the technical claims brain for claims leadership. As leadership pressure-tests processes across the book, you supply the file-level expertise: what’s really happening in the inventory, and why.
  • Keep the lines clean with QA. You are first-line: you work files and you fix them. The independent QA team trains you, audits behind you, and picks up the audit-worthy patterns you hand off. You never audit your own work — that separation is what lets your file actions stand up to carrier and regulator scrutiny.

What You Bring

  • Senior adjuster experience with genuine range. GL/liability complexity is mandatory — that depth transfers to everything else — but you’re equally willing to grind through a high-frequency APD inventory. Deployments will demand both.
  • A completed licensing footprint. You’ve finished the licensing process and are maximally licensed — this role starts deployed, not in a licensing queue. You’ll maintain the footprint with company-supported CE.
  • Airtight file documentation discipline. Your corrective actions live in files that regulators, carriers, and QA will read.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted claims tooling — or strong aptitude and appetite to learn it. You’ll be trained on MAG, Batch, and Copilot before deployment.
  • Comfort operating in a directed, high-tempo model. Claims leadership sets the target and re-aims you as the book demands; you own how the work gets done in the file. If you need six months of runway on one desk, this isn’t your role.
  • The rare temperament this role demands: the diagnostic mindset of an auditor, the willingness to get your hands dirty in files, and the credibility to coach peers directly — including delivering feedback the recipient may not want to hear.
  • A sense of urgency — at all times. (That does not mean working at all hours.)

Why This Role

Visibility. You’ll work directly with the VP of Claims Performance and senior claims leadership, on the problems they care most about, with your findings shaping how they run the book.

Leverage. Fixing one file helps one claim. Writing the spec that becomes a Glance platform check helps every claim, forever. Very few adjuster roles let you build the system instead of just working inside it.

Trajectory. Your job is to work yourself out of a job — and so is the program’s. Rotation alumni return to the book as the adjusters who know the AI tooling, think in platform checks, and have run point for senior claims leadership. As this function sunsets, that experience is what you keep — and it’s the profile we expect to draw on for what comes next.

Working hours are aligned to claims leadership (US hours).

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • 100% remote (home-based) role designed to support your work-life balance
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

raw.description:
About Zapata Quantum

Zapata Quantum (OTCQB: ZPTA) helps organizations close the quantum applications gap. We map industrial use cases to quantum applications using an AI-powered, hardware-agnostic approach, so teams can see where quantum can deliver value and how to get there.

Our story is technical, and it has to be told clearly to executives, analysts, journalists and investors. We are looking for a senior technical writer and editor who can make that happen across everything we publish.

The Role

This is a part-time, remote contract role at roughly 10 to 15 hours per week. You will write, edit and strengthen press releases, blog posts, thought leadership and product marketing content. Working with the CEO, CMO, SMEs across the company, and agencies, you will also help shape the angles and messages behind them. Hourly rate commensurate with senior-level editorial experience in the technology sector.

Detail

Specifics

Engagement

Contract / freelance. Initial term 3 months with potential for renewal and expansion.

Hours

10 to 15 per week, with some flexibility around launches and announcements

Location

Remote, with an option to work in our Boston office

Reports to

Chief Marketing Officer

What You'll Do

  • Write and/or edit press releases, blogs, thought leadership articles and product marketing copy for clarity, accuracy, tone and impact.
  • Translate complex scientific and technical concepts into plain, compelling language without losing precision.
  • Shape the narrative: pitch angles, sharpen key messages and recommend how a topic should be framed for a given audience.
  • Work with scientists, engineers and executives to fact-check claims and capture their ideas accurately.
  • Keep voice and messaging consistent across authors, channels and formats, in line with our style and brand guidelines.
  • Review content for compliance-sensitive language, since we are a public company, and flag anything that needs legal or leadership review.
  • Deliver reliably on tight deadlines.

What You Bring

  • Eight or more years of professional technical writing and editing experience, with a track record of senior or lead editorial work in technical, scientific or B2B communications.
  • Strong STEM literacy in areas such as physics, computing, chemistry or AI, and the curiosity to learn new technical domains quickly. A degree in a science or engineering field is preferred but not required.
  • A portfolio that shows you can explain difficult ideas to non-experts while keeping experts on board.
  • Strategic judgment: you can recommend story angles, spot weak claims and push back constructively on drafts and on messaging.
  • Excellent command of grammar, style and structure, and a sharp eye for hype, jargon and unsupported claims.
  • Experience across press releases, blogs, thought leadership and product marketing.
  • Self-directed and dependable in a remote, asynchronous setting, with the ability to manage your own time on a part-time schedule.

Nice to Have

  • Prior writing or editing in enterprise software, quantum computing, AI or other deep tech.
  • Experience with communications for a publicly traded company, including familiarity with disclosure-sensitive language.
  • Experience working with executives and founders to develop a personal or company point of view.
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn-first content and social media amplification.

Overview

KFS, LLC is seeking a Part-Time National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) Subject Matter Expert (SME) who will support environmental compliance and planning efforts. The Part-Time NEPA SME will provide senior-level technical expertise and guidance to staff- and project-level environmental specialists developing Environmental Assessments, Environmental Impact Statements, and other environmental planning and compliance documents. This person will serve as a technical authority for an environmental program supporting numerous Department of Defense services with environmental compliance and NEPA projects.

Job duties include, but are not limited to:

  • Provide senior-level environmental reviews, project scope and alternative development, field investigation support, planning, cost estimating, problem and conflict resolution, and scheduling guidance.
  • Conduct environmental troubleshooting and consultations, providing expert technical and project advice and guidance to clients, project managers, and interdisciplinary teams.
  • Conduct comprehensive technical and quality-control reviews of professional studies, reports, environmental analyses, and NEPA documents.
  • Collaborate with managers, environmental specialists, engineers and architects, legal staff, contract specialists, contractor personnel, and agency representatives to provide advice and insight regarding the resolution of unique and/or complex environmental compliance issues.
  • Provide technical reviews and review comments for Environmental Assessments, Environmental Impact Statements, Records of Environmental Consideration, Findings of No Significant Impact, Records of Decision, and supporting environmental studies and reports.
  • Prepare and review environmental scopes of work and provide technical support for responses to requests for proposals for environmental projects.
  • Provide expert in-house assessments of project impacts, best management practices, typical and creative mitigation measures, and the required studies, consultations, coordination, permitting requirements, costs, and timelines necessary for final project implementation.
  • Evaluate proposed actions and alternatives for compliance with NEPA and other applicable federal, state, and local environmental laws, regulations, executive orders, and Department of Defense policies.
  • Provide technical direction regarding affected-environment analyses, environmental consequences, cumulative effects, mitigation measures, and agency and public involvement requirements.
  • Prepare, review, and provide senior-level technical input for NEPA documents and correspondence with regulatory and resource agencies.
  • Support agency coordination, public involvement, stakeholder engagement, and consultation activities associated with NEPA compliance.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level environmental staff and provide technical guidance regarding NEPA documentation, analysis, and regulatory compliance.
  • Regular verbal and written updates regarding project status will be a routine aspect of coordinating all assigned tasks.
  • Travel, including potential overnight travel, will be required for up to four weeks per year.

Requirements

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in environmental science, environmental planning, natural resources, biology, ecology, engineering, geography, public policy, or a related field. A master’s degree is preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience supporting NEPA and environmental compliance projects.
  • Demonstrated experience preparing, managing, and reviewing Environmental Assessments, Environmental Impact Statements, Findings of No Significant Impact, Records of Decision, Records of Environmental Consideration, and related technical studies.
  • Expert-level knowledge of NEPA, Council on Environmental Quality regulations, and applicable federal environmental laws, regulations, executive orders, and agency-specific procedures.
  • Experience supporting environmental compliance projects for the Department of Defense, other federal agencies, or federal installations is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate complex proposed actions, alternatives, cumulative effects, mitigation measures, and environmental compliance requirements.
  • Experience providing senior-level technical reviews and quality assurance/quality control of environmental documents and supporting technical analyses.
  • Experience coordinating with regulatory agencies, resource agencies, legal counsel, installation personnel, project stakeholders, and interdisciplinary technical teams.
  • Ability to interpret federal regulations, agency guidance, technical studies, and environmental policy and translate them into practical project recommendations.
  • Strong technical writing, editing, research, analytical, organizational, and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical discussions, resolve complex environmental issues, and provide defensible recommendations to clients and project teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, deadlines, and technical assignments with limited supervision.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain access to Department of Defense installations and facilities.
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States.
  • A valid driver’s license and the ability to travel, including overnight travel for up to 25% per year, are required.

Location: Remote

Must have sufficient mobility, including but not limited to bending, reaching, and kneeling to complete daily duties in a timely and efficient manner. Na Central Ailos, buscamos um(a) Agilista para atuar na Tribo de Aplicativos, uma estrutura estratégica responsável por impulsionar a evolução dos canais digitais e apoiar iniciativas que geram valor para todo o Sistema Ailos.

Nesta posição, você atuará em parceria com liderança, Product Owners, Squads e áreas de negócio, contribuindo para a definição de prioridades, gestão de fluxo, evolução da maturidade ágil e sincronização das entregas. Seu papel será fundamental para garantir alinhamento entre estratégia, capacidade de execução e geração de valor para o negócio.

Se você gosta de conectar pessoas, promover melhorias contínuas e transformar desafios organizacionais em entregas consistentes, essa oportunidade é para você.


  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico das lideranças, apoiando a definição de prioridades, alinhamento de demandas e planejamento de iniciativas que gerem valor para o negócio;
  • Apoiar o coordenador da Tribo na gestão do portfólio de demandas, contribuindo para tomadas de decisão baseadas em dados, capacidade dos times e objetivos estratégicos;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com outros Agilistas, promovendo a evolução da cultura ágil e das práticas de gestão em toda a organização;
  • Facilitar a interação entre Squads, áreas de negócio e times parceiros, garantindo alinhamento, transparência e sincronização das entregas;
  • Identificar, monitorar e atuar na remoção de impedimentos, reduzindo desperdícios, retrabalho, atrasos e gargalos que impactem o fluxo de entrega;
  • Apoiar os times na aplicação de práticas ágeis, Lean e de melhoria contínua, buscando maior previsibilidade, qualidade e geração de valor;
  • Facilitar cerimônias, workshops e fóruns de alinhamento, promovendo colaboração, aprendizado e resolução de problemas;
  • Orientar Squads na adoção de métodos, ferramentas e processos que contribuam para a evolução da maturidade ágil;
  • Monitorar indicadores de fluxo, capacidade, produtividade e qualidade, apoiando a análise de desempenho e a tomada de decisão;
  • Atuar como agente de transformação, estimulando autonomia, protagonismo e evolução contínua dos times;
  • Realizar a gestão e acompanhamento de releases, assegurando alinhamento entre equipes e cumprimento dos prazos acordados;
  • Promover visibilidade sobre o andamento das entregas, riscos, dependências e oportunidades de melhoria para lideranças e stakeholders;
  • Ser corresponsável pelo sucesso das entregas junto às Squads, Product Owners e áreas parceiras, acompanhando indicadores e resultados obtidos.

    • É Essencial:
    Ensino Superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Administração, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;

    Vivência com Instituição Financeira;Vivência com frameworks ágeis como Scrum, Kanban e práticas Lean;
    Experiência atuando com equipes multidisciplinares e gestão de demandas em ambientes ágeis;
    Conhecimento em métricas ágeis, indicadores de fluxo e gestão de capacidade;
    Experiência em facilitação de cerimônias, workshops e resolução de conflitos;
    Vivência com ferramentas de gestão ágil e acompanhamento de demandas
    Conhecimentos Desejaveis: Design Thinking; Lean Inception; UX e Discovery de Produtos; OKRs; Pensamento Lean; Métricas Ágeis e Métricas de Fluxo; Azure DevOps; ServiceNow (ITBM); Ferramentas de gestão e colaboração; Pacote Office.
    É Diferencial:
    Pós-graduação em Gestão Empresarial, Gestão de Negócios, Gestão de Projetos, Gestão Ágil ou áreas afins;Certificações como:PSM (Professional Scrum Master);CSM (Certified Scrum Master);KMP I (Kanban Management Professional);Management 3.0;SAFe Agilist;Lean Inception.

Research and evaluate emerging cyber security technologies to recommend solutions that can improve security posture.

Educate and train users and personnel on security policies, best practices, and procedures.

Advanced knowledge and understanding of cyber security principles and technologies.

Experience with cloud security technologies.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to prioritize tasks and work independently.
