raw.description:
A Note On How To Reach Us

We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.

About Foundant

At Foundant, we build mission-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.

We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of ~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.

Where You’ll Work:
  • As a remote-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.
  • With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.
WhatYou’llDo:
  • You’ll build your own pipeline. Consistent, personalized outreach to community foundations, higher education institutions, and other community-focused organizations is the foundation of your results. You see it as the best way to sharpen your craft, because earning a response to a cold email or call is the hardest part of selling. Marketing and BDR-sourced leads are a welcome bonus on top of your own efforts, never a substitute for them.
  • You’ll own the full sales cycle and its results, carrying each opportunity from first conversation through a signed deal.
  • You’ll run discovery that goes past the surface request, listening for the mission, constraints, and outcomes each organization is working toward, reading both the people and the process, and shaping solutions that fit what they’re trying to achieve.
  • You’ll deliver clear, compelling demos and proposals that connect Foundant’s solutions, from CommunitySuite for fund accounting and donor management to our grantmaking solutions and purpose-built AI, to the results your prospect cares about.
  • You’ll work through multi-stakeholder buying processes, including board and committee reviews, finance and accounting stakeholders, and security reviews, keeping every stakeholder informed and bringing in your director and senior colleagues as deals grow more complex.
  • You’ll think critically about how to position Foundant for each buyer and learn how our internal teams work together, so you know who to involve, when, and why.
  • You’ll use AI to work smarter, from account research to outreach to proposal preparation, and you’ll apply critical thinking to how you use it: checking its outputs, protecting data, and keeping your own judgment in the lead.
  • You’ll partner with Marketing, Revenue Operations, Product, and Client teams, and hand off every new client with full context so the team that takes over is set up to succeed from day one.
  • You’ll learn from senior Account Executives and your director, asking for feedback on discovery, demos, and deal strategy and applying it in your next conversation.
  • You’ll share what you’re hearing from buyers with your director and cross-functional partners, so what you learn in the field helps shape how we sell.
  • You’ll hold yourself accountable for accurate pipeline data and forecasts in our CRM, using that data to prioritize your time and flag risks early, including your own.
  • Other duties as assigned.
WhatYou’llNeed:
  • 2–5 years of B2B SaaS sales experience
  • Demonstrated history of meeting or exceeding sales targets in a full-cycle sales role
  • Experience building your own pipeline through proactive, personalized outbound outreach
  • Experience working multi-stakeholder sales cycles, ideally including procurement, board, committee, or security reviews
  • Sound judgment and critical thinking, including the ability to use AI tools thoughtfully and evaluate their output
  • Proficiency with a CRM platform for pipeline management and forecasting
  • Must be legally eligible to work in the United States
  • Great to have: Experience working at a community foundation or in the broader social good sector
  • Great to have: Accounting background or experience with accounting software, such as an ERP or fund accounting system
WhatYou’llBring to our Team Dynamics:

Adaptive Achievement

Owns a pipeline and a number, building that pipeline through self-driven outreach and keeping deals moving through shifting buyer priorities and long, multi-stakeholder buying cycles. Follows through when a deal gets hard, not just when it’s going well, and takes responsibility for outcomes, including misses.

Productive Collaboration

Works hand in hand with Marketing, Revenue Operations, Product, and Client teams, applying emotional intelligence to build trust across the organization. Hands off new clients with context, so the relationship doesn’t restart at signature.

Service Orientation

Treats every prospect conversation as the start of a long-term relationship: listens for the mission behind the request, reads what’s said and unsaid, and recommends what will genuinely serve the client’s outcomes, even when it isn’t the fastest path to a close.

Business Insight

Builds a working understanding of how community foundations and other community-focused funders raise, manage, and distribute charitable funds and grants, including fund accounting and the financial side, and connects Foundant’s solutions to those outcomes. Thinks critically about positioning and about how AI is used in their own work, and uses pipeline data to prioritize accounts and forecast accurately.

Active Learning

Ramps quickly on Foundant’s solutions and the segment’s funding landscape, stays curious about evolving needs, asks for feedback from clients, peers, and deal reviews, applies it noticeably in the next conversation, and adjusts without being told.

Why You’ll Love Working at Foundant:
  • At the heart of everything we do is a commitment to innovation and making a positive impact. Whether you’re working on projects that empower not-for-profits, community foundations, or corporations, your contributions will help drive real-world change.
  • We offer competitive salary and benefits, including tuition, and lifestyle reimbursements, and bespoke mindfulness and fitness initiatives.
  • With our Flexible PTO policy, you’ll have the freedom to manage your time in a way that supports your personal well-being and professional success.
  • We’re committed to your professional and personal development. With our merger, you'll have the chance to collaborate across teams, giving you exposure to diverse ideas, expertise, and projects that span multiple industries.
  • As part of a larger organization, you’ll have even more opportunities to grow your career. Whether it’s exploring new roles, leadership opportunities, or shifting to a different department, we support internal mobility to help you achieve your career goals
  • You’ll enjoy autonomy and responsibility, empowering you to approach your work creatively and independently, fostering innovation and independent thought.
  • Employee recognition is a core part of our culture. When you do a great job, we make sure everyone knows about it!

Foundant is an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse workforce that represents the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates, and will consider all applicants without regard to race, color, citizenship, religion, sex, marital/family status, sexual orientation, gender identity, Indigenous status, age, disability, or individuals who may require accommodation.

Foundant is also committed to providing accommodations throughout the interview and employment process. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all aspects of the selection process. If you have accessibility requirements during the recruitment process and require accommodation, please contact .

raw.description:
Job Title: Director, Market Access, Reimbursement & Patient Services Learning and

Job Location: Remote, USA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Director, Market Access and Patient Services Learning


About the role:

Biogen is seeking an experienced learning and development leader to direct capability development for Market Access, Reimbursement, Patient Access, and Patient Services teams across the North America commercial organization. Reporting to the Head of Commercial Learning & Development, this remote Director partners with senior leaders to translate business priorities into integrated learning strategies, leads a team responsible for execution, and ensures solutions build critical capabilities and deliver measurable business impact.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the learning strategy and portfolio for Market Access, Reimbursement, and Patient Services, aligned with commercial, functional, brand, and enterprise priorities.
  • Define role-based capabilities and scalable learning pathways spanning onboarding, ongoing development, launch readiness, leadership development, and performance support.
  • Lead, develop, and hold accountable a team of learning professionals responsible for executing the portfolio; set clear priorities, roles, quality standards, and delivery expectations.
  • Translate strategic priorities into team workplans, delegate ownership, monitor progress and quality, remove barriers, and ensure timely delivery.
  • Partner with senior leaders and therapeutic area learning teams to diagnose performance needs, prioritize solutions, clarify ownership, and create a cohesive learner experience.
  • Ensure learning incorporates relevant market, reimbursement, policy, customer, and patient insights and supports customer-facing and patient-supporting roles.
  • Build manager coaching, reinforcement, and learning in the flow of work into capability development to support sustained application.
  • Define success measures and use performance data, learner insights, and stakeholder feedback to evaluate impact and improve investments.
  • Evaluate and apply emerging learning technologies, including AI-enabled practice, coaching, and performance support tools, when they improve effectiveness and learner experience.
  • Manage vendors, budgets, and concurrent initiatives in a complex, matrixed environment while balancing immediate priorities with long-term capability development.
  • Ensure learning complies with Biogen values, code of practice, PRC requirements, and relevant policies and SOPs.


Education, Registration & Certification

  • BS/BA degree required; advanced degree in business, learning and development, healthcare, organizational development, or a related field preferred.
  • Professional certification in learning and development, instructional design, performance consulting, coaching, or a related discipline preferred.


Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare, or life sciences industry, including significant learning and development, capability building, or comparable experience.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting Market Access, Reimbursement, Patient Services, Patient Access, or related commercial functions; direct field experience in one of these or a related customer-facing role preferred.
  • People leadership experience required, including setting priorities and performance expectations, coaching talent, and ensuring high-quality execution through others.
  • Experience developing and leading function- or enterprise-level learning strategies and complex portfolios aligned to business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated success partnering with senior leaders and influencing decisions in a matrixed organization.
  • Experience supporting launches, transformation, or new capabilities and ways of working.
  • Experience managing external partners, budgets, and concurrent strategic initiatives and using evidence to measure effectiveness and guide investment decisions.


Skills, Knowledge & Abilities

  • Deep understanding of the pharmaceutical and biotech market access environment, including payer dynamics, reimbursement, patient access, and patient support services.
  • Strong knowledge of adult learning principles, performance consulting, curriculum strategy, instructional design, facilitation, reinforcement, and learning measurement.
  • Strategic and enterprise mindset, with the ability to build scalable capability solutions rather than isolated programs.
  • Ability to translate complex market access, reimbursement, and patient services concepts into practical and relevant learning experiences.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to connect learning priorities to commercial strategy, organizational performance, customer needs, and patient impact.
  • Executive presence and demonstrated ability to engage, advise, and influence senior leaders.
  • Ability to lead through influence across functions and levels of the organization, including Market Access, Patient Services, Commercial, Legal, Compliance, Operations, Analytics, and therapeutic area teams.
  • Strong people leadership and talent development capabilities, with the ability to create clarity, empower execution, provide effective oversight, and build a high-performing and inclusive team.
  • Ability to navigate and execute effectively in a fast-paced, results-driven environment while managing complexity and ambiguity.
  • Strong portfolio, project, budget, vendor, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to make complex information clear, relevant, and actionable.


Travel

Domestic travel expected up to 30% for field engagements, leadership meetings, workshops, national meetings, vendor engagements, and headquarters visits.

Job Level: Management

Additional Information

The base compensation range for this role is: $182,000.00-$250,250.00

Base salary offered is determined through an analytical approach utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills & experience, job location, and internal equity.


Regular employees are eligible to receive both short term and long-term incentives, including cash bonus and equity incentive opportunities, designed to reward recent achievements and recognize your future potential based on individual, business unit and company performance.


In addition to compensation, Biogen offers a full and highly competitive range of benefits designed to support our employees’ and their families physical, financial, emotional, and social well-being; including, but not limited to:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, & Life insurances
  • Fitness & Wellness programs including a fitness reimbursement
  • Short- and Long-Term Disability insurance
  • A minimum of 15 days of paid vacation and an additional end-of-year shutdown time off (Dec 26-Dec 31)
  • Up to 12 company paid holidays + 3 paid days off for Personal Significance
  • 80 hours of sick time per calendar year
  • Paid Maternity and Parental Leave benefit
  • 401(k) program participation with company matched contributions
  • Employee stock purchase plan
  • Tuition reimbursement of up to $10,000 per calendar year
  • Employee Resource Groups participation

Why Biogen?

We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. As a mid-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills. raw.description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About the role

We are seeking a detail-oriented Personal Injury Protection Resolution Specialist to join our team. The PIP Resolution Specialist will be responsible for investigating and evaluating PIP / MP claims and coverage. The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, excellent communication abilities, and a commitment to providing exceptional customer service. Your role will also be responsible for handling an inventory of PIP claims and delivering service to all constituents of the claim.

The ideal candidate has a willingness to work through and design process that supports the quickest claim resolution with the best outcome. In addition, you will collaborate closely with our product and engineering teams to give feedback and identify technology and process improvements.

What you'll do

  • Managing all aspects of PIP litigated and arbitrated cases, including evaluation of the resolution process.
  • Analyzing auto claims to identify areas of dispute, investigating and gathering all necessary information and documentation, evaluating timeliness for handling of all aspects of the PIP claim to include payment and resolution.
  • Recognizing and solving routine and intermediate issues arising out of PIP arbitration cases that can be resolved early before defense counsel involvement. Ongoing review of NJ and NY arbitration forums for timely responses.
  • Managing arbitration and litigation cases related to auto claims disputes for the personal injury protection and / or medical payments coverage, communicating regularly with clients, attorneys, vendors and other stakeholders.
  • Reviewing legal documents and ensuring compliance with the initial suit-handling plan of action. Partners and/or directs law firms to facilitate timely lawsuit resolution.
  • Analyzing policy language and reaching appropriate coverage decisions.
  • Directing and controlling the activities and costs of outside vendors including defense counsel and coverage counsel, experts and independent adjusters

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree (lack of one should not stop you from applying if you possess all the other qualifications)
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience on point and concentrated in Personal Injury Protection
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience on point and concentrated in Personal Injury Protection Litigation experience
  • Handling of commercial or ride share policies is highly preferred
  • Subrogation referrals
  • Bodily Injury and coordination of benefits between PIP and UM / UIM.
  • Active adjuster license: resident-state license where available, otherwise a Designated Home State (DHS) license. Willing to obtain any additional required licenses within 60 days, including state testing.
  • Knowledge of state regulations, policy provisions, and standard operating procedures
  • Desire to engage in learning opportunities and continuous professional development
  • Willingness to travel for client and claims needs

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • 100% remote (home-based) role designed to support your work-life balance
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

Additionally, we will

  • Listen to your feedback to enhance and improve upon the long-standing challenges of an adjuster and the claims role
  • Work toward reducing and eliminating all the administrative work from an adjuster role
  • Foster a culture of empathy, transparency, and empowerment in a remote-first environment

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

title: Mobile Developer

raw.title: Mobile Developer
raw.excerpt: At Luscii, we develop several applications within the OMRON Digital Health Circle, including the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect.
raw.description:
At Luscii, we develop several applications within the OMRON Digital Health Circle, including the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. Together, we build technology that makes healthcare more accessible, giving patients and healthcare professionals more space to focus on care. As a MobileDeveloper, you will contribute to this mission by developing and improving the applications that connect people, devices and healthcare.

Our digital health solutions enable healthcare professionals to monitor patients remotely, helping people receive the right care in the right place. You will work across our mobile applications, creating reliable, intuitive and high-performing experiences for patients and healthcare professionals alike.

Beyond developing and improving our apps, you will help shape our technical direction, explore new technologies and share your expertise with colleagues. You will have the autonomy to take ownership, make technical decisions and contribute beyond your immediate responsibilities, supported by Luscii's Holacratic way of working.

Your role

As a Mobile Developer at Luscii, you will take ownership of the development, optimisation and maintenance of our mobile applications across iOS and Android. You bring ideas to life, make well-considered technical decisions and help ensure our applications remain performant, stable, scalable and easy to maintain.

You will work closely with colleagues across development, QA and support, combining hands-on engineering with technical ownership. Whether you are building a new feature, exploring a technology through a proof of concept or resolving a production issue, you will help us continuously improve the quality and usability of our digital health solutions.

What you will be doing:

  • Develop, maintain and optimise mobile applications using native technologies such as Kotlin and Swift, with a focus on performance, stability and user experience.

  • Contribute to mobile architecture, technical design and modular codebases, applying clean architecture, object-oriented design principles and patterns such as MVVM and MVI.

  • Build intuitive user interfaces using technologies such as Jetpack Compose and SwiftUI, following platform-specific design guidelines.

  • Develop and maintain features that communicate with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices, as well as web services, cloud platforms and APIs.

  • Build prototypes and proof of concepts to explore new technologies, validate technical approaches and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Investigate and resolve production issues through debugging and performance analysis, covering areas such as memory management, multithreading and networking.

  • Contribute to code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD processes, sharing technical knowledge and helping colleagues make sound implementation decisions.

Why Luscii?

Read more about working at Luscii and how we work at Luscii/OMRON. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy.

Most important benefits

  • Salary: € 4.600 - € 5.900 gross per month (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii).

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii.

  • Flexible setup: Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here.

The ideal candidate…

… probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for somebody who is comfortable in taking ownership and making well-considered decisions independently. You enjoy the autonomy to shape your work and responsibilities, while actively seeking collaboration and alignment with others.

You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust.

  • You have at least five years of experience in mobile development, with a strong background in native Android and/or iOS development. You have extensive experience with Kotlin and/or Swift.

  • You have a relevant bachelor's degree, for example in Computer Science or Computer Engineering and you are familiar with working in an Agile environment.

  • You have a solid understanding of mobile architecture and software design principles, including clean architecture, object-oriented design, MVVM and/or MVI. You know how to build and maintain modular applications.

  • You have experience with mobile development frameworks and tools such as Jetpack Compose, SwiftUI, Kotlin Coroutines, Flow and Kotlin Multiplatform. You are also familiar with unit testing and/or UI testing, CI/CD pipelines and platform-specific design guidelines.

  • You understand what it takes to build reliable, high-performing mobile applications, including memory management, multithreading, networking, debugging and optimisation. You have experience integrating web services, cloud technologies, APIs and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices.

  • You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities;

  • English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language.

Interested? Apply now!

Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via

What does the recruitment process look like?

We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum.

Highlights

Work on mobile applications apps that make a real difference in healthcare. Put your expertise into action and help create more space for care.

0.00

M-F 8am to 5pm

Remote Work Notification

ATTENTION: Archimedes is only able to offer remote work to residents of Alabama, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Indiana, Illinois, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Maryland, Minnesota, Missouri, New Hampshire, New Jersey, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Wisconsin.

Overview

Archimedes is seeking a Part-Time Medical Director to join our team!

The Medical Director provides physician leadership and clinical oversight for utilization management and value-based coverage activities across pharmacy and medical benefits. The role reviews prior authorization cases, applies benefit design and coverage criteria, evaluates clinical evidence and comparative effectiveness, and incorporates health economics and cost-effectiveness into sound, member-centered coverage decisions. The Medical Director participates in clinical governance committees, including Pharmacy and Therapeutics (P&T), and partners with internal and external stakeholders to support consistent, evidence-based, compliant, and financially responsible care.

The Medical Director serves as a senior clinical resource for complex and high-cost cases, with particular value placed on expertise in oncology, gastroenterology, or dermatology. The Medical Director interprets applicable benefits, policies, clinical guidelines, treatment pathways, and emerging evidence; conducts peer-to-peer discussions when appropriate; contributes to policy and criteria development; and communicates clear medical rationale to clinicians, clients, members, and business partners.

Is this you? Find out more below!

Responsibilities

How do I make an impact on my team?

  • Review prior authorization, utilization management, and complex clinical cases across pharmacy and medical benefits, applying coverage criteria, benefit language, clinical evidence, and sound medical judgment.
  • Make timely, consistent, evidence-based determinations that consider safety, efficacy, comparative effectiveness, member-specific circumstances, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Interpret plan benefits, coverage policies, clinical criteria, contractual requirements, and applicable regulatory standards when evaluating cases.
  • Conduct peer-to-peer consultations with treating clinicians and communicate the clinical rationale for determinations clearly, respectfully, and accurately.
  • Participate as a voting or advisory physician member on P&T, utilization management, quality, clinical policy, and other governance committees as assigned.
  • Evaluate published literature, clinical guidelines, real-world evidence, treatment pathways, budget impact, and pharmacoeconomic analyses to inform coverage policy and formulary recommendations.
  • Support the development, review, and maintenance of medical necessity criteria, utilization management policies, clinical programs, and value-based coverage strategies.
  • Provide clinical leadership for specialty medications and high-cost therapies, with preference for expertise in oncology, gastroenterology, or dermatology.
  • Partner across Clinical, Pharmacy, Medical Management, Legal, Compliance, Account Management, Operations, and Analytics to align clinical quality, member experience, affordability, and client commitments.
  • Monitor utilization, quality, financial, and operational trends; identify improvement opportunities; and recommend interventions that enhance outcomes and total cost of care.
  • Present clinical analyses, policy recommendations, program outcomes, and value propositions to executives, clients, committees, and other stakeholders.
  • Promote consistent decision-making, documentation quality, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement through physician education, case calibration, and clinical consultation.
  • Provide guidance with integrity, fairness, credibility, and independence while balancing individual clinical needs with responsible stewardship of healthcare resources.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

What our team expects from you?

  • Part-time position.
  • Doctor of Medicine (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree from an accredited institution required. Completion of an accredited residency program required.
  • Current, unrestricted license to practice medicine in at least one U.S. state required. Must maintain all licenses, credentials, and board certifications required by law, accreditation standards, organizational policy, and client contracts. Ability to obtain additional state licenses may be required. Board certification in a recognized medical specialty preferred.
  • 10 years of overall medical experience, including direct clinical practice and/or physician leadership responsibilities, required.
  • 5 years of leadership experience in a managed healthcare, health plan, PBM, utilization management, or comparable healthcare environment preferred.
  • Demonstrated understanding of health economics, value-based coverage, comparative effectiveness, budget impact, and cost-effectiveness in clinical decision-making required.
  • Demonstrated understanding of PBM and managed care clinical programs and practices, contracting, products and services, cost structures, pricing, and business practices required.
  • Specialty training or substantial clinical experience in oncology, gastroenterology, or dermatology preferred.
  • Experience participating in P&T, utilization management, quality, or clinical policy committees required; experience presenting recommendations to executive or client audiences preferred.
  • Specialty expertise in oncology, gastroenterology, or dermatology preferred.
  • Experience evaluating specialty medications, biologics, infused therapies, or other high-cost treatments across pharmacy and medical benefits preferred.
  • Experience with clinical policy development, technology assessment, evidence review, pharmacoeconomics, or value-based care arrangements preferred.
  • Experience communicating complex medical and economic concepts to clinicians, clients, members, executives, and nonclinical stakeholders preferred.
  • Participate in, adhere to, and support compliance program objectives.
  • The ability to consistently interact cooperatively and respectfully with other employees.

Achter elke klantvraag zit een verhaal. Als klantenservice medewerker voor bol neem jij de tijd om dat verhaal te begrijpen en help je klanten met een passende oplossing. Je staat klanten te woord via telefoon, chat en e-mail en krijgt daarbij de ruimte om zelf mee te denken en oplossingen te bieden.

Want pas als je de situatie écht begrijpt, kun je het verschil maken. Stel dat een klant een camera heeft besteld om foto's te maken van een pasgeboren baby. Dan snap je meteen waarom een vertraagde levering meer is dan zomaar een te late bestelling.

Daarom kijk je verder dan de vraag alleen. Je denkt mee, neemt verantwoordelijkheid en zoekt naar de beste oplossing voor de klant. Daarbij krijg je veel vrijheid. Oplossingsgericht én creatief ondernemen juichen wij toe. Die verantwoordelijkheid krijg je. En we juichen nog harder als jij die oplossing deelt met je team, zodat we er samen beter van worden!

Wat ga je doen?

  • Klanten helpen via telefoon, chat en e-mail

  • Vragen beantwoorden over bestellingen, leveringen en producten

  • Zelfstandig passende oplossingen bedenken

  • Signaleren van verbeteringen en deze delen met je team

  • Elke dag bijdragen aan een uitstekende klantbeleving

Herken jij jezelf hierin?Jij bent iemand die:

  • Goed kan luisteren en zich makkelijk in anderen verplaatst

  • Graag problemen oplost en initiatief neemt

  • Ondernemend en oplossingsgericht denkt

  • Snel schakelt tussen verschillende systemen

  • Klanten altijd nét dat stapje extra wil bieden

  • Ervaring in klantenservice is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste. Wij leren je graag de rest.

Requirements

Goed om te weten:

  • Je ontvangt een salaris vanaf circa € 2.648 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring

  • Je werkt 100% vanuit huis

  • Je werkt op je eigen laptop of computer

  • Je contract bedraagt 24 tot 40 uur per week

  • Je bent beschikbaar op zaterdag

  • Je werkt binnen de openingstijden maandag t/m zaterdag tussen 08:00 en 20:00 uur

  • Je volgt vooraf een volledig betaalde fulltime training van 2 weken, online vanuit huis

  • Daarnaast ontvang je een thuiswerkvergoeding en onregelmatigheidstoeslagen wanneer van toepassing

  • Voor deze functie heb je een eigen, goed werkende laptop/computer nodig.

Waarom werken voor bol via TP?Je werkt voor één van de bekendste merken van Nederland, vanuit je eigen huis. Daarbij krijg je veel vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en de kans om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Ben jij klantgericht, oplossingsgericht en klaar om klanten écht blij te maken? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Solliciteer vandaag nog en wie weet word jij wel dé nieuwe stem voor bol!

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Technical Architecture: Act as a Technical Architect on Salesforce projects, delivering end-to-end monetization and connectivity solutions powered by Salesforce Revenue Cloud (RLM), Communications Cloud, and Data Cloud.
  • Discovery and Design: Lead technical discovery sessions and design workshops to capture complex requirements from telecommunications and digital service providers, translating them into scalable designs aligned with Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) processes and BSS/OSS architectures.
  • Implementation & Monetization: Design and govern the implementation of core catalog, pricing, and telecom modules, including Revenue Lifecycle Management (RLM), Enterprise Product Catalog (EPC), Industries/Revenue CPQ, Subscription Management, Order Management (OM), and MACD (Move, Add, Change, Disconnect) orchestration.
  • Integration and Interoperability: Architect Salesforce integrations with external financial and operational systems (Billing/Rating engines, Payment Gateways, ERPs, Taxation engines, and network orchestrators) using REST/SOAP APIs, TM Forum Open APIs, Apex, LWC, and middleware solutions like MuleSoft.
  • Client Engagement: Partner with executive stakeholders (CIOs, CTOs, Enterprise Architects) to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions. Communicate complex concepts like Asset-Based Ordering (ABO), Usage-Based Billing (UBB), and Headless Commerce architectures clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Technical Expertise:

  • Revenue & CPQ Mastery: Hands-on experience with implementation, data architecture, and custom development in Salesforce Revenue Cloud (RLM), Salesforce Billing, and Communications Cloud (formerly Vlocity).
  • Tools and Frameworks: Strong knowledge of Product Catalog Management, Pricing Procedures, Business Rules Engine (BRE), and the OmniStudio suite (FlexCards, OmniScripts, Integration Procedures, DataRaptors).
  • Salesforce Development: Deep expertise in native platform development (Apex, Lightning Web Components, ConnectApi, SOQL) to build custom transactional flows, complex integrations, and asynchronous processes.
  • Client Focus: Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust, manage expectations, and prioritize multiple client engagements effectively.

Preferred Qualifications:

• AI-Assisted Development (Desirable): Familiarity with generative AI tools and assistants for code generation, debugging, and architectural refinement (e.g., Einstein for Developers, Agentforce, GitHub Copilot, or prompt-driven development processes).
• Salesforce Certifications: Preference for architecture, CPQ, and industry-focused credentials, such as:
Salesforce Revenue Cloud Accredited Professional / CPQ Specialist
Salesforce Billing Accredited Professional
Salesforce Communications Cloud Accredited Professional
Salesforce OmniStudio Developer / Consultant

Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant

Salesforce Application Architect / System Architect
• Delivery Methodologies: Familiarity with Agile (Scrum, SAFe) or hybrid project delivery methodologies and governance.


Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance andbe your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you cando your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. raw.description:
Overview

Position Summary:

The Finance Transformation Lead is a hands-on technology, data and process-automation leader responsible for advancing modernization across Finance. The role partners with Finance leadership to set priorities and leads the work of the Finance Innovation & Transformation Center of Excellence (FIT COE) through matrix leadership; FIT COE members remain in their functional reporting lines.

The Finance Transformation Lead complements Finance’s process expertise with technical and delivery capability. This individual works with leaders and subject-matter experts to understand current processes, identify opportunities, recommend future-state approaches, and translate business needs into practical technology solutions. The role leads selected initiatives from discovery through implementation and sustainment, and helps Finance adopt automation, analytics and artificial intelligence responsibly.

Geo-Salary Information

An in-person interview may be required during the hiring process

State specific pay scales for this role are as follows:$114,602 to $168,083 (NJ, NY, WA, HI, AK, MD, CT, RI, MA)

$104,184 to $152,803 (NV, OR, AZ, CO, WY, TX, ND, MN, MO, IL, WI, FL, GA, MI, OH, VA, PA, DE, VT, NH, ME)

$93,766 to $137,523 (UT, ID, MT, NM, SD, NE, KS, OK, IA, AR, LA, MS, AL, TN, KY, IN, SC, NC, WV)

In CA: Typical hiring range is $114,602 to $168,083.

The expected base salary for this position will vary depending on a number of factors, including relevant experience, skills and location.

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

Lead Finance modernization priorities

  • Partner with Finance leadership to identify, assess and prioritize modernization opportunities across Finance, aligning work to business objectives, value, feasibility, risk and available capacity.
  • Lead technology-enabled process improvement using data, coding, analytics, automation, workflow and artificial intelligence to improve accuracy, efficiency, control effectiveness and scalability.
  • Personally lead selected complex initiatives from discovery and solution design through implementation, adoption and sustainment.

Guide discovery and future-state design

  • Facilitate discovery with Finance leaders and subject-matter experts to understand current processes, objectives, pain points, data, controls, risks and dependencies.
  • Research relevant technologies and leading practices; recommend practical future-state processes, solution options and implementation approaches rather than relying on stakeholders to define the technical solution.
  • Develop prioritized opportunities, business cases, solution designs, delivery plans and measurable outcomes; help leaders make informed tradeoffs.
  • Translate business needs into clear requirements and coordinate with MTS/IT, Data Science and other enterprise partners through solution validation and delivery.

Establish scalable delivery and governance

  • Establish practical standards for intake, prioritization, solution design, controls, testing, documentation, change management, adoption and sustainment.
  • Engage control partners as appropriate and ensure AI-enabled workflows have clear human oversight, decision rights, approval thresholds, exception paths and monitoring.
  • Build reusable solution patterns and delivery practices, with clear business ownership, support arrangements and continuous-improvement plans after go-live.
  • Manage the Finance innovation portfolio, tracking priorities, dependencies, risks, resources, baselines, target outcomes and benefits realization.

Lead the FIT COE and Finance enablement

  • Lead the FIT COE’s matrixed work by setting priorities and team cadences, coordinating commitments, removing obstacles, and tracking initiatives through delivery and sustainment.
  • Coach and guide FIT COE members through project pairing, feedback, knowledge sharing and consistent delivery practices.
  • Serve as Finance’s innovation champion and partner with champions across Mercury to share ideas, practices and opportunities for collaboration.
  • Partner with Enterprise AI Enablement, MTS/IT and other teams to educate Finance employees on practical and responsible use of approved AI tools.
  • Organize Finance-wide innovation and learning initiatives.

Other

  • Perform other job duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education:

Minimum:

  • Bachelor’s degree in technology, information systems, data analytics, engineering, business, finance or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and directly related experience.

Preferred:

  • Master’s degree or relevant professional certification in technology, data, finance, project management or organizational change.

Experience:

Minimum:

  • 8 or more years of progressive experience in technology delivery, data engineering or analytics, process engineering, automation, business transformation or a related field.
  • Experience delivering cross-functional technology, data or automation solutions from discovery and requirements through testing, adoption and sustainment.
  • Demonstrated strong hands-on experience developing code, applying data analytics and implementing process automation using SQL and Python.
  • Hands-on experience building AI agents, AI-enabled workflows or process automations.
  • Experience using AI-assisted coding and rapid prototyping with appropriate attention to security, privacy, data governance, testing and human oversight.
  • Experience working with Finance processes or partnering with Finance teams; familiarity across multiple Finance functions.
  • Experience leading matrixed initiatives and influencing, coaching or coordinating contributors without formal reporting authority.
  • Experience partnering with technology, data and control or risk teams in a governed business environment.

Preferred:

  • Deeper experience applying AI to enterprise business problems is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in property and casualty insurance or related financial services.
  • Experience managing technology-enabled capabilities through ongoing ownership, performance measurement and continuous improvement.

Knowledge and Skills:

Minimum:

  • Strong Python and SQL skills, including the ability to write, test, troubleshoot and maintain code; hands-on capability in data analytics and process automation.
  • Ability to understand current-state processes, connect business needs with data and technology, and recommend practical future-state solutions.
  • Experience with building AI agents, AI-enabled automation or AI-assisted coding/prototyping, and ability to help others adopt approved tools responsibly.
  • Curiosity, initiative and learning agility; willingness to work hands-on, investigate unfamiliar problems and continuously build technical and business knowledge.
  • Ability to lead through influence without formal authority, build trust, align stakeholders, facilitate decisions and create accountability across matrixed teams.
  • Strong collaboration and situational leadership skills, including the ability to coach others and organize cross-functional work.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills; ability to explain technical concepts and recommendations clearly to business and technology audiences.
  • Ability to prioritize and deliver multiple initiatives, balancing business value, feasibility, risk, effort and cost of delay.
  • Sound judgment in applying automation and AI, including process simplification, human oversight, controls, exception handling, privacy and user experience.

Preferred:

  • Familiarity with enterprise technology and data platforms, workflow tools, business intelligence, low-code/no-code automation or process mining.
  • Experience establishing AI or automation governance, training programs, communities of practice or champion networks.
  • Familiarity with financial reporting, internal controls, auditability or operational resilience.

Pay Range

USD $101,167.00 - USD $204,439.00 /Yr.

About the Company

Why choose a career at Mercury?

At Mercury, we have been guided by our purpose to help people reduce risk and overcome unexpected events for more than 60 years. We are one team with a common goal to help others. Everyone needs insurance and we can’t imagine a world without it.

Our team will encourage you to grow, make time to have fun, and work together to make great things happen. We embrace the strengths and values of each team member. We believe in having diverse perspectives where everyone is included, to serve customers from all walks of life.

We care about our people, and we mean it. We reward our talented professionals with a competitive salary, bonus potential, and a variety of benefits to help our team members reach their health, retirement, and professional goals.

Learn more about us here:

Perks and Benefits

We offer many great benefits, including:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexibility to work from anywhere in the United States for most positions
  • Paid time off (vacation time, sick time, 9 paid Company holidays, volunteer hours)
  • Incentive bonus programs (potential for holiday bonus, referral bonus, and performance-based bonus)
  • Medical, dental, vision, life, and pet insurance
  • 401 (k) retirement savings plan with company match
  • Engaging work environment
  • Promotional opportunities
  • Education assistance
  • Professional and personal development opportunities
  • Company recognition program
  • Health and wellbeing resources, including free mental wellbeing therapy/coaching sessions, child and eldercare resources, and more

Mercury Insurance is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Mercury is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities who need assistance with the application and/or employment consideration process. If you require an accommodation, you may contact us by sending an e-mail to . Please include your name, contact information, and a description of your requested accommodation in your message.

About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the role

The Channel Account Executive role at Rippling provides an extremely unique opportunity -- we’re looking for talented and ambitious AEs who can both manage a high velocity sales cycle while also navigating a very strategic sales process. In addition, have a proven ability to work with channel partners to create pipeline via referrals.

As an early member of the channel team, you get to help shape the future of the program. With Rippling investing significantly in the broker channel, your role has an incredible impact on the future of the company. As an added bonus, Channel AEs are expected to take partners out to do fun events such as golf, dinners, sporting events, concerts, etc.

What you will do

  • Create and build relationships with Insurance Brokers
  • Build pipeline of opportunities through referrals from broker partners
  • Manage pipeline in Salesforce to accurately forecast revenue
  • Run sales calls with short deck presentation and detailed product demo
  • Close business and achieve quota attainment consistently
  • Become a product expert across our entire platform and understand our competitor landscape
  • Work closely with CSM team to ensure a smooth transition for new customers

What you will need

  • 5+ years sales experience, particularly in SaaS markets selling B2B
  • Experience carrying $650+ annual quota
  • Proven track record of success (top 10% of sales org)
  • Previous experience selling HRIS/HCM software and/or selling security related products
  • Ability to thrive in a fast paced environment

Additional Information

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email .

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a 40 mile radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

This role will receive a competitive On-Target Earnings (base salary + sales commission) + benefits + equity. The On-Target Earnings* for US-based employees will be 60/40 commission split for base/variable pay, and aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.

A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below.

Job Description

1,142 to 1,220 USD

 ◦ MyCase

 ◦ Microsoft Outlook

 ◦ Online scheduling and digital payment platforms

Required Skills  

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Empathetic and patient client service approach
  • Ability to acknowledge and validate clients’ concerns professionally
  • Strong active listening and telephone communication skills
  • Professional judgment when handling sensitive and confidential information
  • Strong organizational and file management abilities

  • High attention to detail when preparing agreements and maintaining client records
  • Ability to collect and document accurate intake information
  • Confidence discussing appointments, representation agreements, and payment procedures
  • Dependable, helpful, and service oriented attitude

raw.description:
Job Description:

We are seeking a Senior Claims Examiner I to join our team. This role is designed for an independent, self-sufficient professional responsible for managing death claims of moderate complexity. In this position, you will ensure accurate and timely claim processing in alignment with contract provisions, company policies, and regulatory requirements. While you will independently handle routine and moderately complex cases, highly complex or non-standard claims will be escalated for further review.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and adjudicate standard and moderately complex life and annuity claims in compliance with policies and regulations.
  • Processing claims for our RPS line of business, may also handle Life and Annuity lines of business in combination with RPS.
  • Adjudicates and pays claims within established service level agreements (SLAs) up to $1M.
  • Validate beneficiary designations and process payments accurately within documented procedures and team SLAs.
  • Applies established procedures and regulatory guidelines to determine if requests are in “good order.”
  • Identify and escalate highly complex or unusual cases to senior team members or management.
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation for all claims handled.
  • Communicate effectively with beneficiaries, agents, and internal stakeholders to resolve inquiries and champion strong relationship building and customer service.
  • Navigate multiple administrative systems, workflows, and imaging tools simultaneously with a high level of organization and attention according to standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Participate in training and development activities to enhance technical knowledge and skills.

Leidos is establishing a new Global Customs Advisor role to further mature and strengthen its enterprise Global Trade compliance program. The Global Customs Advisor will play an important role in the execution, maintenance, and continuous improvement of Leidos’ customs compliance framework, including broker oversight, policy and procedures, compliance monitoring, recordkeeping, data integrity, tools, and training.

As key member of the Global Customs pillar within Global Trade, the Global Customs Advisor will independently manage assigning compliance activities and initiatives, assess complex customs matters, and contribute to the development and implementation of practical, risk-based solutions. Reporting to the Director, Global Customs, the Advisor will collaborate closely with customs broker/freight forwarders, Global Trade colleagues, program and business stakeholders, Legal, and other functions across the enterprise.

The successful candidate will bring strong analytical and problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and practical experience in customs and import compliance. The successful candidate will demonstrate intellectual curiosity, initiative, and pragmatic approach to compliance, along with the ability to communicate effectively, collaborate, and work independently while contributing to a high-performing team.

This is a remote position, with proximity to Reston, VA preferred.



Key Responsibilities

  • Support customs compliance activities and operations by accurately classifying goods under the Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS/Schedule B), processing ATA Carnets, applying Chapter 98 special classification provisions, certificate of origin review, duty management and preparing and validating customs value declarations to ensure compliance with all applicable import trade regulations
  • Monitor developments in customs laws, regulations, enforcement practices, as well as assess their potential impact on Leidos' operations and recommend appropriate updates to customs compliance processes and controls
  • Monitor customs broker and freight forwarder activities, including reviewing import documentation, identifying discrepancies, and coordinating corrective actions
  • In coordination with the Director, Global Customs, conduct risk-based compliance reviews and self-assessments to identify control gaps, evaluate compliance risks, and recommend corrective actions and process improvements
  • Develop, maintain, and implement customs policies, procedures, work instructions, and guidance to promote consistent compliance practices
  • Monitor customs data quality, integrity, and recordkeeping practices, as well as identifying deficiencies and coordinating improvements with relevant stakeholders
  • Develop and maintain customs metrics to monitor customs performance, identify trends, and assess compliance program effectiveness
  • Support customs-related regulatory filings, audits, investigations, and corrective actions
  • Identify opportunities to enhance customs compliance processes through technology, automation, and data analysis, and support the development and delivery of related training
  • Collaborate with Global Trade colleagues, business stakeholders, customs brokers, freight forwarders, and other internal and external partners to resolve compliance matters and facilitate efficient business operations
  • Other duties as assigned


Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree and 6+ years of prior relevant experience or Advanced Degree with 4+ years prior relevant experience
  • Thorough knowledge of U.S. Customs laws and regulations, including experience with tariff classification, customs valuation, country of origin, and duty mitigation programs, including Free Trade Agreements (FTA).
  • Experience conducting customs compliance reviews and assessments, including addressing findings, identifying risks, and implementing corrective actions
  • Experience working with customs brokers, freight forwarders, and internal business stakeholders to resolve customs compliance matters
  • Working knowledge of U.S. export control and sanctions regimes,
  • Ability to interpret complex laws and regulations and translate them into clear, practical, risk-based guidance for the business
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, including the demonstrated ability to analyze data and metrics to identify trends, evaluate risk, and support decision-making
  • Experience with trade compliance systems, enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, or other technology supporting customs operations
  • Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented, with the ability to prioritize and make independent decisions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and all levels of the organization
  • Must be a U.S. person as defined in ITAR §120.62
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Licensed Customs Broker or relevant trade compliance certification (e.g., Certified Customs Specialist)
  • Experience with customs laws and regulations outside the U.S., specifically Australia and U.K.
  • Experience supporting CBP inquiries, rulings, or other regulatory proceedings
  • Experience in U.S. federal government contracting, aerospace/defense, or high-technology sectors involving controlled technologies or classified programs
  • Experience improving or automating customs compliance processes, including integrating customs requirements into procurement, supply chain, logistics, or other business operations
  • Proximity to Reston, Virginia
  • Current Secret security clearance

We’re looking for talented estate agents with the drive to build their own business as a Territory Owner under the Yopa franchise.

Yopa is one of the largest estate agency brands in the UK. Our service rivals the high street, while our unique technology-led offering gives customers a reason to choose us over the competition. We sell homes for a fair fixed fee that saves the average customer £2,800 (£6,000 in London), while also offering a No Sale, No Fee option that isn’t available with our main competitors. Our award-winning hybrid service has been named the best of its kind in the UK, and we’re rated ‘excellent’ by Trustpilot based on thousands of customer reviews.

As a Territory Owner, you will have your own postcodes and the opportunity to grow your business without limits, with full control over your own agenda and helped by a team of Territory Managers. You’ll be building your own agency, but far from being alone, you will be part of a close-knit regional team and benefit from everything Yopa has to offer in terms of business support, including:

  • Fantastic free lead generation, with a focus on quality, from the central Yopa team with appointments booked in for you.
  • Extra financial incentive for self-generated leads.
  • Multiple revenue streams to help you diversify your business and income, including rewards for referring customers to our partnered conveyancers and our sister company Scout Financial Services.
  • The option to set your own commission rates with No Sale, No Fee.
  • The autonomy to run your own business with flexible hours that fit your existing commitments, and the freedom to employ your own team.
  • No earnings cap - the only limit is your potential.
  • An in-house marketing team providing personalised support, with free money every month to spend on marketing materials.
  • Unique schemes that help you build your business’s visibility in the local area, such as Yopa’s successful Tech for Schools sponsorship programme.
  • The full support of a team in our Contact Centres, including your own Personal Property Adviser to help your business stay in touch with your customers.
  • Ongoing training and support from the Learning and Development team, mentorship from your Regional Director, and regular meetings with fellow colleagues and business owners.

In return, we’re looking for estate agents who:

  • Already have strong experience in the world of estate agency, with a proven track record in valuing and listing homes, and who can confidently see the buying and selling journey through to completion.
  • Demonstrate exceptional levels of customer service, with the willingness to help customers outside of ‘office hours’ and go the extra mile for that sale.
  • Self-starters with the drive to build a long-term business that goes beyond the end of the month or the next paycheck.

If you’re a passionate estate agent who wants to own your own business, benefit from first-in-class support, and help build the future of estate agency, we want to hear from you!

raw.excerpt: L’Expérience Aviva Individuellement, nous sommes des personnes, mais ensemble, nous formons Aviva.
raw.description:
L’Expérience Aviva

Individuellement, nous sommes des personnes, mais ensemble, nous formons Aviva. Ces mots prennent tout leur sens lorsqu’ils deviennent nos valeurs : Bienveillance, Engagement, Collectivité et Confiance.

À Aviva Canada, nous plaçons les gens au premier plan : nos employés, nos clients et nos collectivités. Nous sommes fiers d’une culture fondée sur la bienveillance, l’inclusion et la collaboration, où votre voix compte et votre développement est soutenu. Nous ne faisons pas que de l’assurance; nous faisons une réelle différence en protégeant ce qui compte le plus.

L’Opportunité

Aviva Canada est actuellement à la recherche d’un(e) conseiller(ère) en prévention des risques pour se joindre à l’équipe Solutions de gestion des risques Aviva (ARMS) au sein de notre division Assurance des entreprises.

Dans ce rôle, vous effectuerez des évaluations des risques chez nos clients, préparerez des rapports techniques et agirez à titre de conseiller(ère) de confiance en matière de prévention des pertes et de gestion des risques.

Il s’agit d’un poste permanent en télétravail offrant une grande autonomie, une voiture de fonction et une combinaison intéressante de gestion de comptes, d’ingénierie sur le terrain et d’accompagnement technique. Des déplacements fréquents à travers le Québec sont requis, ainsi que certains déplacements à l’échelle nationale. Les déplacements avec nuitées ou sans représenteront environ 30 % à 50 % du temps.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Effectuer des visites de prévention des risques afin d’évaluer les risques liés aux biens, à la responsabilité civile des produits et aux entrepreneurs en construction.
  • Préparer des rapports techniques de gestion des risques et de souscription.
  • Fournir un soutien-conseil technique aux souscripteurs et recommander des mesures visant à réduire l’exposition aux risques.
  • Maintenir des services de gestion des risques conformes aux normes d’ARMS, notamment en matière de qualité, de délais et de rentabilité.
  • Développer et maintenir des relations solides avec les courtiers, les clients, les partenaires d’affaires et les équipes internes.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les collègues et les partenaires afin d’améliorer continuellement l’expérience client et les services offerts.

Ce que vous apporterez

  • Diplôme collégial ou universitaire en ingénierie, prévention, gestion des risques ou domaine connexe.
  • Plus de cinq ans d’expérience en prévention des pertes liées aux biens, incluant les risques complexes et les risques hautement protégés (HPR).
  • Capacité à interpréter les plans de gicleurs, de pompes incendie, de systèmes d’extinction et les résultats d’essais hydrauliques.
  • Capacité à analyser des plans architecturaux, structuraux, mécaniques et électriques.
  • Excellente connaissance des codes du bâtiment et de prévention des incendies nord-américains, des normes NFPA ainsi que des normes reconnues de l’industrie telles que Factory Mutual .
  • Compréhension approfondie de l’ingénierie des scénarios de pertes complexes (MFL, PML et NLE).
  • Maîtrise de la suite Microsoft Office.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en rédaction technique.
  • Capacité démontrée à travailler de façon autonome tout en favorisant un fort esprit de collaboration.
  • Excellentes habiletés en communication et en relations interpersonnelles.
  • Permis de conduire valide et passeport valide ou admissibilité à l’obtenir.
  • Disponibilité à voyager fréquemment (environ 80 % du temps au Québec et 20 % ailleurs au Canada).
  • La connaissance du français est requise.
  • La maîtrise de l’anglais de niveau intermédiaire avancé est exigée en raison de la nature des tâches, des outils de travail et des interactions fréquentes avec des partenaires, des collègues, des courtiers et des clients anglophones partout au Canada.

Mon avantage unique

  • Expérience en gestion de comptes.
  • Expérience auprès d’entrepreneurs et de risques liés au secteur de la construction.
  • Détention ou poursuite d’un titre professionnel pertinent en gestion des risques ou en prévention des pertes (TPI, TAPI, CET, NICET, CFPS, CRM ou CIP).

Ce que vous gagnerez

  • Un programme de rémunération complet comprenant le salaire de base, l’admissibilité à une prime annuelle, un régime d’épargne-retraite, un plan d’actionnariat, des avantages santé, des initiatives de bien-être et des occasions de bénévolat.
  • Un modèle de travail flexible.
  • Des occasions exceptionnelles de développement professionnel et d’avancement de carrière.
  • Du soutien pour votre formation et votre développement professionnel continus.
  • Un régime de vacances concurrentiel avec la possibilité d’acheter jusqu’à cinq jours supplémentaires par année.
  • Des groupes et programmes dirigés par les employés favorisant la diversité, l’équité et l’inclusion.
  • Des programmes de bien-être conçus pour soutenir la santé physique et mentale de nos employés.

Leidos is currently seeking a Senior Solution Architect to join our SMIT Growth Team. The Senior Solution Architect will be responsible for providing technical leadership and delivering innovative, compliant technical solutions that address complex specific customer business requirements. This role involves designing and validating technical solutions, documenting requirements, developing appropriate business models and ensuring alignment with customer objectives. Selected candidate may also serve as a BOE or BOM estimator or author at times, including providing supporting rationale, substantiation, and assumptions. The SMIT Solution Architect works independently to lead cross functional teams including distinguished architects, DEV Ops engineering, cyber security staff, project management, and the end customer to complete technical Request for Proposals (RFPs) proposals (solutions) that meet or exceed customer requirements and meet SMIT contractual performance requirement. Key responsibilities include applying Agile methodologies, defining, and managing business requirements, and leading cross-functional project execution to drive efficiency and innovation on multiple simultaneous task order proposals. This role also requires deep expertise in quality assurance, test planning, and change management, ensuring solutions meet compliance standards and business goals. Additionally, the Solution Architect will support risk assessment, system integration, and performance validation, while effectively communicating technical strategies to internal teams and clients. The ideal candidate will have strong analytical, collaboration, and communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions. They must confidently engage with technical resources and suppliers, influence client decision-making, and contribute to the development of competitive, high-quality proposals. Works individually, in teams or as leader, to determine customer requirements in complex and often ambiguous outsourced environments. Interact effectively with team, pursuit leaders, internal governance, and business leadership to advance sales efforts.


Primary responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Lead technical solution strategy sessions on assigned proposals
  • Lead solution coordination of internal technical areas (e.g., network, cyber, cloud, application, infrastructure (Power/Cooling), construction), consolidation and reviews for proposals, ROMs and other responses to Government requests.
  • Support efforts to enhance standard solution libraries in support of organization-wide solution and BOE/BOM definitions and customer RFP/Contract negotiations.

o Equipment installation, cabling, rack mounting

o Cyber Security

o Virtual Infrastructure

o Rack/equipment cabling

o Cyber Security

o Cloud computing

o Telecommunications

  • Prior experience in delivering many solutions in a high-volume Task Order environment
  • Experience in translating end user requirements and acquisition strategy then mapping into technical solutions and generating business models to support both end user mission and business needs.
  • Experience in generating, reviewing, and/or validating basis of estimates for highly complex acquisition and engineering solutions.
  • Significant experience in training peers, Department of War US Navy USMC and other end users, executives, and others on acquisition, engineering, and other related tasks.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, lead geographically disparate teams, and create original content using interview and research techniques
  • Experience working in large information technology enterprise environments
  • Experience with requirements analysis and/or architecture synthesis and design
  • Experience in collaborating with other enterprise technologists both internal and external to resolve complex technical issues
  • Cybersecurity frameworks, including Risk Management Framework (RMF) and Zero Trust Architecture
  • Networking technologies (including SD-WAN, MPLS, VLANs, and network security)
