About StaffHero

StaffHero connects businesses with highly skilled remote professionals, primarily from the Philippines, to help organizations scale efficiently and affordably. We provide end-to-end workforce solutions, including recruitment, onboarding, training, payroll, compliance, and workforce management.

Position Overview

StaffHero is seeking a highly organized and patient-focused Bilingual Intake Coordinator fluent in Cantonese and English to support a U.S.-based home healthcare organization.

The ideal candidate must have previous experience working in a Home Care, Home Health Agency (HHA), or a closely related home-based healthcare setting. Direct experience handling patient intake, referral coordination, admissions, or related administrative processes is essential.

The successful candidate will serve as an initial point of contact for patients, family members, and referral sources, assisting with intake inquiries, gathering patient information, coordinating documentation, and facilitating the admissions process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Handle incoming calls and inquiries from patients, family members, healthcare providers, and referral sources.
  • Communicate effectively with Cantonese-speaking and English-speaking patients and families.
  • Manage patient intake and referral requests for home care or home health services.
  • Collect, verify, and document patient demographics, medical information, insurance details, and other required intake information.
  • Follow up with patients, families, and referral sources to obtain missing documents and information.
  • Coordinate with clinical, administrative, and scheduling teams to ensure referrals and intake requests are processed efficiently.
  • Explain intake requirements, available services, and next steps clearly to patients and their families.
  • Monitor pending referrals and follow up to prevent delays in the admissions process.
  • Maintain accurate and updated patient records in the organization's systems.
  • Escalate clinical questions, urgent concerns, and complex inquiries to the appropriate personnel.
  • Ensure all patient information is handled in accordance with HIPAA and applicable privacy requirements.
  • Provide timely updates to internal teams regarding intake progress and outstanding requirements.

Qualifications

Required

  • Fluent in Cantonese and English, with strong verbal communication skills in both languages.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in Home Care, Home Health Agency (HHA), or a closely related home-based healthcare environment.
  • Previous experience handling patient intake, referral coordination, admissions, or similar home healthcare processes.
  • Experience communicating with patients, family members, healthcare providers, and referral sources.
  • Strong understanding of home care or home health operations and patient intake workflows.
  • Excellent customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational abilities.
  • Ability to collect, verify, and accurately document sensitive patient information.
  • Comfortable handling multiple inquiries and following up on pending referrals.
  • Familiarity with EMR/EHR systems and healthcare administrative platforms.
  • Understanding of HIPAA and patient confidentiality requirements.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting U.S.-based home care or home health agencies.
  • Familiarity with caregiver, HHA, skilled nursing, and home health services.
  • Knowledge of U.S. healthcare terminology and insurance verification processes.
  • Experience coordinating with clinical teams and scheduling departments.
  • Familiarity with common home health documentation and referral requirements.

What Success Looks Like

  • Patient and referral inquiries are handled professionally and promptly.
  • Cantonese-speaking patients and families receive clear and effective assistance.
  • Intake information and documentation are collected accurately.
  • Referrals are processed efficiently with minimal delays.
  • Pending cases are consistently monitored and followed up.
  • Patient records are complete, accurate, and properly maintained.
  • Patients and families receive a positive and supportive intake experience.

Work Arrangement

  • Employment Type: Full-Time
  • Work Setup: Remote
  • Location: Philippines-based
  • Language Requirement: Fluent Cantonese and English

Como será o seu dia a dia

  • Evoluir o sistema de faturamento de uma distribuidora, em .NET Framework 4.8 e SQL Server.

Responsabilidades

  • Fazer a engenharia reversa do código e das stored procedures de faturamento e documentar o sistema.
  • Montar a base de regressão: executar a suíte de testes automatizados existente e criar os novos testes da NFGás.

  • Preparar os scripts de corte e a chave de ativação (feature flag) da virada e atuar no hypercare.
  • Revisar criticamente todo código gerado por IA antes de abrir o PR.
  • Apoiar e orientar tecnicamente os demais desenvolvedores do time.

O que buscamos?

Um profissional com olhar para melhorias e entregas de valor.

Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Terá a visão do projeto como um todo e apoiará o time no processo de quebra das tarefas e entendimento das mesmas, visando uma melhor eficiência na entrega;
  • Irá se certificar de que a solução que está sendo construída atenderá as necessidades dos clientes e contém a aplicação de boas práticas;
  • Acompanhar os processos de roll-out dos projetos e apoiar o time na identificação e solução de problemas, e em casos críticos conduzir o time;
  • Responsável por mentorar sobre práticas, ferramentas e conceitos de testes, apoiará o time no refactor de testes;
  • Atuar na identificação e correção de falhas de segurança ou gerar documentação mapeando o cenário identificado;
  • Conhecer modelos e práticas de arquitetura,quando necessárioapoiar o time de arquitetura na validação do desenho de soluções e traduzir as arquiteturas em solução no processo de desenvolvimento;
  • Acompanhar as cerimônias do time se há algum impedimento ou problema e apoiar na construção do plano de ação;
  • Conhecer as métricas que o time usa e analisá-las, sugerindo mudanças e usando-as para processos de planejamento e alinhamentos;
  • Documentar e demonstrar soluções, desenvolvendo documentação, fluxogramas, layouts, diagramas, gráficos e código claro.

Obrigatórios

  • Experiência de 6 anos ou mais com C# e .NET Framework 4.x, incluindo manutenção e evolução de sistemas legados.
  • SQL Server com T-SQL avançado: stored procedures complexas, transações, processamento em lote e otimização de consultas.
  • Desenvolvimento web fullstack em (WebForms ou MVC), HTML e JavaScript.
  • Integração REST/JSON com contratos versionados, idempotência, retentativas e rastreabilidade de chamadas.
  • Testes automatizados (MSTest, NUnit ou xUnit) e refatoração segura de código legado protegida por testes.
  • Capacidade de ler e entender código legado sem documentação.
  • Uso prático de ferramentas de IA no desenvolvimento (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code ou similares), com senso crítico para revisar e corrigir o que a IA produz.
  • Git e Azure DevOps (boards, repos e pipelines).

Desejável

  • Experiência com sistemas de faturamento ou com documentos fiscais eletrônicos (NF-e, NF3e, NFCom).
  • Experiência com integração entre sistemas satélites e SAP S/4HANA.
  • Conhecimento do domínio de distribuição de gás, energia ou outras utilities.
  • Experiência com feature flags e estratégias de virada com reversão por parâmetro.
  • Experiência com engenharia reversa de regras de negócio em stored procedures.

Georgia, Connecticut, Maryland, New Hampshire, New Jersey, North Carolina, Ohio, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Vermont, or Virginia.


What we’re looking for...


You’re someone others look to for advice on the latest technology. Working toward challenging commission-based sales targets to motivate you to perform at your best.   • A dedicated quiet, private workspace.

In this remote role, you'll work from home with occasional in-person trainings and meetings.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

raw.title: Software Engineer-2
raw.excerpt: About the Team/Role We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer II to join our Risk Engineering team.
raw.description:
About the Team/Role

We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer II to join our Risk Engineering team. This is a high-bar engineering role for someone with a strong Computer Science foundation, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to independently design and deliver production software end to end.

Risk Engineering builds business-critical platforms supporting credit, fraud, financial crimes, and collections. Our technology includes Node.js/TypeScript, AWS, Kafka, microservices etc., with both synchronous and asynchronous/event-driven architectures.

We are looking for engineers who understand the fundamentals behind the technologies they use, can reason through complex problems, make sound technical decisions, and take ownership from problem definition through production support.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and support production software across the full lifecycle.
  • Independently own medium-to-high complexity technical problems and communicate technical decisions and tradeoffs.
    • AI-Assisted Engineering
    • Use AI tools to improve engineering productivity, solution quality, and problem-solving.
    • Apply thoughtful prompt engineering, providing appropriate context, constraints, and requirements.
    • Use AI to assist with design exploration, coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and code analysis.
    • Critically evaluate AI-generated output and modify, improve, or reject it when necessary.
    • Maintain ownership of the final design and implementation rather than blindly accepting generated code.
    • Experience with Spec-Driven Development (SDD) or similar AI-assisted development practices is a strong plus.
      • Design scalable microservices and APIs using Node.js/TypeScript, AWS, Kafka, and related technologies.
      • Build and support both synchronous and asynchronous/event-driven systems.
      • Apply strong Computer Science fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, complexity, concurrency, data modeling, and software design to solve technical problems.
      • Develop clean, maintainable, secure, and well-tested software.
      • Contribute to CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability, and production reliability.
      • Collaborate closely with teammates and cross-functional partners to understand problems and deliver effective solutions.
      • Communicate proactively: raise risks and issues early, communicate blockers as they arise, and keep teammates informed rather than waiting for scheduled meetings or standups.
      • Work independently while recognizing when to seek help, ask questions, or involve others. Know when to keep digging and when collaboration will lead to a better outcome.
      • Participate in technical discussions, design reviews, and code reviews; provide mentorship and constructive feedback to other engineers.
      • Strong Computer Science Foundation
        Candidates should be comfortable discussing and applying:
    • Data structures and algorithms
    • Algorithmic complexity and performance
    • Software design principles and patterns
    • Object-oriented and/or functional programming
    • Concurrency and asynchronous programming
    • Database and data modeling fundamentals
    • Networking, APIs, and distributed systems
    • Testing and software quality
    • We value engineers who understand why a solution works, not simply how to implement it using a particular framework.
      End-to-End Engineering & Technical Judgment
      Strong candidates can take a problem through:
      Understand → Design → Implement → Test → Deploy → Monitor → Troubleshoot → Improve
      They should be comfortable working independently, evaluating alternatives and tradeoffs, and knowing when to seek collaboration or guidance.
      Communication & Collaboration
      Strong engineers communicate throughout the work, not only when asked or during scheduled meetings. We value engineers who:
    • Work effectively as part of a team and actively share information.
    • Ask questions and seek help when they are stuck rather than spending excessive time blocked.
    • Raise risks, issues, and concerns early, giving the team an opportunity to respond.
    • Communicate blockers and changes in status as they happen rather than waiting for standup.
    • Know when to work independently and when collaboration will produce a better outcome.
    • Give and receive constructive feedback.
    • Clearly communicate technical decisions, tradeoffs, and recommendations.

Experience you’ll bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong Computer Science fundamentals and demonstrated experience designing and developing production software end to end.
  • Experience with APIs, automated testing, cloud applications, and CI/CD.
  • Experience with microservices, distributed systems, or event-driven architectures.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
    • What Success Looks Like
      You are a strong, independent engineer who can solve complex problems, make thoughtful technical decisions, and deliver reliable production software. You understand the fundamentals behind your technology choices, take ownership of outcomes, and contribute to the technical growth of the team.
      You communicate proactively, collaborate effectively, and know when to work through a problem independently versus when to involve others. You raise issues early and keep your team informed as work progresses.
      You use AI to amplify your engineering capabilities, not replace your judgment. You know how to provide useful context, evaluate AI-generated solutions, and change or replace them when they are not the right answer.
      Preferred Qualifications
    • Node.js and TypeScript
    • AWS
    • Kafka or similar messaging platforms
    • Asynchronous/event-driven architectures
    • PostgreSQL, Redis, Snowflake, or similar technologies
    • Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code tools
    • Production observability and operational practices

raw.description:
UPSTARS – продуктова IT-компанія, з якою злітають і люди, і бренди. Наш основний фокус – технологічні рішення та B2B-послуги для міжнародних клієнтів. Запускаємо зіркові проєкти у сфері iGaming, які отримують визнання та найвищі оцінки профільних рейтингів ✨

І так, підтримувати легальний та прозорий ринок України – це маст хев, тому третіми в країні отримали B2B-ліцензію на надання послуг у сфері азартних ігор.

У 2026 ми активно масштабуємо і проєкти, і дрім тім. Тому для підсилення Product департаменту шукаємо Operations Project Manager.

✅ Твої майбутні задачі:

  • розвивати Jira як центральну систему управління задачами та плануванням: збирати вимоги, формувати ТЗ на spaces, workflows і автоматизації, приймати зміни;

  • аналізувати процеси продуктових команд: знаходити вузькі місця, дублювання та неефективні операції; проєктувати оптимізовані процеси й автоматизацію;

  • розробляти та впроваджувати єдині стандарти роботи продуктового департаменту (планування, пріоритизація, запити, залежності, зони відповідальності, ескалації);

  • координувати операційні ініціативи: терміни, ризики, блокери, комунікація між командами;

  • розвивати операційні метрики, дашборди та звітність, аналізувати відхилення та ініціювати покращення;

  • відстежувати adoption нових процесів і збирати фідбек від команд;

  • вести єдину базу операційної документації в Confluence (process maps, SOP, регламенти, шаблони).

💪 Твої скіли:

  • 3+ роки досвіду в Operations, Product Operations, BPM або суміжних напрямах в IT;

  • навички аналізу, моделювання та оптимізації процесів між командами з різною специфікою;

  • досвід впровадження змін повного циклу: від проблеми й вимог до рішення та оцінки ефективності;

  • впевнене володіння Jira Cloud (boards, workflows, JQL, dashboards, Plans, Automation) та Confluence;

  • вміння формалізувати вимоги, готувати ТЗ, тестувати й приймати рішення;

  • розуміння Agile, Scrum, Kanban (intake, backlog, пріоритизація, планування);

  • досвід створення операційних дашбордів і аналізу метрик.

🤞 Бажано, але не критично:

  • досвід проєктування Jira для декількох команд, включно зі стандартизацією workflows, issue hierarchy та reporting;

  • знання Lean, Six Sigma, Value Stream Mapping, SIPOC, RACI та інших методів процесного аналізу.

🌟 Наші цінності та переваги:

  • командність – гуртом не лише працюємо, а ще й відпочиваємо, двіжуємо і робимо добрі справи;

  • позитив – з легкістю йдемо по життю і отримуємо драйв від круто зробленої роботи, цікавих задач і фідбеку тіммейтів;

  • можливості – пропонуємо чіткий кар’єрний план з Performance Review, тренінги, менторинг-програми та інші інструменти для реалізації як у карʼєрі, так і у житті;

  • сміливість – беремося за задачі із зірочкою, не боїмося викликів і амбітних планів;

  • відкритість – говоримо прямо і просто навіть про складне, чуємо ідеї та фідбеки і цінуємо проактивність;

  • маємо власні потужності для створення технологічних рішень з нуля;

  • автоматизуємо рутину, щоб використовувати час для розвитку та професійного зростання всередині компанії;

  • не любимо бюрократію та застарілі підходи – ми за свободу дій.

🍪Маст-хев:

  • працюй там, де комфортно та безпечно – в хабах у Києві та Варшаві або віддалено;

  • 20 робочих днів оплачуваних дей офів, державні вихідні і лікарняні – ми за ворк-лайф беленс;

  • медичне страхування у топових клініках і покриття витрат на психолога на платформі Pleso;

  • Benefit cafe – щомісячно витрачай кошти на уподобання, хобі, спорт тощо;

  • івенти – бери участь у майстер-класах, відвідуй тімбілдинги та корпоративи;

  • навчання під будь-який запит – індивідуальний бюджет на курси, корпоративна англійська, воркшопи та онлайн-бібліотека.

І ще про важливе:

❗️Не маємо клієнтів, які б використовували наші розробки та послуги на українському ринку.

❗️Не працюємо з клієнтами ринку країни-агресора чи будь-якого іншого російськомовного ринку.

Відчуваєш метч за цінностями і бажання професійно зростати? Давай знайомитися! 😉

P.S. Якщо після відгуку не бачиш нашого листа – зазирни у “Спам” або інші розділи. Іноді наші відповіді губляться там 👀

raw.title: P&C Product Management Director (Umbrella)
raw.excerpt: Why USAA?  At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice.
raw.description:
Why USAA?

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a dedicated P&C Product Management Director for our Countrywide Personal Lines Specialty Products area, with a focus on Umbrella.


This role is accountable for the achievement of property and casualty insurance (P&C) profit and growth targets on a countrywide product basis. Develops strategic vision and tactical plan that will profitably expand USAA product line market share. Focuses on countrywide product competitive and financial KPIs to anticipate and react to potential trends. Identifies opportunities to make regional or countrywide impacts across P&C, which drive best practices and innovation across the organization.


This role is remote eligible in the continental U.S. with occasional business travel. However, individuals residing within a 60-mile radius of a USAA office will be expected to work on-site four days per week.


What you'll do:

  • Works with large data sets and leads business analysis of countrywide P&L and marketing strategy and the impact of marketing investments to influence P&L results.
  • Provides guidance on key financial and customer-related concerns from executives leveraging multiple data sources including SAS, SQL, Tableau, R, etc.
  • Leads the design, development, implementation, and maintenance of the P&C insurance products through deliver value as a leader in collaborating with business partners.
  • Builds relationships and partnerships to collaborate with internal stakeholder's partners to develop insights to develop and execute on multi-year state strategy. Maintains partnerships with external regulators to bring strategic actions to market.
  • Directs and executes data analytics with internal stakeholders to identify growth opportunities, build a 360-degree view of the membership and presents key learnings.
  • Builds complex reports using data tools to monitor business performance and communicate results.
  • Works directly with stakeholders to understand business objectives, define key performance indicators, and evaluate performance; identifies emerging themes, internal and external trends to improve performance and minimize risk.
  • Leads comprehensive market analysis and evaluates product performance metrics to help facilitate decision making at regional/ countrywide level.
  • Maintains partnerships with Government & Industry Relations, Attorney, and Compliance Advisor to manage relationship with local regulatory agencies and industry organizations.
  • Facilitates development of team members by providing guidance, coaching, and training of processes and procedures in support of product line initiatives.
  • Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.

What you have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Supply Chain, or Statistics; OR 4 years of relevant education and/or experience.
  • 8 years of relevant product or program management experience analyzing data and developing recommendation, or an advanced degree in Business, with 6 years of product or program management experience.
  • 4 years of P&C experience.
  • Extensive experience in creating product briefings and presenting to executive leadership.
  • Demonstrated experience in independently conducting product analysis & gaining an in depth understanding of market dynamics including competitor underwriting initiatives, rate level analysis.
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship management skills with an emphasis on customer focus, collaboration and partnering to obtain results.
  • Advanced knowledge of applicable product related regulations, and risk and compliance requirements.

What sets you apart:

  • Product: P&C product management experience, ideally with Umbrella or specialty product line.
  • Data Analytics: Confirmed sophisticated data analytical experience and the ability to demonstrate the skills for pulling data as well as analyzing trends to make recommendations to leadership.
  • Communication: Ability to articulate complex findings with clarity and impact through compelling written and verbal communication. You will regularly present to executive leadership and key business partners, influencing decision making and strong collaborative relationships.
  • Technical Tools: Mastery of essential data tools including SQL, Tableau, and Snowflake. Experience with Python is a plus.
  • P&C Product: Experience with P&C product management to include understanding of pricing, P&L, risk profiles, underwriting, state specific forms and legal/risk management.
  • US military experience through military service or a military spouse/domestic partner.

Compensation range: The salary range for this position is: $127,310 - $243,340.


USAA does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Please do not apply for this role if at any time (now or in the future) you will need immigration support (i.e., H-1B, TN, STEM OPT Training Plans, etc.).

Compensation: USAA has an effective process for assessing market data and establishing ranges to ensure we remain competitive. You are paid within the salary range based on your experience and market data of the position. The actual salary for this role may vary by location.

Employees may be eligible for pay incentives based on overall corporate and individual performance and at the discretion of the USAA Board of Directors.

The above description reflects the details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job and should not be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be performed in the job.

Benefits: At USAA our employees enjoy best-in-class benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellness. These benefits include comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans, 401(k), pension, life insurance, parental benefits, adoption assistance, paid time off program with paid holidays plus 16 paid volunteer hours, and various wellness programs. Additionally, our career path planning and continuing education assists employees with their professional goals.

For more details on our outstanding benefits, visit our benefits page on USAAjobs.com.

Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis, this posting will remain open until the position is filled. Thus, interested candidates are encouraged to apply the same day they view this posting.

USAA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

raw.description:
Company Overview

More than 35 years ago, SelectQuote was founded on one core promise: to help our customers protect the people they value most. We pioneered the way consumers shopped for term life insurance, and now, we also help people find home insurance, auto insurance, senior health insurance and more. Our quick and easy process saves consumers both time and money, and today, more than 2 million families trust us to help them with their insurance needs.

But what truly sets us apart is our people, and the opportunities to grow your career with SelectQuote are unmatched.

About the Role

Sales Development Advisor

Job Summary

SelectQuote is seeking experienced, driven, resilient, and results-oriented sales professionals to join our Qualifications Team as a Sales Development Advisor (SDA).

The SDA is an unlicensed, outbound sales position responsible for contacting prospective customers, generating interest in SelectQuote's products, understanding customer needs, overcoming objections, and transferring qualified prospects to a licensed insurance agent.

This is not a customer service role. This is a high-volume, metrics-driven sales position. Successful candidates must be comfortable making hundreds of outbound calls each day, working from established scripts and processes, handling rejection, and consistently working toward performance goals.

This role provides paid training, a base salary plus bonus opportunity, and a potential career path into a licensed sales agent position. After demonstrating success in the role, SelectQuote will provide opportunities to enter a sales training program and assist with obtaining an insurance license.

Candidates who currently hold an insurance license will not be considered for this position.

After applying, qualified candidates will receive a phone call to complete our pre-screening questionnaire.

Key Responsibilities

  • Make high-volume outbound calls to prospective customers, with activity of up to 800 calls per day.

  • Generate interest and create meaningful engagement with prospective customers.

  • Quickly establish rapport and communicate confidently and professionally over the phone.

  • Identify customer needs and qualify prospects for transfer to a licensed insurance agent.

  • Handle and overcome objections, stalls, hesitation, and rejection throughout the sales conversation.

  • Confidently redirect conversations and move qualified prospects toward the next step.

  • Follow established sales scripts, processes, and instructions while maintaining a natural and engaging conversation.

  • Meet or exceed monthly transfer, contact-to-transfer, and other performance goals.

  • Accept coaching and demonstrate the ability to apply feedback to improve sales performance.

  • Work effectively with multiple monitors, software applications, and phone systems.

  • Maintain consistent attendance, punctuality, productivity, and performance.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.

  • At least 1 year of telesales, inside sales, phone sales, or comparable sales experience required.

  • Proven ability to work in a high-volume, metrics-driven or commission-based sales environment preferred.

  • Demonstrated success working toward quotas, KPIs, conversion goals, or other measurable sales objectives.

  • Strong objection-handling and closing skills.

  • Confident, energetic, and conversational phone presence.

  • Strong active listening and communication skills.

  • Ability to follow scripts and established sales processes.

  • Ability to accept coaching and implement feedback.

  • Professional and reliable work habits.

  • Consistent employment history and demonstrated commitment to previous roles preferred.

  • Candidates should be prepared to clearly explain significant employment gaps, frequent job changes, or positions not reflected on their resume.

  • Current insurance licenses are not eligible for this position.

Compensation & Career Growth

  • Paid training.

  • Base salary plus bonus opportunity.

  • Average first-year earnings of approximately $50,000, with top producers earning $80,000+.

  • Potential opportunity to enter SelectQuote's sales training program after as soon as six months of successful performance.

  • SelectQuote will support successful associates in pursuing an insurance license and progressing into a licensed sales role.

This Role Is a Good Fit for You If...

  • You have a genuine sales mindset and enjoy influencing customers toward a next step.

  • You are comfortable making a very high volume of outbound calls every day.

  • You don't get discouraged by rejection.

  • You can confidently handle "I'm not interested," "I need to think about it," and other common objections.

  • You enjoy working toward quotas, KPIs, and measurable sales goals.

  • You are comfortable using a sales script and can make it sound natural rather than robotic.

  • You can follow a structured sales process while still actively listening and responding to the customer.

  • You are competitive and motivated by improving your numbers.

  • You can stay engaged and energetic through repetitive, high-volume work.

  • You take coaching seriously and can demonstrate changes based on feedback.

  • You can provide specific examples of your past sales performance and accomplishments.

  • You are looking for a long-term sales career, with the potential to progress into a licensed sales role.

  • You are dependable and prepared to consistently work your assigned schedule.

This Role May Not Be a Good Fit for You If...

  • You are primarily looking for a customer service position.

  • You are primarily interested in working from home for flexibility rather than pursuing a sales career.

  • You dislike scripted sales environments or are unwilling to follow established sales processes.

  • You prefer conversations without sales goals, quotas, or performance expectations.

  • You become uncomfortable when customers object, hesitate, or say no.

  • You have difficulty redirecting a conversation or moving a prospect toward the next step.

  • You struggle to maintain energy and engagement during repetitive phone interactions.

  • You are uncomfortable making a high volume of outbound calls.

  • You prefer not to be coached or change your approach based on feedback.

  • You cannot provide specific examples of your sales accomplishments or performance.

  • You are unable to commit consistently to a set schedule, attendance expectations, and the demands of a full-time sales position.

Work-From-Home Requirements

This is a full-time W-2 work-from-home position with an assigned schedule.

Employees must:

  • Be punctual and consistently adhere to their assigned schedule and attendance requirements.

  • Have a quiet, dedicated workspace free from distractions.

  • Have reliable high-speed internet with minimum speeds of 20 Mbps download and 20 Mbps upload through a hardwired connection.

  • Be able to remain fully engaged and available throughout scheduled work hours.

  • Be willing to work overtime, weekends, or schedule variations when business needs require it.

SelectQuote Core Values

Service — We create positive customer experiences.
Entrepreneurship — We create, innovate, and take risks.
Leadership — We build and invest in high-performing teams.
Empowerment — We embrace a changing environment.
Courage — We challenge the status quo and drive continuous improvement.
Teamwork — We help, support, and celebrate each other.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work performed in this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of responsibilities, qualifications, or requirements.

About Publicis Sapient

Most companies in the AI era do one of two things: they advise, or they sell you a tool. We do both. Our Commitment to Inclusive Hiring

We are committed to fostering and encouraging an inclusive and welcoming environment for everyone and we believe great talent comes from many different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. That is why we are committed to creating a hiring process where everyone has an equal opportunity to succeed and feel safe. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and identities including: race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion and value the diverse experiences, perspectives, and strengths they bring to our teams.

If there is anything we can do to make our recruitment process more accessible or comfortable for you, please let us know. We are happy to provide reasonable adjustments throughout the application and interview process. You can contact us anytime at

Your Safety Matters To Us

To help you stay safe from recruitment scams, please remember that our recruiters will only ever contact you from a Publicis Sapient email address. In some cases, we may partner with trusted, vetted recruitment agencies who will clearly identify themselves as working on behalf of Publicis Sapient. If you receive communication from any other domain claiming to represent us, please treat it with caution and contact us at

Overview

Why This Role Matters

Publicis Sapient is looking for a Microsoft Fabric Architect to lead the architecture and technical direction of a modern enterprise Data Platform built on Microsoft Fabric.

In this highly impactful role, you'll define the end-to-end architecture across data ingestion, transformation, storage, analytics and reporting, while establishing scalable platform foundations and engineering standards. You'll work closely with data engineers, analysts, business stakeholders and implementation partners to ensure the platform meets business, security, governance, performance and operational requirements.

You'll thrive in this role if you enjoy designing modern enterprise data platforms, establishing architectural standards and reusable patterns, and translating complex business and regulatory requirements into pragmatic technical solutions. You'll work across the Microsoft Fabric ecosystem, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Fabric Data Factory, Data Engineering, Data Warehouse, Power BI and semantic models, alongside Azure services and modern DevOps practices.

This role is an excellent opportunity for someone who would like to join an international global organization with a 'start-up' mentality. We highly value Openness, Collaboration and a Learning Mindset, and partner with our clients to drive positive outcomes.

  • Define the end-to-end Microsoft Fabric architecture, covering data ingestion, transformation, storage, analytics and reporting.

  • Establish architectural standards, reusable patterns and engineering guardrails to enable consistent and scalable platform development.
  • Design integrations with enterprise applications, APIs, databases and external data providers.
  • Define data modelling, data product and Power BI semantic-layer approaches that support enterprise reporting and analytics.
  • Establish robust security and access-control models across workspaces, domains, data access and sensitive information, including segregation of duties.
  • Drive data governance capabilities, including data ownership, stewardship, cataloguing, lineage, metadata management and data quality.
  • Define CI/CD, environment management and deployment practices across development, test and production environments.
  • Provide architectural guidance on Fabric capacity planning, workload management, performance optimisation and cost control.
  • Lead technical design reviews and provide architectural guidance to data engineering and analytics teams.
  • Partner with business stakeholders, technical teams and implementation partners to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Support the investigation and resolution of complex platform, integration and performance issues.
  • Maintain architecture documentation and ensure alignment with broader enterprise, cloud, security and governance standards.

What You’ll Bring to the Team

  • Strong experience architecting and implementing enterprise data platforms using Microsoft Fabric.
  • Hands-on expertise with OneLake, Lakehouse, Fabric Data Factory, Data Engineering, Data Warehouse, Power BI and semantic models.
  • Strong understanding of medallion architecture, data modelling, data integration and modern analytics patterns.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Fabric security, governance, lineage and administration capabilities.
  • Experience establishing CI/CD pipelines, environment management, deployment processes and operational monitoring for enterprise data platforms.
  • Experience with relevant Azure services, such as Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure Key Vault, Microsoft Entra ID and Azure DevOps.
  • Ability to translate complex business, technical and regulatory requirements into pragmatic and scalable architecture solutions.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to communicate architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proven technical leadership skills and experience guiding engineering teams through architecture and implementation decisions.

Additional Experience We Value

  • Microsoft Fabric or Azure Data Engineering certifications.
  • Experience designing or implementing enterprise-wide data governance frameworks.
  • Experience working with regulated, business-critical data and reporting platforms.
  • Previous exposure to complex industries such as financial services, commodities trading or CTRM platforms.
  • Experience designing platforms where security, governance, data quality, auditability and operational resilience are critical requirements.
  • Experience leading large-scale data platform modernisation or migration initiatives.

Additional Information

What You’ll Get in Return

  • A fast-paced tech environment
  • Continuous growth & learning
  • Open feedback culture
  • Room for own initiative & ideas
  • Transparency about results & strategy
  • Recognition & reward for hard work

raw.description:
Overview

When someone living with opioid use disorder is ready for help, the speed and quality of the referral they receive can change the trajectory of their life. As our Vice President of National Partnerships, you'll own the strategy that makes those referrals happen — at scale, across the country.

Pay Range: $210,000 - $255,000 + Bonus + Benefits

Fully Remote work (Not available to residents of: AK, AR, CA, HI, ID, NE, SD, UT, WY). We are prioritizing candidates who align with the Eastern time zone (EDT/EST) for consistent overlap and availability with our core clinical and operational teams.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do

Own the national growth strategy. You'll build and execute our national referral partnership strategy across healthcare, justice-involved, and community-based channels — setting clear channel strategies, market priorities, and measurable targets for referral volume, conversion, and census growth. Then you'll own the results.

Turn relationships into results. You'll deepen our highest-performing partnerships, expand referral volume from current partners, and source, sign, and activate new ones. When you see an emerging growth opportunity, you'll test it, prove it, and scale it.

Lead and grow a distributed team. You'll coach Partnership Development Managers across multiple markets — setting clear expectations for account ownership, field activity, CRM discipline, and follow-through, and building a culture where accountability and high morale feed each other. Through regular one-to-ones, market reviews, and coaching, you'll sharpen their consultative selling, executive communication, and partner development skills.

Build bridges across functions. You'll strengthen warm-handoff workflows and remove barriers, so more referrals lead to timely access to care, successful member activation, and sustained engagement in treatment — partnering with Marketing, Member Access, Operations, and Clinical teams along the way.

Represent us in the field. You'll build and maintain relationships with high-value national, regional, and market-level partners — courts, correctional agencies, hospitals and health systems, recovery organizations, housing providers, health plans, government stakeholders, and community coalitions.

Change minds, open doors. Working with Marketing, Clinical, Operations, and Member Access, you'll develop partner-facing presentations, education, and messaging — leading partner education on medication for opioid use disorder (MOUD) and evidence-based treatment, especially with justice and community partners, to reduce stigma and open referral pathways.

Let data drive the plan. You'll use market intelligence — competitive dynamics, referral trends, emerging partnership models — to decide which markets and partnerships to prioritize, with performance visibility your team and our executives can act on.

Build what's next. You'll recommend team design, role clarity, incentives, reporting, and CRM capabilities needed to scale — and partner with Emerging Markets to build referral pipelines so new locations open with volume already flowing.

Work Environment/Schedule

This is a national leadership role built for connection. You'll lead a distributed, multi-market team and work cross-functionally with Marketing, Member Access, Operations, Clinical, and executive leadership.

You'll travel as needed for partner meetings, conferences, presentations, market visits, community events, and team engagement. You'll also represent the Partnership Development function in executive discussions, planning sessions, growth reviews, and market performance meetings.

Qualifications

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of healthcare growth, business development, partnership development, market development, or related leadership experience
  • A track record of building high-performing, distributed teams across multiple markets or states — and translating referral partnerships into measurable growth
  • Deep understanding of referral development, account management, healthcare partnerships, and market activation
  • The ability to build scalable strategies from complex, ambiguous environments
  • Fluency with CRM systems, dashboards, pipeline tools, and performance reporting (Salesforce a plus)
  • Executive-level communication — written narratives, presentations, board-level updates, and partner-facing materials
  • The ability to partner effectively with clinical, operational, analytics, marketing, and executive teams
  • Strong coaching, prioritization, and change management skills
  • Willingness to travel for partner meetings, conferences, market visits, and team engagement

Strongly preferred: experience in addiction treatment, behavioral health, value-based care, Medicaid, justice-involved care, health systems, or community-based healthcare.

Why Join Us

  • Expand access to care. Help more people connect with evidence-based addiction treatment by making referral pathways easier to navigate.
  • Shape national growth. Own the partnership strategy, test new opportunities, and help build a function that can scale.
  • Develop people. Coach a multi-market team with clear goals, meaningful feedback, and shared accountability for results.
  • Help reduce stigma. Equip healthcare, justice-system, and community partners with knowledge that opens more pathways to treatment.

Put your growth expertise to work expanding access to evidence-based addiction treatment. At Groups, you'll connect healthcare, justice, and community partners to care, help reduce stigma around MOUD, and shape how a national partnership function grows. It's an opportunity to pair strategic influence with a clear purpose: helping more people start treatment and stay engaged in care.

Responsibilities

Join Peraton in advancing the safety, efficiency, and modernization of the National Airspace System (NAS) through the FAA’s Brand New Air Traffic Control System (BNATCS) contract. As a trusted partner to the Federal Aviation Administration, Peraton helps deliver the systems and services that keep our nation’s skies safe and connected. We’re looking for innovative professionals who thrive in mission-critical environments and are passionate about shaping the future of air traffic management. This is your chance to make an impact on one of the world’s most vital transportation infrastructures, working alongside leaders in aviation, engineering, data science, and systems integration.

At Peraton, you won’t just support the mission — you’ll define it.

Do you want to play a critical role in shaping the future of America’s skies? Peraton is seeking an Software Installer- Senior to support the Federal Aviation Administration's (FAA) Terminal Flight Data Manager (TFDM) program. In this role, you'll update software installation deployment at individual FAA terminal facilities. This is an excellent opportunity for candidates who want to contribute directly to NAS modernization.

Work Location:

  • This role is 100% remote; Candidates must reside within the contiguous United States.
  • Must be available to travel up to 75-100% of the time to support program requirements, including travel to FAA facilities

In this position, you will:

Your work will help ensure TFDM is accurately configured, tested, and ready for operational use while maintaining alignment with FAA requirements, national standards, and approved program baselines.

  • Consistently and accurately create, refine, and execute procedures for TFDM Software Installations at Sites and in Lab environments
  • Create AIMS tickets to report discrepancies with TFDM and request new Site / Lab adaptations
  • Create status reports of On-Site / Lab installations
  • Work with teammates, site personnel, and vendors to solve TFDM software installation and operational issues

On-Site Responsibilities & Travel

  • Ability to lift and transport hardware weighing up to 25 lbs., bend, squat, kneel, and sit or stand for extended periods.
  • Possess a valid driver's license and be comfortable operating a cargo van to transport and deliver equipment to FAA facilities.
  • Ability and willingness to drive between multiple FAA facilities within a designated geographic area to support hardware deliveries, software installations, and system upgrades.
  • Ability to climb approximately 15–20 flights of stairs at air traffic control towers.

Why This Role Matters

As a Software Installer supporting the FAA's TFDM program, you will play a key role in modernizing the National Airspace System (NAS). Your work will help ensure TFDM software is properly installed, tested, and operationally ready at FAA facilities nationwide. By supporting successful deployments and resolving technical challenges, you will directly contribute to improved air traffic operations, system reliability, and the safety and efficiency of America's airspace.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • U.S. Citizenship required.
  • Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.
  • Bachelors degree and 8 years’ relevant experience or Master's degree and 6 years’ or Associates degree with 10 years’ of experience or HS diploma with 12 years’ experience.
  • Required Redhat Linux knowledge:
    • OS Installation
    • File Navigation
    • Shell scripting – VI, GREP, SED, AWK
    • Ansible Playbooks
  • Required VM Ware knowledge:
    • Navigation
    • Troubleshooting
  • Required TCP/IP Networking:
    • Network troubleshooting
    • Creating and running cables
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate with technical and operational stakeholders.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to operate a cargo van for equipment deliveries and travel between FAA facilities.
  • Willingness and ability to travel 75–100%, including driving between multiple installation sites.
  • Ability to perform the essential physical functions of the position, including lifting up to 25 lbs. and climbing air traffic control tower stairs, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience supporting the FAA, National Airspace System (NAS), or aviation modernization programs.
  • Familiarity with TFDM, TFMS, STARS, ASDE-X, ERAM, or other FAA automation and air traffic management systems.
  • Experience with TFDM software
  • Experience working directly with air traffic controllers, FAA Technical Operations personnel, engineers, and other operational stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in aviation, Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

raw.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
raw.excerpt: Ciklum is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team in Brazil or Argentina.
raw.description:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team in Brazil or Argentina.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you'll become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experience of tomorrow.

The company builds software for commercial real estate. This isn't general cloud engineering, you will actually built agentic-platform infrastructure before, not just traditional cloud architecture.

Responsibilities:

  • Model Design & Delivery
    • Design, train and ship production ML models for real estate and facilities decisions, such as forecasting for space, occupancy, headcount, rent and finances
    • Own each model end to end: problem framing, data and features, training, validation, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and cost and latency budgets
    • Serve models as versioned, documented APIs that product features, agents and other systems call. Keep the serving layer portable across cloud platforms, for example by using containers
    • Contribute to embedding and retrieval work, and measure retrieval quality on real customer documents
    • Contribute to synthetic data pipelines, so teams can develop and test without production customer data. Measure how closely the synthetic data matches the real data, how well models trained on it perform, and whether it leaks private data
  • Evaluation, Quality & Trust
    • Own the evaluation of every model you ship: backtests, held-out datasets, metrics that fit the problem, and regression suites in CI that gate releases
    • Build them on the shared evaluation framework that the platform team provides
    • Find the root cause of quality failures, whether data drift, leakage, a feature defect, flawed ground truth, a retrieval miss or a model regression. Fix the layer that is at fault
    • Monitor production models for accuracy, drift, silent degradation and cost
    • Retrain or roll back based on evidence
    • Own model-level safety behavior: keep customer data within each tenant’s access rules, handle PII correctly, test for privacy leakage, and disclose uncertainty clearly
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Partner with Product to turn accuracy thresholds and confidence disclosure into shipped behavior
    • Agree on API contracts, accuracy bars and failure behavior with the teams that build AI agents on your models. Work with Platform Engineering on deployment and with Data Platform on the curated datasets and features your models read
    • Feed model performance and usage data into the warehouse, so model quality is measurable next to product analytics
    • Support the domain teams that build on your models, contribute to the shared quality standard for models and agents, and mentor engineers on ML practice

Requirements:

  • You have taken at least one ML model from problem framing to production, and kept it accurate through retraining and drift. Typically 5+ years of professional engineering experience and a degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • Python and SQL, including the ML stack (scikit-learn, PyTorch or equivalent, pandas or equivalent) and the service stack (FastAPI, Pydantic or equivalent) Testing, code review, CI/CD and production ownership. You use AI coding assistants and verify their output
  • Hands-on experience with ML evaluation: time-aware validation and backtesting against simple baselines, holdout design, metric selection, interval coverage and calibration, error analysis, and using results to gate releases. This is central to the role
  • Production experience with forecasting models, with a working knowledge of statistics and probability. You can quantify uncertainty, for example with prediction intervals
  • Model serving and MLOps: reproducible deployment, monitoring and retraining, for example with experiment tracking, a model registry, containers,
    and batch or online inference
  • Judgment about failure modes such as data leakage, drift, distribution shift, bias, privacy leakage and silent degradation. You can tell acceptable failures from unacceptable ones, and explain model behavior and uncertainty to Product and to people who are not engineers

Desirable:

  • Embeddings and retrieval systems, including how to measure retrieval quality
  • Synthetic data generation, privacy attack evaluation (for example membership inference), and familiarity with differential privacy
  • Geospatial or location data modeling
  • Experience building models that LLM agents call as tools, with an agent framework such as LangGraph and LLM tracing tools
  • Batch pipeline orchestration (Airflow, Step Functions or equivalent) and self- hosted model inference
  • Experience in real estate, facilities, finance or another data-heavy enterprise domain

What’s in it for you?

  • Care: your mental and physical health is our priority. We ensure comprehensive company-paid medical insurance and mental health programs, 5 undocumented sick-leave days per year
  • Tailored education path: boost your skills and knowledge with our regular internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy license, language courses and company-paid certifications
  • Growth environment: share your experience and level up your expertise with a community of skilled professionals, locally and globally
  • Long-term employment with 20 working-days paid vacation and local bank holidays
  • Flexibility: 100% remote work mode
  • Opportunities: we value our specialists and always find the best options for them. Our Internal Mobility Program helps change a project if needed to help you grow, excel professionally and fulfill your potential
  • Global impact: work on large-scale projects that redefine industries with international and fast-growing clients
  • Welcoming environment: feel empowered with a friendly team, open-door policy, informal atmosphere within the company and regular team-building events

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

As we expand into Latin America, every Ciklumer is helping to shape our story. Collaborate with seasoned experts and make a global impact backed by two decades of industry leadership.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

Subject Matter Expert - Crash Course Algebra

When it comes to math, the vast majority of U.S. high schoolers start in the same place: with algebra.

It’s a subject that some find curiously satisfying, and many others cryptic and unapproachable. For today’s high school students, it can seem like just another course to use AI to succeed in. But whether you consider yourself a “math person” or not, required courses in algebra can often stand between you and your goals.

But at Crash Course, we believe that there’s no such thing as a “math person”— math is something we all do every day, whether we realize it or not. And algebra can be one of the best tools to help us solve complex problems in our daily lives and beyond.

If you are an expert in secondary math education and want to share your knowledge with others, you might enjoy being our freelance subject matter expert (SME) for Crash Course Algebra!

Crash Course, owned by the nonprofit Complexly, is an award-winning YouTube channel that invites students, teachers, and lifelong learners to tackle subjects they might have had trouble with or are curious to learn more about. Our videos take traditional classroom concepts and combine them with engaging and insightful narratives to help people learn and understand.

More details on the position:

Job Title: Algebra Subject Matter Expert (SME)

Status: Freelance

Term: Roughly December 2026 to September 2028

Location: Remote, US-Based

Pay: ~$13,300 - $16,550

About Complexly:

Complexly is a media nonprofit that produces shows like Crash Course, SciShow, Eons, Ask Hank Anything, Bizarre Beasts, Study Hall, and more. We were founded by John and Hank Green with a mission of creating trustworthy stuff and lowering barriers to knowledge building. The world is not simple. And that can seem like a burden sometimes. The reality is, the human species will never fully understand itself or its universe, let alone any individual. But instead of seeing that as a failing, we'd like to suggest that the process is as powerful as the outcome.

Complexly was a company privately owned by Hank and John Green. As of 2026, they have donated the company to the public as a new nonprofit 501c3 organization, which will help Complexly fulfill its mission for decades to come. Becoming a nonprofit means we will be able to lean into public support, supercharging our mission to make content the world needs, not what is optimized for advertisers.

The Senior Software Developer is the lead Salesforce developer for a large enterprise Salesforce platform that is moving from Salesforce Education Data Architecture (EDA) to Salesforce Education Cloud. Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and development of Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, and data model changes for the Education Cloud build.

  • Direct and mentor Software Developer I and II staff; assign work, review output, and remove blockers.
  • Build and oversee integrations between Salesforce, connected third-party systems, external partner data feeds, MuleSoft, and AWS services.

  • Estimate work in hours, log time against assigned Jira tickets, and document solutions in Confluence.

Position Title: Mechanical Engineer III

Job Summary

The Mechanical Engineer III will have the opportunity to work with and collaborate with senior design staff and further develop their mechanical design expertise. This person will work as part of the Engineering Team and interact closely with the Project Management Team to produce construction documents, develop and edit project specifications and lead the construction administration process.

The Mechanical Engineer III will receive limited direction on day-to-day work and general instruction on new projects or assignments.  Will execute and assist project leadership on projects of complex scope.  Will work independently or under limited supervision.

The Mechanical Engineer III will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

raw.excerpt: About Vasion For more than a decade, Vasion has been helping companies simplify their print infrastructure, automate business processes, and integrate their technology in a more secure environment.
raw.description:
About Vasion

For more than a decade, Vasion has been helping companies simplify their print infrastructure, automate business processes, and integrate their technology in a more secure environment. Our mission, to make digital transformation attainable for everyone, drives a culture of innovation and exploration. We have one simple goal: help organizations simplify processes through automation and integration.

So we created simple, cost-effective, and easy-to-implement digital tools that work together, removing bottlenecks and improving efficiency. And we’re always on the lookout for new people who can help us innovate, grow, and reach our goal.

About the role

At Vasion, we make print intelligent. Intelligent Print Automation treats File > Print as the entry point to a workflow rather than the end of one: the moment a document is created or captured, it becomes structured, secure, auditable data instead of a page that disappears. Three products run on one cloud-native platform — serverless print management that eliminates print servers, drivers, and scripts; output management that moves business-critical ERP print off legacy on-premise infrastructure; and document automation that captures, classifies, and routes documents with AI at the point of capture, built on AWS Bedrock with connectors into Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure AI, and others. More than 14,000 organizations run on the platform, concentrated in healthcare, government, education, financial services, and manufacturing. We are FedRAMP High Authorized, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 certified, and SOC 2 Type II audited.

This role owns where that platform meets the device: the embedded control panel application (CPA) that runs on multifunction printers from HP, Xerox, Ricoh, Canon, and others. The panel is where a user authenticates, releases a job, and starts a scan — the moment print stops being paper and becomes an intelligent workflow. We are a cloud-native and agent-native product organization, and we expect our product managers to work that way.

Why This Role Exists

Millions of the documents that move through business organizations still start or end at a multifunction printer. This role owns that moment: what the application does at the device panel, how it authenticates a user, how it releases a job, how it captures a scan, and how it stays consistent across thousands of devices from different manufacturers. The panel is where digital transformation meets paper, and our platform is reinventing what happens there — turning that critical physical step in the document lifecycle into the first intelligent one.

We are building the AI and cloud-native MFP applications of the future, with no customer infrastructure behind them. Just as we eliminated print servers in print management, we are removing the infrastructure that supports the MFP so the platform meets customers where they already are: any device, any manufacturer, any identity provider, any location, and nothing to install in between. Zero trust by default, and it just works. This role owns that surface — what we build at the panel, which manufacturers get it and in what order, and what the experience becomes for the thousands of organizations that reach us there every day.

What you'll do
  • The embedded Control Panel Application (CPA) across supported manufacturers. Own the roadmap, requirements, and release decisions for the CPA: secure print release, panel authentication (badge and proximity card, PIN, SSO through customer identity providers), copy and scan, administration and installation, fleet management, cost and quota management, automation and AI solutions at the device, etc. Decide what ships natively per platform versus what runs through a shared cloud service, and defend the trade-off.
  • Driving the platform to zero customer infrastructure. Own the sequence that takes each manufacturer to a no-infrastructure experience — authentication, scanning, and installation handled without anything running in the customer's environment. Decide what "infrastructure-less" means per platform, what is committed versus targeted, and how customers on the current architecture get to the new one without disruption.
  • Multi-manufacturer capability strategy. Maintain the capability matrix across every supported platform. Decide which manufacturers get which features first, sequence work against each OEM's firmware and certification calendar, and make explicit calls about where we accept a platform limitation versus invest to work around it.
  • Capture and document workflows at the device. Own scanning and capture: OCR, destinations and cloud connectors (SharePoint, OneDrive, Google Drive, email, etc.), and metadata. Drive the shift from scan-to-folder toward document intelligence and agent-assisted capture at the point of scan.
  • Security and compliance posture at the panel. Partner with security and compliance to keep the on-device experience defensible for zero trust, SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and FedRAMP customers. Own the authentication and release behaviors these buyers evaluate line by line.
  • The metrics. Own CPA adoption across the installed base, secure release success rate and latency at the panel, scan workflow completion, certification throughput per manufacturer, and the support ticket and field defect rates tied to on-device releases. Set the targets, instrument them, and report against them.
  • Discovery and validation. Talk to IT administrators, security teams, and the clinicians, clerks, and staff who actually stand at the panel — every week, not every quarter. Bring that evidence, plus usage data and a working knowledge of how the established competitors and manufacturer-native offerings solve the same problems, into every prioritization decision.
  • OEM and partner relationships. Co-own the manufacturer relationship alongside the internal teams who carry it — engineering, partner management, and alliances — working directly with OEM developer and certification programs. Their SDK constraints, signing requirements, and roadmaps are inputs you help manage rather than inherit. You are the person who knows, for each platform, what is possible this quarter and what is not.
How This Role Works

You operate in a trifecta with an engineering manager and a product designer. You own the problem, the case for why now, the prioritization, and the outcome. The engineering manager owns technical approach, architecture, and delivery. The designer owns the panel and administrative experience. Ownership is shared rather than siloed: you are expected to hold strong opinions on design and feasibility, and to invite the same on product.

You influence, but do not own, go-to-market packaging and pricing, launch sequencing and enablement, program-level coordination across dependent teams, and OEM certification scheduling. You are the single accountable owner of the product outcome. This role does not ask you to be the program manager, the engineering manager, or the designer.

Working in an Agent-Native Product Organization

We expect AI to be core infrastructure in your practice, not a novelty.

Use it to compress customer research and synthesis, analyze product usage data, draft and pressure-test requirements, and build working prototypes that validate a panel workflow before engineering commits to it. Prefer prototypes and working software over long planning cycles and abstract market research.

As we push document intelligence and agentic workflows into capture and release, you will work with our AI and architecture teams to reason about non-deterministic behavior: defining evaluation sets, judging model quality against them, and designing experiences that handle uncertainty deliberately through confidence thresholds, fallbacks, and human review

Qualifications
  • 5-7+ years in product management shipping software that customers depend on, including end-to-end ownership of a product area from discovery through launch and iteration.
  • Deep subject-matter expertise in printers and MFP applications: the embedded panel experience, manufacturer SDK platforms and their differing capabilities, secure print and release, authentication at the device, and scanning and capture workflows. You have shipped in an environment where the software is constrained by physical devices and by vendor timelines you do not control. Ideally, hands-on experience with one or more manufacturer embedded platforms — HP Workpath or OXPd, Xerox EIP, Ricoh SDK/J, Canon MEAP, or comparable platforms from other manufacturers — across both native and web-based architectures.
    • You have built or owned products in this space and do not need to be taught the domain. This is not a nice-to-have. We will not advance candidates without demonstrated depth here.
  • Demonstrated technical fluency. You can reason about SDKs, APIs, and authentication (SSO and identity providers, badge, PIN), understand how technical choices change the product, and hold your own with engineers on architectural trade-offs.
  • Working AI fluency in your own practice. You use AI tools in real, repeatable workflows for research, analysis, documentation, or prototyping.
  • Strong written communication. You write briefs, requirements, and decision documents a cross-functional team can act on.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related discipline or equivalent practical experience.
  • Working on-site in Lehi or St. George is a significant plus. Fully remote is fine, with occasional travel to Utah.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Print, output management, document capture, or scanning domain experience.
  • Familiarity with printing standards and protocols: IPP, SNMP, Mopria, SOAP, etc.
  • Experience building for regulated and public-sector buyers: healthcare (HIPAA, EMR printing), government (FedRAMP), education, or financial services, including zero trust and VDI environments.
  • Experience with serverless or cloud print, or a comparable migration off on-premise servers.
  • Experience defining evaluation sets or shipping AI, machine learning, or document intelligence features in production.
  • Experience working directly with OEM developer and certification programs or a hardware partner ecosystem.
What Good Looks Like
By 90 days

You have built a working command of the manufacturer capability matrix and are leading conversations about it rather than following them. You have talked with IT administrators and end users across at least two verticals, spent time at real devices across multiple brands, and established a point of view on the top constraints and opportunities in the embedded portfolio.

By six months

You own the CPA roadmap outright. You have shipped at least one meaningful improvement to on-device authentication, release, or capture; made and defended at least one hard per-OEM sequencing decision; and instrumented the adoption and secure release metrics you are accountable for.

By one year

Your area shows measurable movement: CPA adoption across the installed base, secure release reliability, and scan workflow completion trending up; field defect and support rates on device releases trending down. You are leading a managed, sequenced roadmap, and your team ships predictably against it.

Benefits
  • Flexible work environment
  • Discretionary Vacation Bonus
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • Competitive pay
  • A full suite of traditional benefits
  • Training/Advancement opportunities
  • 401k with company match and immediate vesting
  • Mental health & coaching support
  • Financial wellness education
  • Company-contributed HSA
  • On-site perks include gym, pickleball, snacks & drinks, arcade, theater room, etc.
Our Core Values

Vasion looks for people who will exemplify its four core values and are driven to become:

  • Disruptive Visionaries: Our customers are the heroes, and our role is to be a guide on their journey, truly listening and identifying the needs and wants of our customers.
  • Relationship Builders: We treat people as people, building strong relationships through empathy, compassion, and honest communication.
  • Candor Seekers: Candid conversations are critical to achieving objectives, and we nurture a culture of caring personally and challenging directly.
  • Action Owners: Every employee takes ownership of any failures and develops a plan to win, no matter their tenure or circumstance.
More about Vasion

Visit to learn more about Vasion.

Additional Information

Vasion is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, age, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation and other legally protected characteristics.
