raw.title: Senior Director, Revenue Operations
raw.excerpt: Company Overview EPS Learning provides Science of Reading–aligned PreK–12 literacy solutions that help schools deliver effective, evidence-based instruction.
raw.description:
Company Overview

EPS Learning provides Science of Reading–aligned PreK–12 literacy solutions that help schools deliver effective, evidence-based instruction. Our portfolio includes trusted programs such as SPIRE®, SPIRE Up®, and Wordly Wise 3000®, supporting students across all tiers of instruction through print, digital, and blended learning solutions. We partner with districts nationwide to strengthen literacy outcomes and expand access to ESSA-aligned, evidence-based practices.

Backed by a private equity partner, EPS Learning continues to invest in product innovation and go-to-market capabilities to support long-term growth and impact. If you are motivated by meaningful work and want to help improve literacy outcomes for students across the country, you’ll find a collaborative, mission-driven team at EPS Learning committed to making a difference in classrooms every day.

Position Summary

AsSenior Director, Revenue Operations at EPS Learning, you'll build and run the engine behind our growth. You'll own the strategy, processes, analytics and cross-functional workflows that help us win, grow and keep the customers who rely on us to support educators and students, so our revenue is predictable. You'll bring sales operations, marketing operations, deal desk, forecasting and customer lifecycle operations together across the full journey from lead to cash. You'll also be a strategic partner to our SVP of Sales on go-to-market design, planning and investment decisions.

You'll be the business owner of our commercial systems and data. That means you'll decide how tools are used, what they measure and how insights shape decisions. You'll work closely with Technology, especially our NetSuite Solutions Manager, to turn business needs into scalable platform solutions. You'll keep clear ownership of process design, data governance, adoption and results.Most importantly, you'll lead an AI-first approach to Revenue Operations. You'll use tools like Claude, Copilot and Gong to automate manual work, so your team spends less time building reports and more time on analysis and strategy.

Responsibilities

Revenue Strategy, Sales Operations & Pipeline Management

  • Partner with the SVP Sales to shape go-to-market strategy and the annual operating plan, translating growth targets into coverage, capacity, segmentation, and investment recommendations.
  • Define and continuously improve the end-to-end sales process, including opportunity stages, MEDDPICC qualification gates, exit criteria, and required data.
  • Define the pipeline visibility model, including executive, regional, and seller-level pipeline dashboards with product, territory, and motion visibility.
  • Establish forecast discipline and deliver accurate weekly, monthly, and quarterly revenue forecasts.
  • Own territory design, quota and capacity modeling, account segmentation, pipeline coverage analysis, and commercial planning.
  • Lead deal desk operations, including pricing-approval workflows within Finance-approved guardrails, non-standard deal structures, quote and contract support, and order handoff through close.
  • Build quoting and order workflows for K–12 public-sector purchasing, including RFPs and bids, cooperative and state contract vehicles, purchase orders, and fiscal-year funding cycles.
  • Partner with Finance and HR on compensation plan administration, incentives, and performance tracking.
  • Own pipeline hygiene and health: define health standards (stage aging, close-date slippage, next-step coverage, MEDDPICC completeness, and coverage by segment), run a weekly pipeline inspection cadence with sales leaders, and use AI-assisted inspection to flag risk early. Set CRM adoption and data quality standards and hold commercial teams accountable to them.

Marketing Operations

  • Support the lead lifecycle from initial inquiry through MQL, SQL, opportunity, and closed business, with clear service-level agreements between Marketing and Sales.
  • Deliver actionable reporting on pipeline sourced and influenced, conversion, cost efficiency, and campaign return on investment.

Revenue Analytics, Forecasting & Executive Reporting

  • Support and maintain a data dictionary, including single definitions of bookings, pipeline, coverage, and win rate, so Sales, Marketing, Finance, and the board work from one set of numbers.
  • Establish a recurring reporting cadence for weekly pipeline reviews, monthly business reviews, annual planning, and quarterly board reporting.
  • Buildbottoms-up forecast models using historical conversion, sales-cycle, seasonality, and scenario analysis.
  • Provide product-level visibility intopipeline, bookings, renewal health, utilization, and expansion opportunities.
  • Analyze win/loss trends, competitive displacement, seller productivity, account-tier movement, and market opportunity to shape where EPS invests, prices, and deploys sellers.
  • Translate complex revenue data into clear recommendations and narratives for executives and board stakeholders.

GTM Process Design, Enablement & Customer Lifecycle Operations

  • Architect and document the lead-to-cash process, including handoffs across lead capture, opportunity management, quoting, contracting, booking, invoicing, and cash collection.
  • Operationalize distinct go-to-market motions for new logos, upgrades, cross-sell, renewals, channel partners, and strategic accounts.
  • Create practical enablement infrastructure, including playbooks, competitive resources, pricing tools, onboarding, and productivity milestones.
  • Build the renewal operations engine, including health scoring, timeline management, risk escalation, and expansion signals.
  • Coordinate lifecycle workflows across Sales, Marketing, Product, Professional Learning, Finance, and Technology.

Commercial Technology, Data Governance & AI

  • Own the business roadmap for commercial technology, including Claude, CoPilot,HubSpot, Gong,BI,data enrichment, and emerging revenue tools.
  • Define data governance standards, integration requirements, reporting specifications, and prioritized business requirements for technical implementation partners.
  • Lead an AI-firstRevOpsoperating model, using tools such as Claude, Copilot, and Gong to automate reporting, forecast preparation, pipeline inspection, and data hygiene, and own AI use-case prioritization, safeguards, and adoption across commercial teams.
  • Set platform priorities with the NetSuite Solutions Manager, who leads configuration, integrations, and automation, and validate that delivered solutions meet business needs.
  • Directly administer Gong and manageRevOpstechnology vendors, licenses, renewals, and total cost of ownership.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to commercial and executive leaders on revenue performance, operating priorities, investment tradeoffs, and scalability.
  • Create clear decision rights and an effective “business owner + technical partner” operating model across Revenue Operations and Technology.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives through influence, credible data, practical change management, and strong stakeholder communication.
  • Operate as a hands-on individual contributor initially, prioritizing forecasting, pipeline governance, and executive reporting in year one, and build a small team as business needsgrow.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, Business, or a related field required. MBA or advanced degree preferred but not required.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, or a closely related function, including at least 5 years leading teams and major operating programs.
  • Demonstrated success building or transforming a RevOps function into scalable infrastructure across a multi-product or multi-motion organization.
  • Experience improving forecast accuracy, pipeline discipline, data quality, and commercial decision-making.
  • Experience in K–12, EdTech, education publishing, or public-sector selling, or another environment with complex, seasonal, budget-cycle-driven buying, preferred.
  • Experience in a high-growth or private-equity-backed environment with executive and board reporting expectations preferred.
  • Strong CRM fluency; NetSuite CRM experience is highly desirable. The successful candidate should be comfortable as a business-side power user who can define requirements, interpret data, and work effectively with technical administrators.
  • Working knowledge of HubSpot or an equivalent marketing automation platform; hands-on administration experience with conversation intelligence tools such as Gong is a plus.
  • Demonstrated hands-on use of AI tools such as Claude or Copilot to automate analysis, reporting, and workflows, with sound judgment on data privacy and output accuracy.
  • Experience with BI and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent.
  • Advanced financial and operational modeling skills, using Excel, Google Sheets, and AI-assisted analysis, for forecasting, territory, quota, capacity, and compensation analysis.
  • Ability to develop clear business requirements, process documentation, dashboards, and user stories for technical implementation partners.
  • Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and change leadership skills.
  • Our ideal candidate will be based in Eastern or Central time zones, and has the ability to travel a few times a year for in person leadership and sales meetings.

Benefits and Perks

We offer a competitive compensation package based on various factors including but not limited to qualifications, skills, competencies, location, and experience.

Other rewards include an annual bonus or commission, a 401(k) retirement plan with employer match, medical, dental, and vision insurance, generous PTO, sick and paid holidays, as well as employer paid life and short & long term disability insurance.

We provide you with a laptop for your home office and a flexible remote-first work culture.

Compensation Range:The base pay range for this position is $150,000 - $160,000 per year plus bonus.The actual base pay offered is determined by several variables, such as the candidate's qualifications, experience, skills, education, location, and market conditions. Base pay is one component of EPS Learning's total compensation package, which also includes a generous benefits package, 401k plan, as well as bonus or commission.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Our organization is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply! You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Please be sure to attach your resume. Applications without an attached resume will be considered incomplete. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer.

WCG delivers transformational solutions that accelerate clinical research and advance human health. Together, we stimulate growth, maximize efficiency, and shape the future of clinical trials.

Why WCG

At WCG, we invest in our people because you are the driving force behind our mission. When you grow, our impact grows. When you thrive, research accelerates. We empower you to build a meaningful career while advancing the work that improves lives.

What we offer:

Externally, this position maintains relationships with medical and clinical operations decision-makers at pharmaceutical, biopharma, biotech, and medical device companies.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty and responsibility satisfactorily. The accountabilities listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required.

  • Successfully prospects and sells solutions and services via a consultative selling approach within assigned global bio pharm/CRO clients

  • Manages client meeting schedules to achieve target performance

Shift Schedule:This is a 12-hour day shift (5:45 AM to 6:15 PM Mountain Time), operating on a 12/7 rotational schedule. The rotation is as follows:

  • Week 1: Work Thursdaythrough Saturday (3 consecutive days)
  • Week 2: Work Wednesdaythrough Saturday (4 consecutive days)

The schedule rotates on a bi-weekly basis.

This rotation then repeats every two weeks, providing built-in extended breaks and predictability for work-life balance.

Holiday:You will be required to work the holiday if a holiday lands during your shift. Holiday pay includes your hours worked, plus 8 hours of holiday at your regular hourly rate.

Onboarding and Training Schedule:For the purposes of onboarding and training, the shift for this position for the first 3 weeks will be Monday through Friday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Mountain.

Location requirements

Work from home in the United States

Why this job is exciting

This is a fast-paced, dynamic IT position. You will work hands-on with the latest technology in multiple client environments. All while engaging our clients in the process to understand their technology needs and enhance their technology efficiencies.

Who you are

You are a motivated and customer-focused Level II system administrator who supports our clients Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure. You have hands-on expertise in server/OS, networking, and storage systems, and will play a critical role in supporting multiple client’s environments.

You know how to:

  • Install, configure, and maintain servers, network devices, and storage systems following pre-defined process.
  • Monitor system performance and make recommendations for improvements.
  • Implement automation scripts to streamline routine tasks at the direction and support of our engineering department.
  • Support network infrastructure, including switches, routers, and firewalls.
  • Assist in implementing network improvements through the direction of the engineering department
  • Support storage solutions, ensuring data integrity and availability.
  • Support regular backups and disaster recovery testing at the direction of the engineering department and know process documentation.
  • Experience patching various devices with known process and tools during a patching cycle
  • Manage virtual machines, storage accounts, and networking within cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Support robust IAM policy and security measures within the public cloud.
  • Build/Maintain detailed documentation of IT systems, configurations, and procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational policies and industry standards.

Technology proficiencies:

  • Proficient with server operating systems (e.g., Windows Server, Linux, VMware).
  • Strong networking knowledge (e.g., Firewalls, Switches and Routers).
  • Experience with storage technologies (e.g., NAS, SAN, backups solutions).
  • Working experience with Observability tools (e.g., Logic Monitor, RMM).
  • Familiarity with Scripting tools (e.g., PowerShell, Python).
  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Familiarity with ITIL processes and ITSM tools.
  • Experience working in an MSP multi-tenant environment
  • Certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, CCNA, or VMware VCP.

  • Access to over 90,000+ courses in ADP My Learning

You’ll serve as a product and business expert throughout the sales process, combining deep market knowledge with a consultative, solutions-focused approach to influence customer decisions, strengthen opportunities, and drive business growth.

anstellungsdetails

Permanent Contract, Full- or Part-Time, Remote or Cologne / Düsseldorf / Darmstadt / Berlin

info

Who we are

We are the tech powerhouse behind Kaufland’s international online marketplaces and a company within the Schwarz Group. Driven by a start-up mentality and working on an equal footing within flat hierarchies, we develop the best marketplace solutions for our customers, sellers and partners. #FromEuropeForEurope

Day by day, our Tech & Product Team of about 400 experts pursues the goal of creating the best possible customer shopping experience for our online marketplace. Through innovative technical developments, they not only create an outstanding shopping experience but also lay the foundation for an optimal selling experience for our sellers. Learn more about our division, areas, and cross-functional teams here!

aufgaben

Your tasks – this is what awaits you in detail


Product data is the backbone of our marketplace. Every product page, search result, recommendation, and ad, and every answer an AI assistant gives about our products, depends on it. Whether a customer finds the right item, trusts what they see, and decides to buy is decided by the quality of that data.
With tens of millions of items, several countries and languages, and thousands of sellers, this cannot be solved with manual work. It takes scalable systems, and increasingly AI.
As Senior Product Manager, you own a key part of this backbone: how we enrich, evaluate, and prioritize product data, and how we make sure that customers, partners, and the many systems that rely on it can trust it. You will build scalable, backend-heavy products with a direct line to GMV, customer trust, and seller experience.
  • You own the strategy, vision, and roadmap for scalable products that enrich, evaluate, and prioritize product data, from the first idea through architecture and launch to measurable impact
  • You turn open-ended, ambiguous problems into clear sub-problems, a prioritized plan, and an execution path, and you defend your choices with data
  • You design and drive AI-powered systems at scale: LLMs and machine learning for attribute extraction, validation, translation, and quality scoring across multiple languages. You make sure that results are measurable, reliable and cost-efficient
  • You define how we measure the quality and reliability of content: what is “good data”, how do we know, and what do we do when sources disagree?
  • You decide where to invest limited capacity first by quantifying business impact, risk, and cost per item and per category
  • You work as the connecting point between Engineering, Data Science, Design, Search, Legal, Seller-facing teams, and other product teams. You translate business needs into technical requirements and technical trade-offs into business decisions
  • You build the metrics, dashboards, and feedback loops that tell us whether the system works, and you present results to stakeholders up to senior leadership

profil

Your profile – this is what we expect from you

  • You have extensive experience in digital product management or in related fields such as strategy or innovation with proven impact on users and business
  • You approach problems in a structured way: you can break down unclear challenges, form hypotheses, test them with data, and prioritize with a clear rationale
  • You have a good understanding of Data Science Models and when to apply them
  • You are experienced in using LLMs in production environments. You also know their limits and how to check whether results can be trusted
  • You are highly data-literate and outcome-driven, and you can turn metrics and user feedback into decisions
  • You think in scale: you look for solutions that work for millions of items, in several languages, and with limited manual effort
  • You are a strong written and verbal communicator, can explain complex topics simply, and can convince technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels
  • You have a solid technical understanding of data flows, APIs, and system integrations, and you enjoy working closely with engineers
  • You put the customer and the seller first and enjoy solving real pain points
  • You enjoy working in an international, English-speaking team (C1 level) and in a fast-paced, pragmatic environment

benefits

What we offer

  • Create your own work-life balance: You have the flexibility to choose between working remotely (within Germany) or from one of our locations in Cologne, Darmstadt, Düsseldorf, or in Berlin!
  • Do you want to move to Germany? No problem – we offer you an attractive relocation package to give you a smooth start.
  • Urban Sports Club and RSG Group Fitness Studios: Get top deals for fitness, swimming, yoga and more
  • Mental Well-Being: We support you on your well-being journey with special offerings such as Instahelp, the digital platform for online psychological counseling
  • Vacation & Sabbatical: Enjoy 30 days of vacation per year and the opportunity to take a sabbatical once you have been part of the team for a certain period!
  • Option for Pluxee restaurant vouchers: Buy Pluxee vouchers through us and benefit from tax-advantaged meal allowances!
  • ‘Deutschlandticket’: We subsidize your train season ticket for more mobility
  • Employee Discount: You will receive a monthly coupon for Kaufland.de
  • Free choice of hardware: Mac or Lenovo, it’s up to you
  • Boost your growth: Benefit from our online language learning programs, diverse in-house training, and our automated 360-degree feedback. We cover the costs for relevant conferences, training opportunities, and approved team workshops to strengthen personal interactions
  • This is who we are: Our dynamic culture combines flat hierarchies, a start-up mentality, an international team of over 65 nationalities, and the strength of the Schwarz Group to provide you an agile and secure working environment.
  • We are team players: From day one, you will connect not only with your team but also with others through our digital onboarding journey, the buddy program, and regular team and company events, all-hands meetings, powerful mornings, and much more!
Check out our Principles & our blog for even more insights into our company culture!

bewerben

Diversity at Kaufland e-commerce

We welcome applications from everyone, regardless of skin colour, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, ethnic origin, religion and ideology. We are signatories to the Charta der Vielfalt (German Diversity Charter) – because we know that extraordinary things can only be achieved with diversity. Read more here! When applying, you can optionally include your pronouns in your resume.

Why are you the perfect fit for this position?
Don't bother with cover letters - we're interested in facts and figures! Feel free to share your Github profile with us in your application.

As we have very international teams, we would highly appreciate it to receive your CV or profile link in English.

We are looking forward to your application!

En The Whiteam Consultingbuscamos un/a Arquitecto de Software / Senior Backend Developer para incorporarse a un programa estratégico de modernización tecnológica orientado a la transformación de aplicaciones Mainframe hacia arquitecturas modernas basadas en Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Batch, Oracle y AWS.

  • Revisar y validar conversiones generadas mediante herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial.

  • Participar en el diseño e implementación de arquitecturas APX dentro del proceso de modernización.

  • Garantizar la calidad técnica y funcional de las aplicaciones migradas.

  • Colaborar con equipos de desarrollo, arquitectura y transformación tecnológica.

Requisitos

  • Al menos 4 años de experiencia profesional en desarrollo de software.

  • Experiencia demostrable trabajando con tecnologías Mainframe como COBOL, JCL, CICS, DB2 o Copybooks.

  • Experiencia analizando e interpretando aplicaciones Mainframe.

  • Al menos 3 años de experiencia profesional con Java y Spring Boot.

  • Experiencia en Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Batch, Oracle y/o AWS.

  • Experiencia en diseño técnico, arquitectura de aplicaciones o definición de soluciones.

  • Capacidad para analizar aplicaciones existentes y definir su migración hacia arquitecturas modernas.

  • Experiencia o conocimientos en APX.

  • Participación en proyectos de modernización, transformación o migración tecnológica.

Se Valorará

  • Experiencia en proyectos de transformación Mainframe a Java.

  • Experiencia en sector bancario o financiero.

  • Participación en procesos de modernización asistidos por automatización o Inteligencia Artificial.

  • Conocimiento de arquitecturas cloud y microservicios.

  • Experiencia definiendo estándares, patrones de desarrollo y reglas de conversión tecnológica.

Condiciones

  • Modalidad 100% Remota.

  • Participación en un proyecto estratégico de transformación tecnológica.

  • Entorno altamente especializado e innovador.

  • Incorporación a iniciativas de modernización de sistemas críticos y arquitecturas empresariales de gran escala.

Compañía

Formar parte de THEWHITEAM es colaborar con una empresa formada por profesionales con una dilatada experiencia en consultoría tecnológica.

Creemos firmemente que las empresas y clientes marcan el camino a seguir en el sector, pero éste lo construyen las personas. Consideramos de vital importancia que nuestra organización se fundamente en nuestro mejor activo y marca de valor añadido que es nuestro equipo humano.

Beneficios

• Tenemos 23 días de vacaciones al año

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Undergrad Intern – R&D Execution, Operations & Strategy (Summer 2027)

What You Will Do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. This internship will be approximately 12 weeks and includes both project-based and experiential learning. The intern will be an integral member of the R&D Execution, Operations & Strategy (R&D EOS) organization, which is focused on driving innovation beyond the molecule and applying digital strategies to simplify processes. The 4 functional areas within R&D EOS are:

  • Strategy: Powering-up industry-leading R&D through strategy, functional transformation, and performance excellence
  • Portfolio & Program Management: Turning product strategy into execution to bring medicines to patients faster
  • R&D Business Operations: Innovating excellence and navigating efficiency to manage R&D operational activities, including budget planning and contracting, suppliers, laboratories, workforce strategy and environmental, social & governance (ESG)
  • R&D Knowledge & Learning: Transforming and advancing digitization and contemporized learning as well as cultivating talent & culture for a people-centric and inclusive workforce

As a member of Amgen's R&D EOS Organization, your work will be highly collaborative across multiple functions and levels within Amgen, including for example, Research & Development, Corporate Affairs, Digital Technology & Innovation, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging, and others. You will be uniquely responsible for one or more key projects that will advance R&D EOS’ mission, including the following:

  • Developing a project charter to map out objectives and identify key stakeholders, timelines, and deliverables
  • Leveraging your analytical, leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills to work in teams, identify problems, conduct research, develop recommendations through qualitative and quantitative analysis, and deliver final projects
  • Presenting your deliverables/findings through various forums including an intern-wide poster session and a final readout to executive management
  • You will also be engaged in learning activities, networking with colleagues across the company, and enjoying full access to Amgen’s Employee Resource Groups

This job description serves as a general outline for the responsibilities of an undergraduate intern in R&D EOS. The specific tasks and requirements may vary depending on the organization and its projects.

Program Eligibility Requirements

  • Expected completion of one year of study from an accredited college or university prior to the internship commencing
  • Expected continued enrollment in an accredited college or university following the internship program
  • Student must be located in the United States for the duration of the internship program
  • Must be available to work a full-time schedule

What We Expect of You

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The collaborative individual we seek is hard-working with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

Amgen requires that all individuals applying for an undergrad internship or a co-op assignment at Amgen must meet the following criteria:

  • 18 years or older
  • Currently enrolled in a full-time Bachelor’s Degree program from an accredited college or university with a 3.0 minimum GPA or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

· Degree concentration(s) in Business, Finance, Management Sciences, Life Sciences, Engineering, Communications, Psychology, Human Resources, Information Science or a related field

· Strong written and verbal communication skills

· Highly organized, with an ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines

· Enthusiastic, proactive, and a willingness to learn

· Adaptability in navigating and effectively responding to ambiguity and evolving circumstances and priorities

· Basic understanding of project management concepts is a plus

What You Can Expect of Us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The base pay range for this opportunity in the U.S. is $28.87 per hour.

  • Build a network of colleagues that will endure and grow throughout your time with us and beyond.
  • Bring your authentic self to the table and become the professional you’re inspired to be through accepting a culture that values the diversity of thought and experience and will flex to your strengths and possibilities.
  • Participate in executive and social networking events, as well as community volunteer projects.

Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.

raw.description:
Liebe*r zukünftig*r Kolleg*in,

heute bewerben wir uns bei dir und stellen dir unser Unternehmen, unsere Leistungen und das Besondere an Plusnet vor:

Wir leben und gestalten Kommunikation

Die Plusnet GmbH, eine Tochtergesellschaft der EnBW, ist ein deutsches Telekommunikationsunternehmen mit Fokus auf Geschäftskunden. Plusnet betreibt eine eigene, bundesweite Netzinfrastruktur und verfügt über jahrzehntelange Erfahrung im Betrieb unterschiedlicher Breitband-Technologien. Auf Basis ihres umfassenden Know-hows stellt die Plusnet Gruppe mehr als 40.000 Geschäftskunden jeder Größenordnung zuverlässige und hochsichere Sprach- und Datendienste zur Verfügung. Darüber hinaus agiert Plusnet als Vermittler zukunftssicherer Netze: Über die bundesweite offene Connectivity-Handelsplattform Netbridge können Partner eigene Glasfasernetze bzw. andere Infrastrukturen besser auslasten oder zusätzliche Reichweite für eigene Services gewinnen. Das Unternehmen mit Sitz in Köln beschäftigt rund 500 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter an insgesamt zehn deutschen Standorten. Diese wichtigen Themen kannst du mitgestalten und voranbringen.

Dein Wirkungsfeld

Als Partner Manager Retail verantwortest du die strategische und wirtschaftliche Entwicklung eines definierten Portfolios von Retail- und Vertriebspartnern im indirekten Vertrieb. Du gewinnst, aktivierst und entwickelst Partner gezielt weiter und sorgst dafür, dass sie ihr Vertriebs- und Umsatzpotenzial ausschöpfen. Dabei steuerst du die Partnerperformance entlang von Umsatz, Pipeline, Conversion und Kampagnenaktivität und stellst eine erfolgreiche und nachhaltige Zusammenarbeit sicher.

Requirements

Dein Aufgabenfeld

  • Du verantwortest dein Partnerportfolio: Du betreust Retail- und Vertriebspartner im indirekten Vertrieb, gewinnst neue Partner und entwickelst bestehende Partnerschaften strategisch und wirtschaftlich weiter.

  • Du planst und steuerst die Partnerperformance: Du entwickelst Partner-Business-Pläne mit Umsatz-, Pipeline- und Forecast-Zielen und leitest aus relevanten KPIs konkrete Maßnahmen ab.

  • Du aktivierst und befähigst deine Partner: Du stellst die Kampagnenfähigkeit sicher, steuerst Lead-Zuführung und -Bearbeitung und unterstützt deine Partner durch Schulungen, Zertifizierungen und eine einheitliche Verkaufsstory.

  • Du entwickelst Partnerschaften nachhaltig: In regelmäßigen Business- und Performance-Reviews identifizierst du Potenziale und Risiken, gibst strukturiertes Feedback und leitest Maßnahmen zur Weiterentwicklung ab.

  • Du steuerst Schnittstellen und Eskalationen: Du koordinierst wiederkehrende Themen, klärst Channel-Konflikte mit dem Key Account Management und sorgst für transparente CRM-, Pipeline- und Forecast-Daten.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du bringst relevante Erfahrung mit: Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation und bringst mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung im indirekten Vertrieb, Channel- oder Partner Management mit.

  • Verständnis für Partnervertrieb: Partnerökosysteme, Lead Management, Kampagnensteuerung und Vertriebsperformance sind für dich vertrautes Terrain.

  • Stärke in der Partnerentwicklung: Du weißt, wie du Partner gewinnst, aktivierst, befähigst und mithilfe von Enablement und Performance Management nachhaltig entwickelst.

  • Kommerzielles und vertriebliches Know-how: Du kannst Rahmen- und Konditionsverträge sicher verhandeln, steuerst Partner anhand relevanter Vertriebskennzahlen und bringst ein gutes Verständnis für B2B-Telekommunikations-, ITK- und cloudbasierte Lösungen mit. Dabei kannst du deren Nutzen verständlich und vertriebsorientiert vermitteln.

  • Struktur & Kommunikation: Du arbeitest sicher mit CRM-/PRM- und Reporting-Tools, kommunizierst souverän mit Partnern und internen Stakeholdern und bringst sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse mit.

Bei uns sind alle Menschen willkommen. Wir fördern Chancengleichheit unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, sexueller Identität, Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, mit oder ohne Behinderung.

Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, möchten wir dich ausdrücklich ermutigen, dich bei uns zu bewerben!

raw.description:
Title:

Principal Marketing Specialist, Tradeshows & Events

At KBR, we deliver science, technology and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world. KBR employs approximately 37,000 people worldwide with customers in more than 85 countries and operations in over 28 countries. KBR is proud to work with its customers across the globe to provide technology, value-added services, and long-term operations and maintenance services to ensure consistent delivery with predictable results.


Trinzic is the future independent company to be created through the planned spin-off of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, expected in January 2027. Our people work at the frontier of what is possible, delivering solutions in challenging environments and advancing some of the world's highest-priority national security and space missions. 


Backed by decades of mission success, deep expertise, and trusted partnerships, Trinzic will launch as a global organization with more than 18,000 employees supporting customers around the world. Join us at a defining moment and help shape the future of a company built to tackle complex challenges and make a meaningful impact. 


Candidates who join KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business before the spin-off will transition to Trinzic when the separation is complete and will not need to reapply for employment. 


The Principal Marketing Specialist is a key member of the Corporate Marketing Tradeshows & Events team, providing strategic leadership for tradeshow, event, sponsorship, and membership marketing initiatives. This role is responsible for developing, driving, and optimizing event marketing strategies that support business growth, strengthen brand visibility, enhance customer engagement, and advance strategic business development objectives across domestic and international markets. Working collaboratively with business leaders, business development teams, and marketing stakeholders, the Principal Marketing Specialist leads a diverse portfolio of high-profile events while providing strategic guidance, performance insights, and recommendations that maximize organizational impact and return on investment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and oversee the full lifecycle of event management initiatives, spanning strategic planning, vendor sourcing and oversight, logistics coordination, and budget adherence, ensuring alignment with overarching brand and business objectives.
  • Serve as a cross-functional project leader, managing multiple concurrent initiatives and ensuring deliverables are executed on time, within budget, and in support of business goals.
  • Drive the planning and execution of key tradeshows, conferences, sponsorships, memberships, and affiliated events supporting Trinzic's business objectives, ensuring a high-impact and engaging brand presence.
  • Oversee all aspects of event execution, including venue selection, exhibit and booth design, meeting schedules, staffing coordination, A/V, catering, shipping logistics, and on-site event management.
  • Lead the planning and execution of executive engagements, customer events, media days, and other high-visibility corporate events involving executive leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Partner with business leaders, business development teams, and marketing stakeholders to define event objectives, strategic messaging, audience engagement strategies, and success metrics that support growth and customer engagement.
  • Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to develop event marketing materials and assets, including presentations, brochures, signage, multimedia content, promotional campaigns, and branded merchandise that reinforce Trinzic's value proposition.
  • Establish and track event performance metrics, deliver post-event reporting and analysis, and provide actionable recommendations to enhance future event strategies and maximize return on investment.
  • Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with event organizers, industry associations, sponsors, vendors, and external partners, negotiating contracts and ensuring successful delivery of services.
  • Develop, manage, and reconcile event, sponsorship, and membership budgets while identifying opportunities to optimize resources and maximize value.
  • Facilitate planning meetings, readiness reviews, and post-event debriefs to align stakeholders, evaluate outcomes, and drive continuous improvement across event programs.
  • Ensure consistent brand representation and excellence across all event touchpoints while managing multiple complex events in a fast-paced environment.
  • Oversee membership administration and event-related financial activities, including contract management, sponsorship fulfillment, purchase requisitions, payment processing, and budget reconciliation.

Basic Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of progressive marketing experience, including direct hands-on experience developing and executing tradeshow, event marketing, sponsorship, and experiential marketing programs.
  • Experience planning and executing complex national and international tradeshows, conferences, sponsorships, executive events, and customer engagements.
  • Experience managing event budgets, vendor contracts, sponsorship investments, and related financial processes.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally, including evenings and weekends, as required.

Professional Skills & Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of event marketing, tradeshow strategy, sponsorship activation, and event planning best practices.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple high-priority projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and budget requirements.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to build strong relationships across all levels of the organization.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with experience measuring event effectiveness and translating results into actionable recommendations.
  • Proven ability to negotiate and manage relationships with vendors, venues, industry organizations, and external partners.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Teams, and JIRA or similar project management tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting defense, government contracting, aerospace, logistics, space, or technology organizations, including planning and executing events that engage U.S. Government, Department of Defense, and federal civilian customers.
  • Experience managing events of varying size, complexity, and format, ranging from executive meetings and customer engagements to large-scale tradeshows, conferences, and sponsorship activations.
  • Professional certification in event management, marketing, or project management.
  • Experience utilizing CRM, event management, marketing automation, or analytics platforms to measure campaign and event performance.

Location: The ideal candidate will be located in the Washington, D.C. area however remote candidates are encouraged to apply.


Additional Compensation: KBR may offer bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation to certain job titles or levels, per internal policy or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be in the form of sign on bonus, relocation benefits, short term incentives, long term incentives, or discretionary payments for exceptional performance.

Benefits: KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits which could include a 401K plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, flexible spending account, disability, paid time off, or flexible work schedule. We support career advancement through professional training and development.


Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR

At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together.


KBR is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

Your greatest work is ahead!

We’re seeking a Lead Substation Physical Engineer to take a key role in delivering high‑impact substation physical design projects. You’ll work on utility systems ranging from 12 kV to 500 kV, contributing to major grid‑modernization efforts and supporting how renewable generation connects to the grid. In this role, you’ll apply your expertise in digital logic design and AC/DC circuits to develop safe, reliable, and efficient substation physical layouts. From equipment arrangement to grounding and structural components, you’ll help shape the next generation of substation projects powering communities.

*Remote candidates must be located in the United States, preferably in the state of Pennsylvania.

*Must be willing to travel to customer sites and into the office as needed (10% to 15% travel)

Successful candidates can look forward to a fast paced, diverse work environment and flexible work hours/work arrangements as well as managers who will encourage career development and growth including:

  • Professional Engineer License (PE).
  • Project Management Professional (PMP).
  • Technical & Non-Technical Training Opportunities.
  • Leadership Opportunities.
  • Mentorship & Training Opportunities.
  • Opportunity to Lead, Grow, and Inspire a Dynamic Team

Begin your journey of a flourishing and meaningful career, share your resume with us today!

The Challenge:

  • Lead and support the delivery of substation physical design projects, ensuring technical excellence and on‑time performance.
  • Partner closely with internal engineering groups and external clients to understand needs, align expectations, and deliver solutions that exceed standards.
  • Perform detailed QA/QC reviews on substation physical design packages, ensuring accuracy, constructability, and compliance.
  • Read, design, and review essential substation drawings, including one‑lines, three‑lines, plan‑and‑section views, grounding layouts, and foundation designs.
  • Create and verify bills of materials for substation physical components, ensuring precision and alignment with project requirements.
  • Conduct site visits at customer locations to gather data, validate designs, and support successful project execution.

Successful candidates must comply with quality control and safe work practices and maintain compliance with project scope, schedule, and budget. This position will be a member of a design team comprised of engineers, designers, and CAD technicians and will work with client standards to implement design.

What Sets You Apart:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (or related field) with 8+ years of substation physical design experience.
  • Experience performing grounding studies, lightning protection analysis, and lighting studies.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with internal teams and clients to support project needs.
  • Proven ability to meet deadlines and stay organized in fast‑paced or high‑pressure situations.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team environment, contribute to group success, and provide leadership when needed.
  • Self‑starter who can take initiative and work with minimal supervision.
  • Strong analytical abilities with a track record of solving engineering challenges both independently and collaboratively.
  • High level of computer competency and comfort working with engineering tools and software.
  • Willingness to travel to project sites and client locations as needed.
  • Professional Engineer (“PE”) License. - Preferred

You Might Also have:

  • Engineer Intern (“EI” or “EIT”) professional certification.
  • Working knowledge of protection and control design
  • Experience with bus calculation
  • Experience with WinIGS or CDEGS
  • Master’s degree in related field.

WHAT WE DO

Leidos is a trusted and technology-focused solutions provider. Utilities and mobile operators rely on our Power Delivery Services Team for reliable power and telecommunication expertise, as reflected through our work with more than 50 investor-owned utilities, more than 160 municipals/cooperatives, as well as a growing number of mobile operators, local utility providers and private developers. In addition to providing engineering and project management services, Leidos works with an established group of industry-leading construction partners delivering meaningful Energy Delivery Solutions. Our recognition as an industry leader is confirmed by the latest national rankings by Engineering News-Record (ENR) ranking Leidos within the Top 10 T&D Firms, and Top 10 Power Firms. To explore and learn more, click here!

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

We take care of our employees. Leidos seeks the best and the brightest, and in return, we invest in you, with an eye on your future, through career advancement, growth opportunities and continuous improvement via mentoring, formal and informal project management training and assistance with obtaining pertinent certifications. We challenge you to help solve some of the world’s toughest problems, and reward you with a welcoming culture that recognizes the importance of a strong work/life balance, as well as competitive compensation and benefits. We believe that diversity and inclusion make us all better and offer the chance to have fun and make a difference.

PowerDelivery

PDSSUBSTATION

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

Supplier.io is the data foundation that enterprises build their supplier decisions on. Fragmented, duplicated, and unreliable supplier data quietly limits the ROI of source-to-pay platforms, analytics, risk, and AI initiatives, so we resolve, enrich, and continuously maintain the industry's most complete supplier identity, then put it to work for the teams that buy and the suppliers themselves. Relied on by companies across the Fortune 2000 for accurate data, our platform helps corporate procurement, finance, and compliance teams manage their vendor master, source diverse and sustainable suppliers, and mitigate risk, all from one verified identity instead of a dozen disconnected systems.

Our solutions turn that foundation into action: accurate data and continuous maintenance for teams managing a fragmented vendor master, sourcing intelligence built resolving even the hardest-to-identify suppliers, small, local, and diverse businesses, for teams tracking sustainability and compliance, and direct visibility for the suppliers themselves into where they stand with the enterprises that buy from them. Whether you're resolving vendor records, sourcing alternatives, or measuring program results, Supplier.io transforms complexity into clarity, so teams can lead with confidence and build supply chains that deliver for both business and community.

The Opportunity

The Director, Data Architecture owns the strategy, standards, and team behind how data moves through Supplier.io, from source systems and web-scraping pipelines through ingestion, transformation, and governed delivery into the warehouses and marts the rest of the business relies on. You'll operate as a peer to our other engineering leaders, setting data architecture direction jointly with the CTO, while staying accountable for the reliability, quality, and governance of every data workflow we run.

You'll lead two distinct groups: a Data Engineering team building new pipelines, models, and architecture, and a Data Operations Engineering team running and maintaining the processes already in production. In the near term, before the team and its processes are fully built out, this role is hands-on: you'll be designing pipelines, data models, and orchestration directly, not just directing from a distance.

What You Will Do

Data Architecture & Platform Strategy

  • Own the multi-year data architecture strategy across our data warehouses and operational data stores, including evolving toward a medallion (bronze, silver, gold) lakehouse model.
  • Design and own our data lake and warehouse architecture, including the formation and population of data marts that serve analytics, product, and stakeholder reporting needs.
  • Set the orchestration strategy and standards for all data workflows, including source ingestion, web-scraping pipelines, ETL/ELT, and automated workflow management, and standardize the tooling used across the function.
  • Own the infrastructure and administration behind our data warehouses and pipelines, including capacity, reliability, and cost.
  • Own data governance end to end: the policies, standards, and practices for data quality, lineage, access, retention, and classification across every system of record.

Team & Execution Leadership

  • Build, lead, and grow two functions: Data Engineering, building new pipelines, models, and architecture, and Data Operations Engineering, running and maintaining existing production data processes.
  • Decide how the function is organized as it scales, including when and whether to add management layers beneath you to run day-to-day execution.
  • Stay hands-on early: design and review pipelines, data models, and orchestration directly until the team is built out to carry that execution independently, and stay close enough to the technology afterward to make credible architecture calls.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with engineering leadership to keep data architecture decisions aligned with company-wide standards.
  • Work closely with data engineering teams on technical planning and delivery for our core data products.
  • Partner with product, analytics, and other business stakeholders across the company to understand data needs and translate them into warehouse and data mart designs.

Data Quality & Compliance

  • Define and enforce data quality gates, lineage tracking, and auditability standards across all data pipelines.
  • Own data access controls, classification, and retention policy across the data estate.
  • Ensure compliance-relevant and audit-sensitive data is handled according to governance standards as our data sources and customer base grow.

What You Will Need to Succeed

  • 10+ years in data engineering, data architecture, or related roles, including 5+ years in a Director or Manager-level leadership role owning architecture strategy and a team, not just individual delivery.
  • Deep, hands-on experience designing and operating cloud data warehouse or lakehouse architectures (Snowflake and/or BigQuery), including medallion (bronze, silver, gold) patterns.
  • Experience integrating a range of source systems (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and building ingestion and ETL pipelines from varied and unstructured sources, including web-scraping pipelines and background job orchestration.
  • A track record of building and scaling a data engineering or data platform organization, including deciding when and how to split engineering and operations functions.
  • Strong data governance background: establishing policies and standards for data quality, lineage, access, and retention in a regulated or compliance-sensitive environment.
  • Experience setting technical direction jointly with peer engineering leaders and influencing architecture decisions across teams.
  • Excellent communication skills, comfortable setting strategy with peer leaders and reporting data platform health, cost, and risk directly to the CTO.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience consolidating or re-architecting data platforms following an acquisition or significant data source expansion.
  • Experience with orchestration tooling such as Airflow or dbt, and with scraping or crawling infrastructure at scale.
  • Background establishing data marts and self-service analytics layers for non-engineering stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with data observability tooling (Monte Carlo, Great Expectations, Soda, or similar).
